```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ValidatePlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanConflictResolutionData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanSaveData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\PlanConflictReason;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\ResourceBookingReleased;
use Konventix\Resources\Exceptions\PlanConflictException;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * Design §6.3: deleting, recategorising or blocking an occupied place is a
 * conflict; moving or relabelling it never is. The only resolution is
 * `release` — booking released with reason `plan_conflict`, claim back to
 * `unplaced` — and nothing is written until every conflict has one.
 */
it('refuses to delete an occupied place and lists its booking', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEvent($brand);
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
    $plan = seatingPlan($eventId);

    $a = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-01');
    $b = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-02', ['x' => 800]);
    seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$a, $b]));
    $booking = seatingOccupy(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id']));

    try {
        seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$b]));
        $this->fail('Expected PlanConflictException.');
    } catch (PlanConflictException $e) {
        $response = $e->render(request());

        expect($e->conflicts)->toHaveCount(1)
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->placeId)->toBe($a['id'])
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->ref)->toBe('A-01')
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->reason)->toBe(PlanConflictReason::Deleted)
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->bookings[0]->bookingId)->toBe($booking->id)
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->bookings[0]->holderType)->toBe('registration')
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->bookings[0]->registrationId)->toBe($booking->registration_id)
            ->and($e->conflicts[0]->bookings[0]->claimId)->toBe($booking->claim_id)
            ->and($response->getStatusCode())->toBe(422)
            ->and($response->getData(true)['conflicts'][0]['bookings'][0]['bookingId'])->toBe($booking->id);
    }

    expect($booking->fresh()->state)->toBe(BookingState::Confirmed)
        ->and(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id'])->deleted_at)->toBeNull()
        ->and($plan->fresh()->version)->toBe(1);
});

it('refuses to recategorise an occupied place', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEvent($brand);
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
    $vip = seatingCategory($eventId, 'vip');
    $plan = seatingPlan($eventId);

    $a = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-01');
    seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$a]));
    seatingOccupy(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id']));

    try {
        seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([array_merge($a, ['resourceTypeId' => $vip->id])]));
        $this->fail('Expected PlanConflictException.');
    } catch (PlanConflictException $e) {
        expect($e->conflicts[0]->reason)->toBe(PlanConflictReason::CategoryChanged);
    }

    expect(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id'])->resource_type_id)->toBe($type->id);
});

it('refuses to block an occupied place', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEvent($brand);
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
    $plan = seatingPlan($eventId);

    $a = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-01');
    seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$a]));
    seatingOccupy(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id']));

    try {
        seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([array_merge($a, ['blocked' => true])]));
        $this->fail('Expected PlanConflictException.');
    } catch (PlanConflictException $e) {
        expect($e->conflicts[0]->reason)->toBe(PlanConflictReason::Blocked);
    }

    expect(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id'])->blocked)->toBeFalse();
});

it('releases the booking and unplaces the claim when the operator resolves with release', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEvent($brand);
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
    $plan = seatingPlan($eventId);

    $a = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-01');
    $b = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-02', ['x' => 800]);
    seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$a, $b]));
    $booking = seatingOccupy(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id']));

    $seen = [];
    Event::listen(ResourceBookingReleased::class, function (ResourceBookingReleased $event) use (&$seen): void {
        $seen[] = [$event->bookingId, $event->reason, DB::transactionLevel()];
    });

    $result = seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$b]), [
        new PlanConflictResolutionData(placeId: $a['id'], resolution: 'release'),
    ]);

    expect($result->version)->toBe(2)
        ->and($booking->fresh()->state)->toBe(BookingState::Released)
        ->and(ResourceClaim::query()->findOrFail($booking->claim_id)->state)->toBe(ClaimState::Unplaced)
        ->and(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id'])->deleted_at)->not->toBeNull()
        // RefreshDatabase's wrapper is level 1: the listener ran after
        // SavePlan's commit, not inside the nested release.
        ->and($seen)->toBe([[$booking->id, 'plan_conflict', 1]]);
});

it('lets an occupied place move and be relabelled without a conflict', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEvent($brand);
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
    $plan = seatingPlan($eventId);

    $a = seatingPlace($type->id, 'A-01');
    seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([$a]));
    $booking = seatingOccupy(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id']));

    Event::fake([ResourceBookingReleased::class]);

    $result = seatingSave($plan, seatingDocument([
        array_merge($a, ['x' => 5000, 'y' => 3000, 'rotation' => 90, 'label' => 'Front 1', 'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 500, 'h' => 500]]),
    ]));

    expect($result->version)->toBe(2)
        ->and($booking->fresh()->state)->toBe(BookingState::Confirmed)
        ->and(seatingPlaces($plan)->get($a['id'])->label)->toBe('Front 1');

    Event::assertNotDispatched(ResourceBookingReleased::class);
});

it('reports the same conflicts from the dry run without writing', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEvent($brand);
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\PlanPublished;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;

/**
 * Makes a plan visible to the picker (design §6.4): sets `published_at` and
 * re-derives `is_published` on the plan's live places, because that flag is
 * the projection's copy of the plan's state (§4.2) and the picker reads only
 * the projection. Idempotent — publishing a published plan changes nothing
 * and emits nothing. Soft-deleted places stay as they are: history.
 */
final class PublishPlan
{
    public function handle(Plan $plan): Plan
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($plan): Plan {
            Plan::withoutBrandScope()->whereKey($plan->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $plan->refresh();

            if ($plan->published_at !== null) {
                return $plan;
            }

            $plan->forceFill(['published_at' => now()])->save();

            Resource::withoutBrandScope()
                ->where('plan_id', $plan->id)
                ->update(['is_published' => true]);

            DB::afterCommit(static function () use ($plan): void {
                event(new PlanPublished(planId: $plan->id, eventId: $plan->event_id, brandId: $plan->brand_id));
            });

            return $plan;
        });
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/UnpublishPlan.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\PlanUnpublished;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;

/**
 * Withdraws a plan from the picker (design §6.4): clears `published_at` and
 * turns `is_published` off on the plan's live places, so the availability
 * read model reports them `unavailable` and `AssignPlacesToRegistration`
 * refuses them. Existing bookings are untouched — unpublishing is not a
 * release. Idempotent, emits only on a change.
 */
final class UnpublishPlan
{
    public function handle(Plan $plan): Plan
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($plan): Plan {
            Plan::withoutBrandScope()->whereKey($plan->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $plan->refresh();

            if ($plan->published_at === null) {
                return $plan;
            }

            $plan->forceFill(['published_at' => null])->save();

            Resource::withoutBrandScope()
                ->where('plan_id', $plan->id)
                ->update(['is_published' => false]);

            DB::afterCommit(static function () use ($plan): void {
                event(new PlanUnpublished(planId: $plan->id, eventId: $plan->event_id, brandId: $plan->brand_id));
            });

            return $plan;
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanDocumentData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanSaveData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanSaveResultData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\PlanVersionSource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;

/**
 * Replaces a plan's document with an uploaded one (design §6.4): the array
 * is validated as `PlanDocumentData` (a bad upload is an ordinary 422), then
 * saved through `SavePlan` with source `import` against the plan's current
 * version — so every rule of a save applies: unknown ids are new places,
 * ids under another plan or brand are refused, an occupied place the upload
 * drops is a conflict the caller has to resolve like any other.
 *
 * `$categoryMap` rewrites `resourceTypeId`s before validation, for documents
 * written against another event's categories or the committed example's
 * placeholder (`PlanImportCommand::PLACEHOLDER_CATEGORY`).
 */
final class ImportPlan
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly SavePlan $save,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $document
     * @param  array<string, string>  $categoryMap  old resource type id => new resource type id
     */
    public function handle(Plan $plan, array $document, ?string $actorUserId, array $categoryMap = []): PlanSaveResultData
    {
        if ($categoryMap !== [] && isset($document['elements']) && is_array($document['elements'])) {
            foreach ($document['elements'] as $index => $element) {
                if (is_array($element) && isset($element['resourceTypeId']) && isset($categoryMap[$element['resourceTypeId']])) {
                    $document['elements'][$index]['resourceTypeId'] = $categoryMap[$element['resourceTypeId']];
                }
            }
        }

        $data = new PlanSaveData(
            expectedVersion: $plan->version,
            document: PlanDocumentData::validateAndCreate($document),
            resolutions: [],
        );

        return $this->save->handle($plan, $data, $actorUserId, PlanVersionSource::Import);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the two commands**

`app-modules/resources/src/Console/PlanImportCommand.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Console;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use JsonException;
use Konventix\Platform\Brands\BrandContext;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Brand;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ImportPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\PublishPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanDocumentData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\CapacityMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Exceptions\PlanConflictException;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;
use Konventix\Resources\Plans\PlanCanonicalJson;
use Konventix\Resources\Plans\PlanGeometry;

/**
 * Creates a plan from a `konventix.plan/v1` document on disk and imports it
 * through `ImportPlan` (design §6.4, §9.2) — the fallback that keeps the
 * SXLan plan reachable if the editor slips, and the way a plan travels
 * between environments.
 *
 * The event comes from Resources' own window read model (ULID or slug), the
 * brand from `--brand` or from that window, so nothing here reads another
 * module's tables (ADR-0004). Every `resourceTypeId` the event does not know
 * is remapped to `--category` (ULID or slug), or to the event's only unit
 * category when there is exactly one; otherwise the import stops before it
 * creates anything. Plan and import share one transaction, so a refused
 * document leaves no empty plan behind.
 *
 * Runs without a brand: queries escape the brand scope and the plan's
 * `brand_id` is force-filled. The brand is put into context for the
 * duration so listeners on `PlanSaved` see it.
 */
final class PlanImportCommand extends Command
{
    /**
     * The `resourceTypeId` the committed example document carries — a
     * syntactically valid ULID that never exists, so it always remaps.
     */
    public const string PLACEHOLDER_CATEGORY = '00000000000000000000000000';

    protected $signature = 'resources:plan-import
        {file : Path to a konventix.plan/v1 JSON document, absolute or relative to the project root}
        {--event= : Event ULID or slug, as projected into resource_event_windows}
        {--name= : Plan name; defaults to the file name}
        {--brand= : Brand ULID or slug; defaults to the brand of the event window}
        {--category= : Category (resource type) ULID or slug that replaces every resourceTypeId the event does not know}
        {--publish : Publish the plan once imported}';

    protected $description = 'Create a plan from a JSON document and project its places';

    public function handle(ImportPlan $import, PublishPlan $publish): int
    {
        $path = (string) $this->argument('file');
        $path = str_starts_with($path, '/') ? $path : base_path($path);

        if (! is_file($path)) {
            $this->error("File [{$path}] does not exist.");

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $document = PlanCanonicalJson::decode((string) file_get_contents($path));
        } catch (JsonException $e) {
            $this->error('The file is not a plan document: '.$e->getMessage());

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $eventOption = (string) $this->option('event');

        if ($eventOption === '') {
            $this->error('--event is required (an event ULID or slug).');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $brand = $this->resolveBrand((string) $this->option('brand'));
        $windows = ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where(fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->where('event_id', $eventOption)->orWhere('slug', $eventOption))
            ->when($brand !== null, fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->forBrand($brand->id))
            ->get();

        if ($windows->count() !== 1) {
            $this->error($windows->isEmpty()
                ? "No event window matches [{$eventOption}]; run event:replay-details or check the slug."
                : "Several brands have an event [{$eventOption}]; pass --brand.");

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $window = $windows->first();
        $brand ??= Brand::query()->whereKey($window->brand_id)->first();

        if ($brand === null) {
            $this->error('The brand of that event window no longer exists.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $categoryMap = $this->categoryMap($document, $brand->id, $window->event_id, (string) $this->option('category'));

        if ($categoryMap === null) {
            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $name = (string) ($this->option('name') ?: pathinfo($path, PATHINFO_FILENAME));

        try {
            $result = app(BrandContext::class)->withBrand($brand, function () use ($import, $publish, $document, $categoryMap, $brand, $window, $name): array {
                return DB::transaction(function () use ($import, $publish, $document, $categoryMap, $brand, $window, $name): array {
                    $plan = $this->createPlan($brand->id, $window->event_id, $name, $document);
                    $saved = $import->handle($plan, $document, null, $categoryMap);

                    if ((bool) $this->option('publish')) {
                        $publish->handle($plan);
                    }

                    return ['plan' => $plan, 'places' => count($saved->changedPlaceIds), 'version' => $saved->version];
                });
            });
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->error('The document was refused:');

            foreach ($e->errors() as $key => $messages) {
                $this->line("  {$key}: ".implode(' ', $messages));
            }

            return self::FAILURE;
        } catch (PlanConflictException $e) {
            $this->error($e->getMessage());

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        /** @var Plan $plan */
        $plan = $result['plan'];

        $this->info(sprintf(
            'Imported plan [%s] "%s" for event %s at version %d with %d place(s)%s.',
            $plan->id,
            $plan->name,
            $window->event_id,
            $result['version'],
            $result['places'],
            $plan->published_at !== null ? ', published' : '',
        ));

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function resolveBrand(string $option): ?Brand
    {
        if ($option === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return Brand::query()
            ->where(fn (Builder $query): Builder => $query->whereKey($option)->orWhere('slug', $option))
            ->first();
    }

    /**
     * Rewrites every unknown `resourceTypeId` to the chosen category, or
     * explains what is missing. Null means "stop".
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $document
     * @return array<string, string>|null
     */
    private function categoryMap(array $document, string $brandId, string $eventId, string $option): ?array
    {
        $types = ResourceType::withoutBrandScope()
            ->forBrand($brandId)
            ->where('event_id', $eventId)
            ->get();
        $known = $types->pluck('id')->all();

        $unknown = [];

        foreach ((array) ($document['elements'] ?? []) as $element) {
            $typeId = is_array($element) ? ($element['resourceTypeId'] ?? null) : null;

            if (is_string($typeId) && ! in_array($typeId, $known, true)) {
                $unknown[$typeId] = true;
            }
        }

        if ($unknown === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $target = $option !== ''
            ? $types->first(fn (ResourceType $type): bool => $type->id === $option || $type->slug === $option)
            : ($types->where('mode', CapacityMode::Unit)->count() === 1 ? $types->firstWhere('mode', CapacityMode::Unit) : null);

        if ($target === null) {
            $this->error(sprintf(
                'The document uses %d categor%s the event does not know (%s); pass --category=<ulid|slug> of one of: %s.',
                count($unknown),
                count($unknown) === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies',
                implode(', ', array_keys($unknown)),
                $types->isEmpty() ? '(none yet — create one in admin/resource-types)' : $types->pluck('slug')->implode(', '),
            ));

            return null;
        }

        return array_fill_keys(array_keys($unknown), $target->id);
    }

    /**
     * Width and height come from the document's world bounds, rounded up to
     * the next metre with a metre of margin, so an import never lands
     * outside its own canvas. `brand_id` force-filled (console, no context).
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $document
     */
    private function createPlan(string $brandId, string $eventId, string $name, array $document): Plan
    {
        $bounds = (new PlanGeometry(PlanDocumentData::validateAndCreate($document)))->bounds();
        $width = $bounds === null ? 10000 : (int) (ceil($bounds->maxX / 1000) * 1000) + 1000;
        $height = $bounds === null ? 10000 : (int) (ceil($bounds->maxY / 1000) * 1000) + 1000;

        $plan = new Plan;
        $plan->forceFill([
            'brand_id' => $brandId,
            'event_id' => $eventId,
            'venue_id' => null,
            'name' => $name,
            'floor_label' => null,
            'width_mm' => max(1000, $width),
            'height_mm' => max(1000, $height),
            'unit_display' => 'cm',
            'snap_step' => 100,
            'version' => 0,
            'document' => PlanDocumentData::from(['schema' => 'konventix.plan/v1', 'elements' => []]),
            'published_at' => null,
            'created_by' => null,
        ])->save();

        return $plan;
    }
}
```

`createPlan()` validates the raw document once for the bounds before `ImportPlan` validates the remapped one; the placeholder category is a syntactically valid ULID, so laravel-data's rules pass and only `PlanInvariants` (which needs the real category) sees the remapped document.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Console;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ExportPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;

/**
 * Prints a plan's document in canonical JSON (design §6.4, §9.2) — pipe it
 * into a file to move a plan between environments or to refresh the
 * committed example. Runs without a brand, so the lookup escapes the scope.
 */
final class PlanExportCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'resources:plan-export {plan : Plan ULID}';

    protected $description = 'Print a plan document as canonical JSON';

    public function handle(ExportPlan $export): int
    {
        $plan = Plan::withoutBrandScope()->whereKey((string) $this->argument('plan'))->first();

        if ($plan === null) {
            $this->error('No plan with that id.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $this->output->write($export->handle($plan));

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/ReservePlaceForOperator.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * An orga reservation (design §7.3, Q7): hold plus confirm in one
 * transaction with holder `operator` and the acting user's id, over the
 * event window like every whole-event booking. No claim, no registration.
 *
 * Reserving an occupied place fails through the exclusion constraint —
 * `HoldResourceBooking` lets the database refuse and raises
 * `ResourceUnavailableException`; nothing here checks first (ADR-0020). A
 * blocked place may be reserved: blocking keeps registrants off it, which
 * is exactly when the orga wants it. A removed place may not.
 *
 * `Permission::BookOnBehalf` is checked by the console controller.
 */
final class ReservePlaceForOperator
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly HoldResourceBooking $hold,
        private readonly ConfirmResourceBooking $confirm,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Resource $place, string $actorUserId): ResourceBooking
    {
        if ($place->trashed()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['placeId' => ['This place was removed from the plan.']]);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($place, $actorUserId): ResourceBooking {
            $type = ResourceType::withoutBrandScope()->whereKey($place->resource_type_id)->firstOrFail();
            $window = ResourceEventWindow::forEvent($place->brand_id, $type->event_id);

            if ($window === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['placeId' => ['The event window is not projected yet; run event:replay-details.']]);
            }

            $booking = $this->hold->handle(
                resource: $place,
                holderType: ResourceBooking::HOLDER_OPERATOR,
                holderId: $actorUserId,
                startsAt: $window->starts_at,
                endsAt: $window->ends_at,
                quantity: 1,
            );

            return $this->confirm->handle($booking);
        });
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/ReleaseOperatorReservation.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;

/**
 * Gives an orga reservation back (design §7.3) with reason
 * `operator_released`. Refuses anything that is not an operator booking:
 * a registration's seat leaves only through the registration lifecycle or
 * a plan conflict, never through this button.
 *
 * `Permission::BookOnBehalf` is checked by the console controller.
 */
final class ReleaseOperatorReservation
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReleaseResourceBooking $release,
    ) {}

    public function handle(ResourceBooking $booking): ResourceBooking
    {
        if ($booking->holder_type !== ResourceBooking::HOLDER_OPERATOR) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(sprintf(
                'Booking [%s] is held by a %s, not an operator reservation.',
                $booking->id,
                $booking->holder_type,
            ));
        }

        return $this->release->handle($booking, BookingState::Released, 'operator_released');
    }
}
```

## Slice S3: Registration seating grant, seat claims, AssignPlacesToRegistration

**Goal:** A registration type can grant seating (`GrantKind::Seating` with category ULIDs and a mode), the confirmation and amendment events carry that grant plus the registrant, Resources turns every seating grant into a `resource_claims` row and releases it with the registration, and `AssignPlacesToRegistration` places a claim on concrete places with the exclusion constraint deciding races — reachable headlessly and through `resources:assign-place`.

**Depends on:** S0 (`FulfilResourceClaims::handle(registrationId, eventId, brandId, grants, amendmentId)`, `FulfilClaimsOnRegistrationAmended`, `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationCancelled`, `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationRejected`, `ShortCircuitsInactiveModule::moduleActiveForBrand(string $brandId): bool`, `HoldResourceBooking::handle(..., ?string $registrationId = null, ?string $claimId = null)`, `ExpireResourceHoldsCommand` registered through `$this->commands([...])` in `ResourcesServiceProvider`), S1 (`Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim` with `$fillable` covering `event_id`, `registration_id`, `registrant_user_id`, `amendment_id`, `resource_type_ids` (cast `array`), `seating_mode` (cast `Konventix\Resources\Enums\SeatingMode`), `quantity`, `state` (cast `Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState {Unplaced, Placed, Released}`); `Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan` on `resource_plans` with `event_id`, `published_at` and `Plan::factory()`; `resources` columns `plan_id`, `ref`, `blocked`, `deleted_at` (`SoftDeletes`); `resource_bookings.claim_id`). `PickPlacesData` (S1) is consumed by the S5 controller, not by this slice.

**Slice constraints (in addition to the global ones):** every commit message ends in `(#S3)`; PHP only through `vendor/bin/sail`; tests only as `flock /home/mawiguko/git/konventix/konventix-poc/.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-10-seating/sail.lock vendor/bin/sail artisan test --compact <path-or-filter>`; never two test processes at once; `vendor/bin/sail composer verify` before every commit. Pest helpers that a second file calls live in `app-modules/resources/tests/Helpers.php` and are prefixed `seating`; helpers used by one file only stay in that file with a file-unique prefix. Console code in this slice (the artisan commands, the release listeners, every Action) runs without an ambient brand: `withoutBrandScope()` on every query level, `forceFill(['brand_id' => …])` on every create.

**Deviations recorded in the design doc §13 by this slice** (the executor appends them in the task that introduces them): one seating grant per type and per amendment (the unique key `(registration_id, amendment_id)` on `resource_claims` admits one claim per confirmation occasion, so a type that offers several categories lists them in that one grant's `resourceTypeIds`); an `operator` actor with a null user id is the trusted CLI path and skips the `BookOnBehalf` check.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Registration\Enums;

/**
 * What a single entry in a `RegistrationType`'s `grants` collection produces
 * once a registration confirms (ADR-0005, SPEC.md "Grant definitions").
 *
 * `Admission` grants are what `Konventix\Admission`'s listener reacts to
 * (one `Admission` row per unit of `quantity`). `ResourceClaim` grants are
 * fulfilled first-fit by Resources (one booking of `resourceTypeId`).
 * `Seating` grants (seating design §7.1) become a `resource_claims` row in
 * Resources that the registrant places on `quantity` places out of
 * `resourceTypeIds`, in `seatingMode`, after confirmation.
 */
enum GrantKind: string
{
    case Admission = 'admission';
    case ResourceClaim = 'resource_claim';
    case Seating = 'seating';
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Registration\Enums;

/**
 * How a `GrantKind::Seating` grant is placed (seating design §7.1).
 *
 * `Pick`: the registrant chooses in "Meine Registrierung". `Assign`: an
 * operator places the registration (console or `resources:assign-place`).
 * There is no `none` — a type that grants no seat carries no seating grant.
 *
 * Resources keeps a copy of these values in its own enum: the string is the
 * contract (ADR-0004), not the class.
 */
enum SeatingMode: string
{
    case Pick = 'pick';
    case Assign = 'assign';
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Registration\Data;

use Konventix\Registration\Enums\GrantKind;
use Konventix\Registration\Enums\SeatingMode;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\ArrayType;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\IntegerType;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\Min;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\Nullable;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\Required;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\StringType;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\Validation\Ulid;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Data;
use Spatie\TypeScriptTransformer\Attributes\TypeScript;

/**
 * One entry in a `RegistrationType`'s `grants` collection (ADR-0005, SPEC.md
 * "Grant definitions" — "how many admissions of which role, which resource
 * claims, and which seating a confirmed registration of a given type is
 * entitled to"). `RegistrationType::$grants` casts its JSON column to a
 * `Spatie\LaravelData\DataCollection` of these (ADR-0009 — a JSON column is
 * acceptable only behind a typed cast).
 *
 * `resourceTypeId` only applies to `GrantKind::ResourceClaim`;
 * `resourceTypeIds` and `seatingMode` only to `GrantKind::Seating`, where
 * `quantity` is the maximum number of places (seating design §7.1). All of
 * them are plain ULIDs (no FK) because Resources owns those entities
 * (ADR-0014). Which fields a kind needs is a cross-field rule and lives in
 * `Actions\Concerns\GuardsSeatingGrants`, not here.
 */
#[TypeScript]
final class GrantData extends Data
{
    /**
     * @param  list<string>|null  $resourceTypeIds
     */
    public function __construct(
        #[Required]
        public readonly GrantKind $kind,

        #[Required, StringType]
        public readonly string $role,

        #[Required, IntegerType, Min(1)]
        public readonly int $quantity,

        #[Nullable, Ulid]
        public readonly ?string $resourceTypeId = null,

        /** @var list<string>|null */
        #[Nullable, ArrayType]
        public readonly ?array $resourceTypeIds = null,

        #[Nullable]
        public readonly ?SeatingMode $seatingMode = null,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Only the element rule: laravel-data replaces the inferred ruleset for
     * every key this method returns (`RegistrationTypeData::rules()` explains
     * the trap), and `resourceTypeIds.*` has no inferred rules to lose.
     *
     * @return array<string, array<int, string>>
     */
    public static function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'resourceTypeIds.*' => ['ulid'],
        ];
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add the seating guard and wire it into both guards**

`app-modules/registration/src/Actions/Concerns/GuardsSeatingGrants.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Registration\Actions\Concerns;

use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Registration\Data\GrantData;
use Konventix\Registration\Enums\GrantKind;

/**
 * The cross-grant rules of a seating grant (seating design §7.1), shared by
 * `GuardsTypeConfiguration` (type create/update) and `AmendRegistration`
 * (a delta that adds a seating grant).
 *
 * - A seating grant names at least one category and a mode; without either
 *   the picker has nothing to offer and Resources could not build a claim.
 * - One seating grant per grant list. Resources keys its claims on
 *   `(registration_id, amendment_id)` — one per confirmation occasion — so
 *   a second grant would be silently dropped. Several categories are one
 *   grant with several `resourceTypeIds`.
 * - A category is either claimed first-fit (`resource_claim`) or offered for
 *   picking (`seating`), never both on the same type: the first-fit booking
 *   would take the very places the registrant is then asked to choose from.
 */
trait GuardsSeatingGrants
{
    /**
     * @param  list<GrantData>  $grants
     */
    private function guardSeatingGrants(array $grants): void
    {
        $seating = array_values(array_filter(
            $grants,
            fn (GrantData $grant): bool => $grant->kind === GrantKind::Seating,
        ));

        if ($seating === []) {
            return;
        }

        if (count($seating) > 1) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'grants' => __('A type carries at most one seating grant; list every category it may choose from in that grant.'),
            ]);
        }

        $grant = $seating[0];

        if ($grant->resourceTypeIds === null || $grant->resourceTypeIds === [] || $grant->seatingMode === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'grants' => __('A seating grant needs at least one category and a seating mode.'),
            ]);
        }

        foreach ($grants as $other) {
            if (
                $other->kind === GrantKind::ResourceClaim
                && $other->resourceTypeId !== null
                && in_array($other->resourceTypeId, $grant->resourceTypeIds, true)
            ) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'grants' => __('Category :id is both claimed first-fit and offered for seating; a category is one or the other.', [
                        'id' => $other->resourceTypeId,
                    ]),
                ]);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
    private function guardGrants(array $grants): void

            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Registration\Events;

/**
 * The type's `confirmation_gate` has been passed — the one event that
 * materializes entitlements (SPEC.md "Public contract" table). Emitted by
 * `Konventix\Registration\Actions\ConfirmRegistration`.
 *
 * `grants` is the scalar projection of `RegistrationType::$grants`
 * (`GrantData::toEventPayload()`): `Konventix\Admission`'s listener issues
 * one `Admission` per unit of `quantity` on every `kind: admission` entry,
 * Resources books `kind: resource_claim` entries first-fit and turns
 * `kind: seating` entries into seat claims — each using only this payload
 * (ADR-0004), never a `RegistrationType` model.
 *
 * `registrantUserId` is here for the seat claim: Resources authorises the
 * picker against it without ever reading a `Registration` row (seating
 * design §7.1).
 *
 * Per ADR-0026, a `settlement: free` registration never causes
 * `RegistrationSettlementRequested` to be emitted alongside this event.
 *
 * @phpstan-type GrantPayload array{kind: string, role: string, quantity: int, resource_type_id: string|null, resource_type_ids: list<string>|null, seating_mode: string|null}
 */
final class RegistrationConfirmed
{
    /**
     * @param  list<GrantPayload>  $grants
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $registrationId,
        public readonly string $registrationTypeId,
        public readonly string $eventId,
        public readonly string $brandId,
        public readonly string $registrantUserId,
        public readonly string $confirmedAt,
        public readonly array $grants,
    ) {}
}
```

If S0–S2 created `app-modules/resources/tests/Helpers.php`, append the functions below (merge the `use` lines at the top). Otherwise create the file with this content — `tests/Pest.php` requires every `app-modules/*/tests/Helpers.php` once per process, nothing else is needed:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Event\Events\EventCreated;
use Konventix\Identity\Models\User;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Permission as PermissionModel;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Role;
use Konventix\Registration\Events\RegistrationAmended;
use Konventix\Registration\Events\RegistrationConfirmed;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\Permission;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Helpers more than one file of this module's suite calls, prefixed
 * `seating` (seating design §10): Pest loads every module's Helpers.php in
 * every worker, and helper names are process-global (.ai/rules/tests.md).
 * Each takes the brand or its id rather than calling the protected
 * `withBrand()` on the TestCase.
 */
function seatingWindow(string $eventId, string $brandId): ResourceEventWindow
{
    event(new EventCreated(
        eventId: $eventId,
        brandId: $brandId,
        slug: 'e-'.Str::lower(Str::random(6)),
        name: 'Seating test event',
        startsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDay()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        endsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDays(3)->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        timezone: 'Europe/Berlin',
        predecessorEventId: null,
    ));

    return ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()->where('event_id', $eventId)->firstOrFail();
}

/**
 * A `kind: seating` grant in the payload shape of `RegistrationConfirmed`.
 *
 * @param  list<string>  $resourceTypeIds
 * @return array{kind: string, role: string, quantity: int, resource_type_id: string|null, resource_type_ids: list<string>|null, seating_mode: string|null}
 */
function seatingGrantPayload(array $resourceTypeIds, int $quantity = 1, string $seatingMode = 'pick'): array
{
    return [
        'kind' => 'seating',
        'role' => 'seat',
        'quantity' => $quantity,
        'resource_type_id' => null,
        'resource_type_ids' => $resourceTypeIds,
        'seating_mode' => $seatingMode,
    ];
}

/**
 * Dispatches a real `RegistrationConfirmed` so the module's real listener
 * wiring runs. Returns the registration id.
 *
 * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $grants
 */
function seatingConfirm(string $eventId, string $brandId, array $grants, ?string $registrationId = null, ?string $registrantUserId = null): string
{
    $registrationId ??= (string) Str::ulid();

    event(new RegistrationConfirmed(
        registrationId: $registrationId,
        registrationTypeId: (string) Str::ulid(),
        eventId: $eventId,
        brandId: $brandId,
        registrantUserId: $registrantUserId ?? (string) Str::ulid(),
        confirmedAt: now()->toIso8601String(),
        grants: $grants,
    ));

    return $registrationId;
}

/**
 * Dispatches a real `RegistrationAmended`. Returns the amendment id.
 *
 * @param  list<array<string, mixed>>  $grants
 */
function seatingAmend(string $eventId, string $brandId, string $registrationId, array $grants, ?string $amendmentId = null, ?string $registrantUserId = null): string
{
    $amendmentId ??= (string) Str::ulid();

    event(new RegistrationAmended(
        registrationId: $registrationId,
        amendmentId: $amendmentId,
        registrationTypeId: (string) Str::ulid(),
        eventId: $eventId,
        brandId: $brandId,
        registrantUserId: $registrantUserId ?? (string) Str::ulid(),
        grants: $grants,
        amendedAt: now()->toIso8601String(),
    ));

    return $amendmentId;
}

/**
 * The registration's claim from its original confirmation (no amendment).
 */
function seatingClaimFor(string $registrationId): ResourceClaim
{
    return ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
        ->where('registration_id', $registrationId)
        ->whereNull('amendment_id')
        ->sole();
}

function seatingPlan(string $eventId, bool $published = true): Plan
{
    return Plan::factory()->create([
        'event_id' => $eventId,
        'name' => 'Hall '.Str::upper(Str::random(4)),
        'width_mm' => 20000,
        'height_mm' => 10000,
        'published_at' => $published ? now() : null,
    ]);
}

/**
 * A place: a unit-mode resource projected from a plan (seating design §4.2).
 *
 * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
 */
function seatingPlace(Plan $plan, ResourceType $type, string $ref, array $attributes = []): Resource
{
    return Resource::factory()->ofType($type)->create(array_merge([
        'plan_id' => $plan->id,
        'ref' => $ref,
        'label' => $ref,
        'capacity' => 1,
        'is_published' => $plan->published_at !== null,
        'blocked' => false,
    ], $attributes));
}

/**
 * Runs an attempt that must be refused with a `ValidationException` and
 * hands back its errors, so a test asserts on the field and the text.
 *
 * @return array<string, array<int, string>>
 */
function seatingRefusal(Closure $attempt): array
{
    try {
        $attempt();
    } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
        return $exception->errors();
    }

    throw new RuntimeException('Expected a ValidationException and got none.');
}

/**
 * A user holding `resources.book-on-behalf` on the brand, granted the way
 * `permissions:sync` materialises it: a brand role plus a `model_has_roles`
 * row (the same shape `PermissionHoldersTest` uses).
 */
function seatingUserWithBookOnBehalf(string $brandId): User
{
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    PermissionModel::query()->firstOrCreate(['name' => Permission::BookOnBehalf->value, 'guard_name' => 'web']);

    $role = Role::query()->create([
        'name' => 'Seating desk '.Str::lower(Str::random(4)),
        'guard_name' => 'web',
        'brand_id' => $brandId,
    ]);
    $role->givePermissionTo([Permission::BookOnBehalf->value]);

    DB::table('model_has_roles')->insert([
        'role_id' => $role->id,
        'model_type' => $user->getMorphClass(),
        'model_id' => $user->id,
        'brand_id' => $brandId,
    ]);

    return $user;
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Konventix\Registration\Events\RegistrationCancelled;
use Konventix\Registration\Events\RegistrationRejected;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\SeatingMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\SeatClaimCreated;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\SeatClaimReleased;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * A confirmed registration's seating grant becomes a `resource_claims` row
 * (seating design §7.2, decision D-EVT-06: an unallocated claim needs its own
 * row, never a fake booking). Claims follow the registration out again on
 * cancellation and rejection.
 */
it('creates one unplaced claim for a seating grant on confirmation', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources');
    $eventId = (string) Str::ulid();
    seatingWindow($eventId, $brand->id);
    $type = ResourceType::factory()->forEvent($eventId)->create();
    $registrantId = (string) Str::ulid();

    Event::fake([SeatClaimCreated::class]);

    $registrationId = seatingConfirm($eventId, $brand->id, [
        ['kind' => 'admission', 'role' => 'visitor', 'quantity' => 1, 'resource_type_id' => null, 'resource_type_ids' => null, 'seating_mode' => null],
        seatingGrantPayload([$type->id], quantity: 2, seatingMode: 'pick'),
    ], registrantUserId: $registrantId);

    $claim = seatingClaimFor($registrationId);

    expect($claim->brand_id)->toBe($brand->id)
        ->and($claim->event_id)->toBe($eventId)
        ->and($claim->registrant_user_id)->toBe($registrantId)
        ->and($claim->resource_type_ids)->toBe([$type->id])
        ->and($claim->seating_mode)->toBe(SeatingMode::Pick)
        ->and($claim->quantity)->toBe(2)
        ->and($claim->state)->toBe(ClaimState::Unplaced)
        ->and(ResourceClaim::query()->count())->toBe(1);

    Event::assertDispatched(
        SeatClaimCreated::class,
        fn (SeatClaimCreated $event): bool => $event->claimId === $claim->id
            && $event->registrationId === $registrationId
            && $event->eventId === $eventId
            && $event->brandId === $brand->id,
    );
});

it('is idempotent when the confirmation is replayed', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources');
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The two Actions**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/CreateSeatClaims.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\SeatingMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\SeatClaimCreated;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * Turns a confirmed registration's `seating` grant into a `resource_claims`
 * row (seating design §7.2) — the Resources-owned snapshot of the
 * entitlement, `unplaced` until the registrant (or an operator) picks.
 *
 * Takes scalars, never Registration's classes: the thin listener unpacks the
 * event, the shape `FulfilResourceClaims` uses. `'seating'` is a literal,
 * the string is the contract (ADR-0004).
 *
 * Idempotent per confirmation occasion: `(registration_id, amendment_id)` is
 * unique on the table, so a replayed confirmation or amendment finds its
 * claim and adds none. The same key is why a payload with two seating grants
 * yields one claim — Registration's guard refuses such a type, and this
 * Action does not second-guess an older payload by inventing a second key.
 *
 * `brand_id` comes from the payload, not ambient context (ADR-0010): the
 * confirmation may arrive from a webhook or the scheduler with no brand.
 *
 * @phpstan-type Grant array{kind: string, role: string, quantity: int, resource_type_id: string|null, resource_type_ids?: list<string>|null, seating_mode?: string|null}
 */
final class CreateSeatClaims
{
    private const string SEATING_GRANT_KIND = 'seating';

    /**
     * @param  list<Grant>  $grants
     * @return list<ResourceClaim>
     */
    public function handle(
        string $registrationId,
        string $eventId,
        string $brandId,
        ?string $registrantUserId,
        array $grants,
        ?string $amendmentId = null,
    ): array {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($registrationId, $eventId, $brandId, $registrantUserId, $grants, $amendmentId): array {
            $created = [];

            foreach ($grants as $grant) {
                if ($grant['kind'] !== self::SEATING_GRANT_KIND) {
                    continue;
                }

                $resourceTypeIds = $grant['resource_type_ids'] ?? null;
                $seatingMode = $grant['seating_mode'] ?? null;

                if ($resourceTypeIds === null || $resourceTypeIds === [] || $seatingMode === null) {
                    // A payload older than the seating contract, or one the
                    // Registration guard should have refused. Nothing to
                    // pick from — skip rather than fail the confirmation.
                    continue;
                }

                $exists = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
                    ->where('brand_id', $brandId)
                    ->where('registration_id', $registrationId)
                    ->where('amendment_id', $amendmentId)
                    ->exists();

                if ($exists) {
                    continue;
                }

                $claim = new ResourceClaim([
                    'event_id' => $eventId,
                    'registration_id' => $registrationId,
                    'registrant_user_id' => $registrantUserId,
                    'amendment_id' => $amendmentId,
                    'resource_type_ids' => array_values($resourceTypeIds),
                    'seating_mode' => SeatingMode::from($seatingMode),
                    'quantity' => $grant['quantity'],
                    'state' => ClaimState::Unplaced,
                ]);
                $claim->forceFill(['brand_id' => $brandId])->save();

                event(new SeatClaimCreated(
                    claimId: $claim->id,
                    registrationId: $registrationId,
                    eventId: $eventId,
                    brandId: $brandId,
                ));

                $created[] = $claim;
            }

            return $created;
        });
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/ReleaseSeatClaims.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\SeatClaimReleased;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * Ends every live seat claim of a registration (seating design §7.2, §7.5):
 * cancellation and rejection take the entitlement away, so "Meine
 * Registrierung" must stop offering the picker. The claim's bookings are
 * released by the same listener through `ReleaseResourceBooking`; this
 * Action only moves the claim rows and says so.
 *
 * Idempotent — an already-released claim is skipped and emits nothing,
 * because a cancellation arriving twice is normal. Ungated on purpose, like
 * the booking release beside it (ADR-0060's explicit ADR-0003 exception):
 * giving something back is safe for a brand that switched the module off.
 *
 * `RegistrationCancelled` carries no brand id, so the lookup is by
 * registration id `withoutBrandScope()` — a registration ULID is unique
 * across brands.
 */
final class ReleaseSeatClaims
{
    public const string REASON_CANCELLED = 'registration_cancelled';

    public const string REASON_REJECTED = 'registration_rejected';

    /**
     * @return list<ResourceClaim>
     */
    public function handle(string $registrationId, string $reason): array
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($registrationId, $reason): array {
            $claims = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
                ->where('registration_id', $registrationId)
                ->whereIn('state', [ClaimState::Unplaced->value, ClaimState::Placed->value])
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get();

            foreach ($claims as $claim) {
                $claim->forceFill(['state' => ClaimState::Released])->save();

                event(new SeatClaimReleased(
                    claimId: $claim->id,
                    registrationId: $claim->registration_id,
                    eventId: $claim->event_id,
                    brandId: $claim->brand_id,
                    reason: $reason,
                ));
            }

            return $claims->all();
        });
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Listeners;

use Konventix\Platform\Modules\Concerns\ShortCircuitsInactiveModule;
use Konventix\Registration\Events\RegistrationConfirmed;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\CreateSeatClaims;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\FulfilResourceClaims;

/**
 * Materializes a confirmed registration's grants (seating design §7.2):
 * `resource_claim` grants become first-fit bookings, `seating` grants
 * become unplaced seat claims. Admission grants are Admission's business.
 *
 * Gated on the payload's brand rather than the ambient one: a paid type
 * confirms from Commerce's webhook, which runs without a brand in context.
 * A brand without Resources still registers people correctly — their claims
 * simply stay unfulfilled, and their seat claims are never created.
 */
final class FulfilClaimsOnRegistrationConfirmed
{
    use ShortCircuitsInactiveModule;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly FulfilResourceClaims $fulfil,
        private readonly CreateSeatClaims $createSeatClaims,
    ) {}

    protected function moduleName(): string
    {
        return 'resources';
    }

    public function handle(RegistrationConfirmed $event): void
    {
        if (! $this->moduleActiveForBrand($event->brandId)) {
            return;
        }

        $this->fulfil->handle(
            registrationId: $event->registrationId,
            eventId: $event->eventId,
            brandId: $event->brandId,
            grants: $event->grants,
        );

        $this->createSeatClaims->handle(
            registrationId: $event->registrationId,
            eventId: $event->eventId,
            brandId: $event->brandId,
            registrantUserId: $event->registrantUserId,
            grants: $event->grants,
        );
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Listeners;

use Konventix\Registration\Events\RegistrationCancelled;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ReleaseResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ReleaseSeatClaims;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;

/**
 * A cancelled registration gives everything back (seating design §7.2,
 * §7.5): every held or confirmed booking with reason
 * `registration_cancelled`, and every live seat claim.
 *
 * Deliberately ungated (ADR-0060's explicit ADR-0003 exception): a release
 * is safe and idempotent for a brand that switched the module off, and the
 * event carries no brand id to gate on anyway.
 */
final class ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationCancelled
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReleaseResourceBooking $release,
        private readonly ReleaseSeatClaims $releaseSeatClaims,
    ) {}

    public function handle(RegistrationCancelled $event): void
    {
        $bookings = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('registration_id', $event->registrationId)
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->get();

        foreach ($bookings as $booking) {
            $this->release->handle($booking, BookingState::Released, ReleaseSeatClaims::REASON_CANCELLED);
        }

        $this->releaseSeatClaims->handle($event->registrationId, ReleaseSeatClaims::REASON_CANCELLED);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;

use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Placing a seat claim (seating design §7.3): hold plus confirm per place in
 * one transaction, the exclusion constraint deciding races, every refusal a
 * `placeIds` validation error the picker can show.
 *
 * `assignTest*` helpers are used by this file only; the shared ones live in
 * tests/Helpers.php with the `seating` prefix (.ai/rules/tests.md).
 *
 * @return array{0: string, 1: ResourceType, 2: Plan}
 */
function assignTestScene(Brand $brand): array
{
    $eventId = (string) Str::ulid();
    seatingWindow($eventId, $brand->id);
    $type = ResourceType::factory()->forEvent($eventId)->create();
    $plan = seatingPlan($eventId);

    return [$eventId, $type, $plan];
}

function assignTestAction(): AssignPlacesToRegistration
{
    return app(AssignPlacesToRegistration::class);
}

it('places a claim: confirmed bookings, placed claim, event after commit', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources');
    [$eventId, $type, $plan] = assignTestScene($brand);
    $a1 = seatingPlace($plan, $type, 'A-01');
    $a2 = seatingPlace($plan, $type, 'A-02');
    $registrantId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $registrationId = seatingConfirm($eventId, $brand->id, [seatingGrantPayload([$type->id], quantity: 2)], registrantUserId: $registrantId);
    $claim = seatingClaimFor($registrationId);

    Event::fake([SeatClaimPlaced::class]);

    $bookings = assignTestAction()->handle($claim, [$a2->id, $a1->id, $a1->id], AssignPlacesToRegistration::ACTOR_REGISTRANT, $registrantId);

    $window = ResourceEventWindow::forEvent($brand->id, $eventId);

    expect($bookings)->toHaveCount(2)
        ->and($bookings[0]->state)->toBe(BookingState::Confirmed)
        ->and($bookings[0]->holder_type)->toBe(ResourceBooking::HOLDER_REGISTRATION)
        ->and($bookings[0]->holder_id)->toBe($registrationId)
        ->and($bookings[0]->registration_id)->toBe($registrationId)
        ->and($bookings[0]->claim_id)->toBe($claim->id)
        ->and($bookings[0]->quantity)->toBe(1)
        ->and($bookings[0]->starts_at->equalTo($window->starts_at))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($bookings[0]->ends_at->equalTo($window->ends_at))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(collect($bookings)->pluck('resource_id')->sort()->values()->all())->toBe(collect([$a1->id, $a2->id])->sort()->values()->all())
        ->and($claim->fresh()->state)->toBe(ClaimState::Placed);

    Event::assertDispatched(
        SeatClaimPlaced::class,
        fn (SeatClaimPlaced $event): bool => $event->claimId === $claim->id
            && $event->registrationId === $registrationId
            && $event->eventId === $eventId
            && $event->brandId === $brand->id
            && $event->placeIds === collect([$a1->id, $a2->id])->sort()->values()->all(),
    );
});

it('maps a deadlock and an exclusion violation to the same refusal', function (): void {
    // A real deadlock needs two connections; the constraint path is proven

    $failure = fn (string $sqlState): QueryException => new QueryException(
        'pgsql',
        'insert into "resource_bookings"',
        [],
        new class('simulated', $sqlState) extends PDOException
        {
            public function __construct(string $message, string $sqlState)
            {
                parent::__construct($message);
                $this->code = $sqlState;
            }
        },
    );

    expect(AssignPlacesToRegistration::isRaceFailure($failure('23P01')))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(AssignPlacesToRegistration::isRaceFailure($failure('40P01')))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(AssignPlacesToRegistration::isRaceFailure($failure('23505')))->toBeFalse();
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the Action**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/AssignPlacesToRegistration.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Konventix\Platform\Permissions\PermissionHolders;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\Permission;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\SeatClaimPlaced;
use Konventix\Resources\Exceptions\ResourceUnavailableException;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;

/**
 * Places a seat claim on concrete places (seating design §7.3) — the one
 * pick path, used by the picker's controller, the console reseat and
 * `resources:assign-place`.
 *
 * One transaction: the claim row is locked `FOR UPDATE` so two picks for the
 * same claim serialise; the claim's live bookings are released first
 * (reason `repicked`) so picking the same place again is not a self-collision;
 * then, per place, `HoldResourceBooking` immediately followed by
 * `ConfirmResourceBooking` — the seat booking is never a clocked hold, it is
 * firm the moment the transaction commits (ADR-0060's second hold kind).
 *
 * **Who wins a race is the database's call.** The exclusion constraint
 * (ADR-0020) refuses the loser's insert with `23P01`; a lock cycle between
 * two pickers ends in `40P01`. Both surface here as a `placeIds` validation
 * error naming the place, and the loser's transaction rolls back whole —
 * no booking, claim still `unplaced`. `placeIds` are sorted and de-duplicated
 * before locking so two pickers touching the same two places lock them in
 * the same order.
 *
 * Eligibility is a query over the projection, never over the plan document
 * (seating design §6.2): a place is a non-deleted, non-blocked `resources`
 * row of a *published* plan of the claim's event whose category is one the
 * claim may choose.
 *
 * Actors: `registrant` must own the claim (`registrant_user_id`);
 * `operator` with a user id needs `resources.book-on-behalf` on the brand
 * (checked through Platform's `PermissionHolders`, so this module imports no
 * User model — ADR-0004); `operator` with a null user id is the trusted CLI
 * path (`resources:assign-place`), recorded in the design's §13.
 *
 * `SeatClaimPlaced` is dispatched after the transaction returned. The
 * booking Actions dispatch their own events inside it, as they always have.
 */
final class AssignPlacesToRegistration
{
    public const string ACTOR_REGISTRANT = 'registrant';

    public const string ACTOR_OPERATOR = 'operator';

    public const string REASON_REPICKED = 'repicked';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly HoldResourceBooking $hold,
        private readonly ConfirmResourceBooking $confirm,
        private readonly ReleaseResourceBooking $release,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $placeIds
     * @return list<ResourceBooking>
     *
     * @throws ValidationException keyed `placeIds`
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function handle(ResourceClaim $claim, array $placeIds, string $actorType, ?string $actorUserId): array
    {
        $this->guardActor($claim, $actorType, $actorUserId);

        $placeIds = array_values(array_unique($placeIds));
        sort($placeIds);

        $bookings = DB::transaction(function () use ($claim, $placeIds): array {
            $locked = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
                ->whereKey($claim->getKey())
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->firstOrFail();

            if ($locked->state === ClaimState::Released) {
                throw $this->refuse(__('This registration no longer holds a seat claim.'));
            }

            if ($placeIds === []) {
                throw $this->refuse(__('Choose at least one place.'));
            }

            if (count($placeIds) > $locked->quantity) {
                throw $this->refuse(__('You may choose at most :count place(s).', ['count' => $locked->quantity]));
            }

            $places = $this->eligiblePlaces($locked, $placeIds);
            $ineligible = array_values(array_diff($placeIds, array_keys($places)));

            if ($ineligible !== []) {
                throw $this->refuse(__('Place :ref is not available for this registration.', [
                    'ref' => $this->refOf($ineligible[0]),
                ]));
            }

            $window = ResourceEventWindow::forEvent($locked->brand_id, $locked->event_id);

            if ($window === null) {
                throw $this->refuse(__('The event window is not projected yet; please try again later.'));
            }

            $this->releaseCurrentBookings($locked);

            $created = [];

            foreach ($placeIds as $placeId) {
                $place = $places[$placeId];

                try {
                    $booking = $this->hold->handle(
                        resource: $place,
                        holderType: ResourceBooking::HOLDER_REGISTRATION,
                        holderId: $locked->registration_id,
                        startsAt: $window->starts_at,
                        endsAt: $window->ends_at,
                        quantity: 1,
                        registrationId: $locked->registration_id,
                        claimId: $locked->id,
                    );

                    $created[] = $this->confirm->handle($booking);
                } catch (ResourceUnavailableException) {
                    throw $this->taken($place);
                } catch (QueryException $exception) {
                    if (self::isRaceFailure($exception)) {
                        throw $this->taken($place);
                    }

                    throw $exception;
                }
            }

            $locked->forceFill(['state' => ClaimState::Placed])->save();

            // Refresh the caller's instance so it reads what was written.
            $claim->setRawAttributes($locked->getAttributes(), true);

            return $created;
        });

        event(new SeatClaimPlaced(
            claimId: $claim->id,
            registrationId: $claim->registration_id,
            eventId: $claim->event_id,
            brandId: $claim->brand_id,
            placeIds: $placeIds,
        ));

        // Confirm returned refreshed rows; hand them back as a list.
        return array_values($bookings);
    }

    /**
     * The two SQLSTATEs a lost race produces: `23P01` (exclusion violation)
     * and `40P01` (deadlock). `HoldResourceBooking` already converts the
     * first into `ResourceUnavailableException` when it sees it; this
     * catches the constraint name too, for a driver that reports the code
     * differently, and the deadlock the Action itself never sees.
     */
    public static function isRaceFailure(QueryException $exception): bool
    {
        $code = (string) $exception->getCode();

        return $code === '23P01'
            || $code === '40P01'
            || str_contains($exception->getMessage(), 'resource_bookings_no_overlap');
    }

    private function guardActor(ResourceClaim $claim, string $actorType, ?string $actorUserId): void
    {
        if ($actorType === self::ACTOR_REGISTRANT) {
            if ($actorUserId === null || $claim->registrant_user_id !== $actorUserId) {
                throw new AuthorizationException('This seat claim belongs to another registrant.');
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($actorType === self::ACTOR_OPERATOR) {
            if ($actorUserId === null) {
                // The console command: no user behind it, trusted by being
                // able to run artisan at all (seating design §13).
                return;
            }

            $holders = app(PermissionHolders::class)
                ->userIdsWithPermission($claim->brand_id, Permission::BookOnBehalf->value);

            if (! in_array($actorUserId, $holders, true)) {
                throw new AuthorizationException(sprintf(
                    'Placing on behalf of a registration needs %s.',
                    Permission::BookOnBehalf->value,
                ));
            }

            return;
        }

        throw new InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Unknown actor type [%s].', $actorType));
    }

    /**
     * The requested places that this claim may actually take, keyed by id.
     * Anything the query drops is ineligible for one of the listed reasons;
     * the caller reports the first missing one by ref.
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $placeIds
     * @return array<string, Resource>
     */
    private function eligiblePlaces(ResourceClaim $claim, array $placeIds): array
    {
        $places = Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->select('resources.*')
            ->join('resource_plans', 'resource_plans.id', '=', 'resources.plan_id')
            ->where('resources.brand_id', $claim->brand_id)
            ->whereIn('resources.id', $placeIds)
            ->whereNull('resources.deleted_at')
            ->where('resources.blocked', false)
            ->whereIn('resources.resource_type_id', $claim->resource_type_ids)
            ->where('resource_plans.event_id', $claim->event_id)
            ->whereNotNull('resource_plans.published_at')
            ->get();

        return $places->keyBy('id')->all();
    }

    /**
     * Every live booking this claim holds goes back before the new set is
     * taken (seating design §7.5 "Registrant re-picks"). Inside the same
     * transaction, so a refused re-pick leaves the old places in place.
     */
    private function releaseCurrentBookings(ResourceClaim $claim): void
    {
        $active = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('claim_id', $claim->id)
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->get();

        foreach ($active as $booking) {
            $this->release->handle($booking, BookingState::Released, self::REASON_REPICKED);
        }
    }

    private function taken(Resource $place): ValidationException
    {
        return $this->refuse(__('Place :ref has just been taken by someone else.', [
            'ref' => $place->ref ?? $place->label,
        ]));
    }

    private function refuse(string $message): ValidationException
    {
        return ValidationException::withMessages(['placeIds' => $message]);
    }

    /**
     * The human key of a place the claim may not take, for the error text —
     * or the id when the row is gone.
     */
    private function refOf(string $placeId): string
    {
        $place = Resource::withoutBrandScope()->whereKey($placeId)->first();

        return $place?->ref ?? $place?->label ?? $placeId;
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Console;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\AssignPlacesToRegistration;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * The operator's headless pick (seating design §7.3, Q6): places a
 * registration's live seat claim on places named by ref, through the same
 * `AssignPlacesToRegistration` the picker uses. Nothing here is a second
 * booking path.
 *
 * Runs as the `operator` actor with no user id: there is no signed-in user
 * behind an artisan call, and being able to run artisan at all is the
 * trust boundary — the `BookOnBehalf` check applies to the console UI, not
 * here (recorded in the design's §13). No brand in context, so every query
 * is `withoutBrandScope()`; `--brand` narrows when the same registration id
 * should ever appear under two brands (it cannot, ULIDs are unique, but the
 * option makes the intent explicit on a shared dev database).
 *
 * A ref is unique per plan, not per event: when the event has two published
 * plans with the same ref the command refuses rather than guessing.
 */
final class AssignPlaceCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'resources:assign-place
        {registration : Registration ULID whose seat claim is placed}
        {refs* : Place refs from the plan, one per place (e.g. A-01 A-02)}
        {--brand= : Brand ULID, to narrow the claim lookup}';

    protected $description = 'Place a registration\'s seat claim on places named by ref, as the operator (Resources).';

    public function handle(AssignPlacesToRegistration $assignPlaces): int
    {
        $registrationId = (string) $this->argument('registration');
        /** @var list<string> $refs */
        $refs = array_values(array_unique(array_map('strval', (array) $this->argument('refs'))));
        $brandId = $this->option('brand');

        $claim = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('registration_id', $registrationId)
            ->when(is_string($brandId) && $brandId !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where('brand_id', $brandId))
            ->whereIn('state', [ClaimState::Unplaced->value, ClaimState::Placed->value])
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->first();

        if ($claim === null) {
            $this->components->error(sprintf('Registration [%s] has no live seat claim.', $registrationId));

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $places = $this->placesByRef($claim, $refs);

        $missing = array_values(array_diff($refs, $places->keys()->all()));

        if ($missing !== []) {
            $this->components->error(sprintf('No place with ref %s on a published plan of event [%s].', implode(', ', $missing), $claim->event_id));

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $ambiguous = $places->filter(fn (Collection $rows): bool => $rows->count() > 1)->keys()->all();

        if ($ambiguous !== []) {
            $this->components->error(sprintf('Ref %s is ambiguous: it exists on more than one published plan of the event. Use the plan editor for this one.', implode(', ', $ambiguous)));

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        /** @var list<string> $placeIds */
        $placeIds = $places->map(fn (Collection $rows): string => (string) $rows->first()->id)->values()->all();

        try {
            $bookings = $assignPlaces->handle($claim, $placeIds, AssignPlacesToRegistration::ACTOR_OPERATOR, null);
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            foreach ($exception->errors() as $messages) {
                foreach ($messages as $message) {
                    $this->components->error($message);
                }
            }

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $this->components->info(sprintf(
            'Placed registration %s on %s (claim %s).',
            $registrationId,
            implode(', ', array_map(fn ($booking): string => (string) ($booking->resource()->withoutGlobalScopes()->value('ref') ?? $booking->resource_id), $bookings)),
            $claim->id,
        ));

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    /**
     * The event's published places carrying one of the refs, grouped by
     * ref so ambiguity is visible.
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $refs
     * @return Collection<string, Collection<int, Resource>>
     */
    private function placesByRef(ResourceClaim $claim, array $refs): Collection
    {
        return Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->select('resources.*')
            ->join('resource_plans', 'resource_plans.id', '=', 'resources.plan_id')
            ->where('resources.brand_id', $claim->brand_id)
            ->whereNull('resources.deleted_at')
            ->whereIn('resources.ref', $refs)
            ->where('resource_plans.event_id', $claim->event_id)
            ->whereNotNull('resource_plans.published_at')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('ref');
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabaseState;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * The concurrency half of the seat picker (seating design §11, optional):
 * Pest is single-threaded and cannot make two picks actually race, so
 * `resources:probe-seat-race` spawns real processes and this test runs it,
 * the way `InvoiceNumberingProbeTest` runs `commerce:probe-invoice-numbering`.
 */
beforeEach(function (): void {
    // Leave RefreshDatabase's transaction so the children, on their own PDO
    // handles, see the rows this test creates (.ai/rules/tests.md).
    DB::rollBack();
});

afterEach(function (): void {
    RefreshDatabaseState::$migrated = false;
});

it('proves that parallel picks of one place have exactly one winner', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = (string) Str::ulid();
    seatingWindow($eventId, $brand->id);
    $type = ResourceType::factory()->forEvent($eventId)->create();
    $place = seatingPlace(seatingPlan($eventId), $type, 'R-01');

    $exit = Artisan::call('resources:probe-seat-race', [
        'place' => $place->id,
        '--workers' => 3,
    ]);

    expect($exit)->toBe(0)
        ->and(Artisan::output())->toContain('exactly one winner');

    // Without --keep the probe cleans up: the winner's booking is released
    // and the probe claims are closed.
    expect(ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()->where('resource_id', $place->id)->where('state', BookingState::Confirmed->value)->count())->toBe(0)
        ->and(ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()->where('resource_id', $place->id)->where('state', BookingState::Released->value)->count())->toBe(1)
        ->and(ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()->where('event_id', $eventId)->where('state', ClaimState::Released->value)->count())->toBe(3);
});

it('fails loudly for a place that does not exist', function (): void {
    $exit = Artisan::call('resources:probe-seat-race', [
        'place' => '01JZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ',
        '--workers' => 1,
    ]);

    expect($exit)->not->toBe(0)
        ->and(ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()->count())->toBe(0);
});
```
