- [ ] **Step 3: The command**

`app-modules/resources/src/Console/ProbeSeatRace.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Console;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Platform\Environment\DeploymentEnvironment;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\AssignPlacesToRegistration;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ReleaseResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\SeatingMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Symfony\Component\Process\Exception\ProcessTimedOutException;
use Symfony\Component\Process\Process;

/**
 * Proves, by actually racing processes, that N parallel picks of one place
 * end with exactly one confirmed booking — the property the seat picker
 * rests on (ADR-0020's exclusion constraint, seating design §7.3).
 *
 * Why a command and not a Pest test alone: Pest runs single-threaded inside
 * one transaction and can never have two picks contend; real contention
 * needs real processes on their own connections. It is also the shape an
 * operator can point at the dev cluster by hand. The pattern is
 * `commerce:probe-invoice-numbering`, and `SeatRaceProbeTest` runs it in CI.
 *
 * The probe writes real claim and booking rows for the place it is given —
 * that is the point — so it refuses production (ADR-0053) and, unless
 * `--keep`, releases the winner's booking and closes its claims afterwards.
 */
final class ProbeSeatRace extends Command
{
    private const float WORKER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 60.0;

    protected $signature = 'resources:probe-seat-race
        {place : ULID of a published place (resources row) the workers race for}
        {--workers=4 : Child processes picking in parallel}
        {--timeout= : Seconds a child may run before the probe gives up on it (default 60)}
        {--keep : Leave the winner\'s booking and the probe claims in place}
        {--worker : Internal — run as one child}
        {--claim= : Internal — the claim the child picks with}';

    protected $description = 'Prove that parallel picks of one place have exactly one winner — writes real rows, never run on production (Resources).';

    public function handle(DeploymentEnvironment $environment, AssignPlacesToRegistration $assignPlaces, ReleaseResourceBooking $release): int
    {
        if ($environment->isProduction()) {
            $this->components->error('Refusing to run on production: the probe books a real place (ADR-0053).');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $placeId = (string) $this->argument('place');

        if ($this->option('worker')) {
            return $this->runAsWorker($assignPlaces, $placeId, (string) $this->option('claim'));
        }

        return $this->runAsParent($release, $placeId, max(1, (int) $this->option('workers')));
    }

    /**
     * One child: one pick, one word on stdout — `won` or `lost` — which the
     * parent parses. Nothing else is printed.
     */
    private function runAsWorker(AssignPlacesToRegistration $assignPlaces, string $placeId, string $claimId): int
    {
        $claim = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()->whereKey($claimId)->firstOrFail();

        try {
            $assignPlaces->handle($claim, [$placeId], AssignPlacesToRegistration::ACTOR_OPERATOR, null);
            $this->output->writeln('won');
        } catch (ValidationException) {
            $this->output->writeln('lost');
        }

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function runAsParent(ReleaseResourceBooking $release, string $placeId, int $workers): int
    {
        $place = Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->select('resources.*', 'resource_plans.event_id as plan_event_id', 'resource_plans.published_at as plan_published_at')
            ->join('resource_plans', 'resource_plans.id', '=', 'resources.plan_id')
            ->whereKey($placeId)
            ->first();

        if ($place === null || $place->getAttribute('plan_published_at') === null) {
            $this->components->error(sprintf('No published place [%s]. Pass the ULID of a resources row on a published plan.', $placeId));

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $eventId = (string) $place->getAttribute('plan_event_id');
        $claimIds = $this->createClaims($place, $eventId, $workers);

        $this->components->info(sprintf('Racing %d worker(s) for place %s (%s) of event %s.', $workers, $place->ref ?? $place->label, $placeId, $eventId));

        $timeout = (float) ($this->option('timeout') ?: self::WORKER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS);
        [$results, $failures] = $this->runWorkers($placeId, $claimIds, $timeout);

        $won = count(array_filter($results, fn (string $result): bool => $result === 'won'));
        $lost = count(array_filter($results, fn (string $result): bool => $result === 'lost'));
        $confirmed = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('resource_id', $placeId)
            ->whereIn('claim_id', $claimIds)
            ->where('state', BookingState::Confirmed->value)
            ->count();
        $placed = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()->whereIn('id', $claimIds)->where('state', ClaimState::Placed->value)->count();

        foreach ([
            sprintf('%d worker(s) exited 0', $workers) => $failures === [],
            'exactly one winner' => $won === 1,
            sprintf('%d loser(s)', $workers - 1) => $lost === $workers - 1,
            'one confirmed booking on the place' => $confirmed === 1,
            'one claim placed' => $placed === 1,
        ] as $label => $held) {
            $this->components->twoColumnDetail($label, $held ? '<fg=green>ok</>' : '<fg=red>FAILED</>');
        }

        foreach ($failures as $failure) {
            $this->components->error($failure);
        }

        if (! $this->option('keep')) {
            $this->cleanUp($release, $placeId, $claimIds);
        }

        return ($failures === [] && $won === 1 && $lost === $workers - 1 && $confirmed === 1 && $placed === 1)
            ? self::SUCCESS
            : self::FAILURE;
    }

    /**
     * One `assign`-mode claim per worker on fictitious registrations, all
     * eligible for the place's category. Committed before the children
     * start: the parent runs outside any transaction.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function createClaims(Resource $place, string $eventId, int $workers): array
    {
        $ids = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < $workers; $i++) {
            $claim = new ResourceClaim([
                'event_id' => $eventId,
                'registration_id' => (string) Str::ulid(),
                'registrant_user_id' => null,
                'amendment_id' => null,
                'resource_type_ids' => [$place->resource_type_id],
                'seating_mode' => SeatingMode::Assign,
                'quantity' => 1,
                'state' => ClaimState::Unplaced,
            ]);
            $claim->forceFill(['brand_id' => $place->brand_id])->save();

            $ids[] = $claim->id;
        }

        return $ids;
    }

    /**
     * Starts every child at once — they have to overlap for the probe to
     * mean anything — with this process's own database configuration as
     * explicit environment (a child reading `.env` under the test runner
     * would probe the dev database and prove nothing). A child that hangs is
     * reported, not thrown: a lock nobody released is exactly what this
     * probe hunts.
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $claimIds
     * @return array{0: list<string>, 1: list<string>}
     */
    private function runWorkers(string $placeId, array $claimIds, float $timeout): array
    {
        $environment = $this->childEnvironment();

        /** @var list<Process> $processes */
        $processes = [];

        foreach ($claimIds as $claimId) {
            $process = new Process([
                PHP_BINARY,
                base_path('artisan'),
                'resources:probe-seat-race',
                $placeId,
                '--worker',
                '--claim='.$claimId,
            ], base_path(), $environment, null, $timeout);

            $process->start();

            $processes[] = $process;
        }

        $results = [];
        $failures = [];

        foreach ($processes as $worker => $process) {
            try {
                $process->wait();
            } catch (ProcessTimedOutException) {
                $failures[] = sprintf('Worker %d timed out after %ss', $worker, $timeout);

                continue;
            }

            if (! $process->isSuccessful()) {
                $failures[] = sprintf(
                    'Worker %d exited %s: %s',
                    $worker,
                    var_export($process->getExitCode(), true),
                    trim($process->getErrorOutput().' '.$process->getOutput()),
                );

                continue;
            }

            $results[] = trim($process->getOutput());
        }

        return [$results, $failures];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function childEnvironment(): array
    {
        $connection = (string) config('database.default');

        /** @var array<string, mixed> $settings */
        $settings = (array) config('database.connections.'.$connection);

        return [
            'APP_ENV' => (string) config('app.env'),
            'DB_CONNECTION' => $connection,
            // Blank rather than absent: an inherited DB_URL would outrank
            // every setting below (ConfigurationUrlParser wins over the parts).
            'DB_URL' => '',
            'DB_HOST' => (string) ($settings['host'] ?? ''),
            'DB_PORT' => (string) ($settings['port'] ?? ''),
            'DB_DATABASE' => (string) ($settings['database'] ?? ''),
            'DB_USERNAME' => (string) ($settings['username'] ?? ''),
            'DB_PASSWORD' => (string) ($settings['password'] ?? ''),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Gives the place back and closes the probe claims, so a dev plan is not
     * left with a phantom occupant. Through `ReleaseResourceBooking` like
     * every other release — never a direct write to `resource_bookings`.
     *
     * @param  list<string>  $claimIds
     */
    private function cleanUp(ReleaseResourceBooking $release, string $placeId, array $claimIds): void
    {
        $bookings = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('resource_id', $placeId)
            ->whereIn('claim_id', $claimIds)
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->get();

        foreach ($bookings as $booking) {
            $release->handle($booking, BookingState::Released, 'operator_released');
        }

        ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
            ->whereIn('id', $claimIds)
            ->update(['state' => ClaimState::Released->value]);

        $this->components->info('Cleaned up: winner booking released, probe claims closed (pass --keep to inspect them instead).');
    }
}
```

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Enums;

/**
 * Resources' capability catalogue (ADR-0013), picked up by
 * `permissions:sync`.
 *
 * `ManagePlans` is the seating console (design §8.2): creating, importing,
 * publishing and editing hall plans. Reservations on a plan's places are
 * `BookOnBehalf`, because an orga reservation is a booking like any other
 * (design §7.3); releasing one is `ReleaseBookings`.
 */
enum Permission: string
{
    case ViewResources = 'resources.view-resources';
    case ManageResourceTypes = 'resources.manage-resource-types';
    case ManageResources = 'resources.manage-resources';
    case ManagePlans = 'resources.manage-plans';
    case BookOnBehalf = 'resources.book-on-behalf';
    case ReleaseBookings = 'resources.release-bookings';
}

    public function defaultRoles(): array

    }

- [ ] **Step 5: The shared helpers**

`app-modules/resources/tests/Helpers.php` — create it with this content, or, if S1–S3 already created the file, append the three functions below to it (keep the existing header docblock and functions):

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Konventix\Event\Events\EventCreated;
use Konventix\Identity\Models\User;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Brand;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Operator;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Permission as PermissionModel;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Role;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Helpers that more than one file of this module's suite calls. Loaded by
 * tests/Pest.php for every worker of a parallel run — a function declared
 * inside a *Test.php file exists only in the process that loaded that
 * file, and names stay process-global across modules, hence the `seating`
 * prefix (.ai/rules/tests.md, design §10).
 */

/**
 * An operator admin on its own admin host with the given capabilities.
 * The pattern is `registrationTypeOperator()` in Registration's suite;
 * the host differs so the two suites never share a unique `admin_host`.
 *
 * @param  list<string>  $permissions
 * @return array{0: Operator, 1: User}
 */
function seatingOperator(array $permissions = [
    'platform.access-admin',
    'resources.manage-resource-types',
    'resources.manage-plans',
    'resources.book-on-behalf',
]): array
{
    $operator = Operator::factory()->create();
    $operator->forceFill(['admin_host' => 'admin.seating.test'])->save();

    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($operator->getKey());

    foreach ($permissions as $name) {
        PermissionModel::query()->firstOrCreate(['name' => $name, 'guard_name' => 'web']);
    }

    $role = Role::query()->create([
        'name' => 'Operator Admin',
        'guard_name' => 'web',
        'brand_id' => $operator->getKey(),
    ]);
    $role->givePermissionTo($permissions);

    $admin = User::factory()->create();
    $admin->assignRole($role);

    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$operator, $admin];
}

/**
 * Projects an event window (with name and slug, design §4.7) by firing
 * Event's contract event — the only way this module may learn about an
 * event (ADR-0004). Takes the brand rather than creating it: a plain Pest
 * helper cannot call the protected `withBrand()` (.ai/rules/tests.md).
 */
function seatingEventWindow(Brand $brand, string $name = 'SXLan 2027', ?string $eventId = null): string
{
    $eventId ??= (string) Str::ulid();

    event(new EventCreated(
        eventId: $eventId,
        brandId: $brand->getKey(),
        slug: Str::slug($name).'-'.Str::lower(Str::random(4)),
        name: $name,
        startsAt: '2027-05-14 18:00:00',
        endsAt: '2027-05-16 14:00:00',
        timezone: 'Europe/Berlin',
        predecessorEventId: null,
    ));

    return $eventId;
}

/**
 * A minimal valid `konventix.plan/v1` document (design §5): one group with
 * `$places` places of the given category, refs `A-01`…, so an import or a
 * save has something structurally complete to accept.
 *
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function seatingPlanDocument(string $resourceTypeId, int $places = 2): array
{
    $groupId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $elements = [[
        'id' => $groupId,
        'kind' => 'group',
        'parentId' => null,
        'ref' => 'A',
        'label' => 'A',
        'layer' => 'default',
        'x' => 1000,
        'y' => 1000,
        'rotation' => 0,
        'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 800 * $places, 'h' => 800],
        'locked' => false,
    ]];

    for ($n = 1; $n <= $places; $n++) {
        $elements[] = [
            'id' => (string) Str::ulid(),
            'kind' => 'place',
            'parentId' => $groupId,
            'ref' => sprintf('A-%02d', $n),
            'label' => sprintf('A-%02d', $n),
            'layer' => 'default',
            'x' => 800 * ($n - 1),
            'y' => 0,
            'rotation' => 0,
            'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 800, 'h' => 800],
            'locked' => false,
            'resourceTypeId' => $resourceTypeId,
            'accessible' => false,
            'detached' => false,
            'blocked' => false,
        ];
    }

    return ['schema' => 'konventix.plan/v1', 'elements' => $elements];
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The identity guard shared by both Actions**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/Concerns/GuardsResourceTypeIdentity.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions\Concerns;

use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * What makes a category *the* category of an event: the event must be one
 * this module knows for that brand (its window is projected, ADR-0004 —
 * there is no other way to check an event id without reading Event's
 * tables), and the slug is unique per brand and event
 * (`resource_types` unique index; refused here so the operator sees a
 * field error rather than a 500 from the constraint).
 *
 * Both Actions run on the admin host with no brand in context, so every
 * query escapes the scope explicitly and filters by the brand id it was
 * handed (ADR-0029, .ai/rules/app-modules-src.md).
 */
trait GuardsResourceTypeIdentity
{
    private function guardEvent(string $brandId, string $eventId): void
    {
        if (ResourceEventWindow::forEvent($brandId, $eventId) === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'eventId' => __('Resources does not know this event for the brand yet.'),
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function guardSlug(string $brandId, string $eventId, string $slug, ?string $exceptId = null): void
    {
        $taken = ResourceType::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('brand_id', $brandId)
            ->where('event_id', $eventId)
            ->where('slug', $slug)
            ->when($exceptId !== null, fn ($query) => $query->whereKeyNot($exceptId))
            ->exists();

        if ($taken) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'slug' => __('Another category of this event already uses this slug.'),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The two Actions**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/CreateResourceType.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\Concerns\GuardsResourceTypeIdentity;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\ResourceTypeData;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Creates a category (design §4.1) from the console. The brand comes from
 * the request, not from context: the admin host resolves none (ADR-0029),
 * so `brand_id` is force-filled before the save and `BelongsToBrand`'s
 * creating hook finds it already set.
 */
final class CreateResourceType
{
    use GuardsResourceTypeIdentity;

    public function handle(string $brandId, ResourceTypeData $data): ResourceType
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($brandId, $data): ResourceType {
            $this->guardEvent($brandId, $data->eventId);
            $this->guardSlug($brandId, $data->eventId, $data->slug);

            $type = new ResourceType;
            $type->forceFill([
                'brand_id' => $brandId,
                'event_id' => $data->eventId,
                'name' => $data->name,
                'slug' => $data->slug,
                'mode' => $data->mode,
                'hold_minutes' => $data->holdMinutes,
                'description' => $data->description,
                'token' => $data->token,
                'symbol' => $data->symbol,
                'sort_order' => $data->sortOrder,
                'default_shape' => $data->defaultShape,
            ])->save();

            return $type;
        });
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/UpdateResourceType.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\Concerns\GuardsResourceTypeIdentity;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\ResourceTypeData;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Edits a category. The event is frozen once the category has places: a
 * place belongs to a plan of one event, and moving its category to another
 * event would leave the plan's projection pointing across events. The
 * capacity mode is frozen for the same reason — the exclusion constraint's
 * `is_exclusive` is denormalised from it onto every booking (ADR-0034).
 */
final class UpdateResourceType
{
    use GuardsResourceTypeIdentity;

    public function handle(ResourceType $type, ResourceTypeData $data): ResourceType
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($type, $data): ResourceType {
            $this->guardEvent($type->brand_id, $data->eventId);
            $this->guardSlug($type->brand_id, $data->eventId, $data->slug, exceptId: (string) $type->getKey());
            $this->guardFrozenAxes($type, $data);

            $type->forceFill([
                'event_id' => $data->eventId,
                'name' => $data->name,
                'slug' => $data->slug,
                'mode' => $data->mode,
                'hold_minutes' => $data->holdMinutes,
                'description' => $data->description,
                'token' => $data->token,
                'symbol' => $data->symbol,
                'sort_order' => $data->sortOrder,
                'default_shape' => $data->defaultShape,
            ])->save();

            return $type;
        });
    }

    private function guardFrozenAxes(ResourceType $type, ResourceTypeData $data): void
    {
        $hasPlaces = Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('resource_type_id', $type->getKey())
            ->exists();

        if (! $hasPlaces) {
            return;
        }

        $errors = [];

        if ($type->event_id !== $data->eventId) {
            $errors['eventId'] = __('This category already has places; it stays with its event.');
        }

        if ($type->mode !== $data->mode) {
            $errors['mode'] = __('This category already has places; its capacity mode is frozen.');
        }

        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The controller**

`app-modules/resources/src/Http/Controllers/Admin/ResourceTypeAdminController.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Konventix\Platform\Http\Concerns\HasDataTableQuery;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Brand;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\CreateResourceType;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\UpdateResourceType;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\ResourceTypeData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\ResourceTypeRowData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\CapacityMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\CategoryToken;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\Permission;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Operator console: categories (design §8.1). A category is a
 * `ResourceType` (§4.1) — the console says "category" because that is what
 * a place, a grant and the picker call it.
 *
 * Runs on the admin host, where `BrandScope` hardens every brand-owned
 * query to zero rows (ADR-0029): every query here escapes it deliberately,
 * relation counts included (.ai/rules/app-modules-src.md), and the event
 * picker reads this module's own window projection, never Event's tables
 * (ADR-0004).
 */
class ResourceTypeAdminController
{
    use HasDataTableQuery;

    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManageResourceTypes->value);

        $perPage = $this->resolvePerPage($request);
        $sort = $this->resolveSort($request, allowedSorts: ['name', 'slug', 'sort_order', 'created_at'], default: 'name');
        $filters = $this->resolveFilters($request, ['event' => null]);

        $types = ResourceType::withoutBrandScope()
            ->when($request->filled('search'), function ($query) use ($request): void {
                $query->where('name', 'ilike', '%'.$request->string('search')->trim().'%');
            })
            ->when($filters['event'] !== null, fn ($query) => $query->where('event_id', $filters['event']))
            ->orderBy($sort['column'], $sort['direction'])
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->paginate($perPage)
            ->withQueryString();

        $eventNames = ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()
            ->whereIn('event_id', $types->getCollection()->pluck('event_id')->unique()->all())
            ->pluck('name', 'event_id');

        // A grouped count rather than withCount(): the latter re-applies
        // BrandScope on the counted model and reads zero on this host.
        $placeCounts = Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->selectRaw('resource_type_id, count(*) as aggregate')
            ->whereIn('resource_type_id', $types->getCollection()->pluck('id'))
            ->groupBy('resource_type_id')
            ->pluck('aggregate', 'resource_type_id');

        return Inertia::render('admin/resource-types/Index', [
            'types' => $types->through(fn (ResourceType $type): array => (new ResourceTypeRowData(
                id: (string) $type->getKey(),
                name: $type->name,
                slug: $type->slug,
                eventName: $eventNames[$type->event_id] ?? $type->event_id,
                mode: $type->mode,
                token: $type->token,
                symbol: $type->symbol,
                sortOrder: $type->sort_order,
                places: (int) ($placeCounts[$type->getKey()] ?? 0),
            ))->toArray()),
            'brands' => $this->brandOptions(),
            'events' => $this->eventOptions(),
            'options' => $this->axisOptions(),
            'filters' => $this->currentFilters($request, $sort, $perPage, $filters),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, CreateResourceType $createResourceType): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManageResourceTypes->value);

        $brandId = $request->validate(['brand_id' => ['required', 'ulid', 'exists:brands,id']])['brand_id'];
        $type = $createResourceType->handle($brandId, ResourceTypeData::validateAndCreate($request->all()));

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Category created.')]);

        return to_route('admin.resource-types.edit', $type->getKey());
    }

    public function edit(string $resourceType): Response
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManageResourceTypes->value);

        $type = $this->find($resourceType);

        /** @var Brand|null $brand */
        $brand = Brand::query()->whereKey($type->brand_id)->first();

        return Inertia::render('admin/resource-types/Edit', [
            'type' => [
                'id' => (string) $type->getKey(),
                'brandName' => $brand->name ?? '—',
                ...ResourceTypeData::fromModel($type)->toArray(),
            ],
            'events' => $this->eventOptions($type->brand_id),
            'options' => $this->axisOptions(),
            'places' => Resource::withoutBrandScope()->where('resource_type_id', $type->getKey())->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, string $resourceType, UpdateResourceType $updateResourceType): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManageResourceTypes->value);

        $type = $this->find($resourceType);

        $updateResourceType->handle($type, ResourceTypeData::validateAndCreate($request->all()));

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Category saved.')]);

        return to_route('admin.resource-types.edit', $type->getKey());
    }

    private function find(string $resourceType): ResourceType
    {
        /** @var ResourceType */
        return ResourceType::withoutBrandScope()->findOrFail($resourceType);
    }

    /**
     * The events this module knows, by name (design §4.7). Optionally
     * narrowed to one brand for the editor, where the type's brand is fixed.
     *
     * @return list<array{id: string, name: string, brandId: string}>
     */
    private function eventOptions(?string $brandId = null): array
    {
        return array_values(ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()
            ->when($brandId !== null, fn ($query) => $query->where('brand_id', $brandId))
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (ResourceEventWindow $window): array => [
                'id' => $window->event_id,
                'name' => (string) ($window->name ?? $window->event_id),
                'brandId' => $window->brand_id,
            ])
            ->all());
    }

    /**
     * Every axis value the form may offer, from the enums themselves.
     *
     * @return array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private function axisOptions(): array
    {
        return [
            'mode' => array_column(CapacityMode::cases(), 'value'),
            'token' => array_column(CategoryToken::cases(), 'value'),
        ];
    }
}
```

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { Plus } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import InputError from '@/components/InputError.vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { store as storeType } from '@/routes/admin/resource-types';

/**
 * Creating a category asks for its identity only — brand, event, name,
 * slug, mode and token. Description, symbol, sort order and the default
 * place shape are the editor's job on the next screen (design §8.1).
 *
 * The slug follows the name until the operator edits it by hand, the way
 * every slug field in the console behaves.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    brands: { id: string; name: string }[];
    events: { id: string; name: string; brandId: string }[];
    options: { mode: string[]; token: string[] };
}>();

const open = ref(false);
const slugTouched = ref(false);

const form = useForm({
    brand_id: props.brands[0]?.id ?? '',
    eventId: '',
    name: '',
    slug: '',
    mode: 'unit',
    holdMinutes: 30,
    description: null as string | null,
    token: 'chart-1',
    symbol: null as string | null,
    sortOrder: 0,
    defaultShape: null as null | { type: string; w: number; h: number },
});

const eventsForBrand = computed(() =>
    props.events.filter((event) => event.brandId === form.brand_id),
);

function slugify(value: string): string {
    return value
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}

watch(
    () => form.name,
    (name) => {
        if (!slugTouched.value) {
            form.slug = slugify(name);
        }
    },
);

function submit(): void {
    form.post(storeType().url, {
        onSuccess: () => {
            form.reset();
            slugTouched.value = false;
            open.value = false;
        },
    });
}
</script>

<template>
    <Dialog v-model:open="open">
        <DialogTrigger as-child>
            <Button>
                <Plus class="size-4" />
                New category
            </Button>
        </DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent class="max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Create category</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <form class="flex flex-col gap-4" @submit.prevent="submit">
                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="category-brand">Brand</Label>
                    <select
                        id="category-brand"
                        v-model="form.brand_id"
                        class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                        <option
                            v-for="brand in props.brands"
                            :key="brand.id"
                            :value="brand.id"
                        >
                            {{ brand.name }}
                        </option>
                    </select>
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.brand_id" />
                </div>

                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="category-event">Event</Label>
                    <select
                        id="category-event"
                        v-model="form.eventId"
                        class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                        <option value="" disabled>Choose an event</option>
                        <option
                            v-for="event in eventsForBrand"
                            :key="event.id"
                            :value="event.id"
                        >
                            {{ event.name }}
                        </option>
                    </select>
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.eventId" />
                </div>

                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="category-name">Name</Label>
                    <Input id="category-name" v-model="form.name" />
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.name" />
                </div>

                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="category-slug">Slug</Label>
                    <Input
                        id="category-slug"

                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Head, Link } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import type { ColumnDef, SortingState } from '@tanstack/vue-table';
import { computed, h } from 'vue';
import AdminPageHeader from '@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader.vue';
import DataTable from '@/components/admin/DataTable.vue';
import DataTableToolbar from '@/components/admin/DataTableToolbar.vue';
import type {
    DataTableFilterDef,
    DataTableFilters,
} from '@/composables/useDataTable';
import { useDataTable } from '@/composables/useDataTable';
import {
    edit as editType,
    index as typesIndex,
} from '@/routes/admin/resource-types';
import ResourceTypeCreateDialog from '../../../components/admin/ResourceTypeCreateDialog.vue';

/**
 * Categories of an event (design §8.1): what a place is, what a seating
 * grant may choose from, and how the picker draws it — a colour token and a
 * symbol, because state is never conveyed by colour alone (BFSG).
 *
 * The event filter is a toolbar filter declared once on the backend and
 * once here (.ai/rules/pages.md); the options are this module's own event
 * projection (ADR-0004).
 */
type TypeRow = Konventix.Resources.Data.ResourceTypeRowData;

interface PaginatedTypes {
    data: TypeRow[];
    current_page: number;
    last_page: number;
    per_page: number;
    total: number;
    from: number | null;
    to: number | null;
}

const props = defineProps<{
    types: PaginatedTypes;
    brands: { id: string; name: string }[];
    events: { id: string; name: string; brandId: string }[];
    options: { mode: string[]; token: string[] };
    filters: DataTableFilters & { event: string | null };
}>();

const { filters, setSearch, setFilter, toggleSort, setPerPage, setPage } =
    useDataTable(() => typesIndex().url, props.filters);

const filterDefs = computed<DataTableFilterDef[]>(() => [
    {
        name: 'event',
        label: 'Events',
        value: props.filters.event,
        options: props.events.map((event) => ({
            value: event.id,
            label: event.name,
        })),
    },
]);

const sorting = computed<SortingState>(() =>
    filters.sort ? [{ id: filters.sort, desc: filters.dir === 'desc' }] : [],
);

function onSortingChange(next: SortingState): void {
    if (next.length > 0) {
        toggleSort(next[0].id);
    }
}

const pagination = computed(() => ({
    currentPage: props.types.current_page,
    lastPage: props.types.last_page,
    total: props.types.total,
    from: props.types.from,
    to: props.types.to,
}));

const columns: ColumnDef<TypeRow>[] = [
    {
        accessorKey: 'name',
        header: 'Name',
        enableSorting: true,
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h(
                Link,
                {
                    href: editType(row.original.id).url,
                    class: 'font-medium hover:text-accent',
                },
                () => row.original.name,
            ),
    },
    {
        id: 'event',
        header: 'Event',
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h('span', { class: 'text-text-muted' }, row.original.eventName),
    },
    {
        id: 'token',
        header: 'Token',
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h('span', { class: 'inline-flex items-center gap-2' }, [
                h('span', {
                    class: 'size-3 rounded-full border border-border',
                    style: { backgroundColor: `var(--${row.original.token})` },
                    'aria-hidden': 'true',
                }),
                h('span', { class: 'text-text-muted' }, row.original.token),
            ]),
    },
    {
        id: 'symbol',
        header: 'Symbol',
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h(
                'span',
                { class: 'text-text-muted' },
                row.original.symbol ?? '—',
            ),
    },
    {
        accessorKey: 'sort_order',
        header: 'Order',
        enableSorting: true,
        cell: ({ row }) => String(row.original.sortOrder),
    },
    {
        id: 'mode',
        header: 'Mode',
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h(
                'span',
                {
                    class: 'rounded-full bg-subtle px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-text-muted',
                },
                row.original.mode,
            ),
    },
    {
        id: 'places',
        header: 'Places',
        cell: ({ row }) => String(row.original.places),
    },
];
</script>

<template>
    <Head title="Categories" />

    <div class="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <AdminPageHeader
            title="Categories"
            description="What a place is: the categories a seating grant chooses from and the picker draws"
        />

        <DataTableToolbar
            :search="filters.search ?? ''"
            :per-page="filters.per_page ?? 15"
            :filters="filterDefs"
            search-placeholder="Search categories…"
            @update:search="setSearch"
            @update:per-page="setPerPage"
            @update:filter="setFilter"
        >
            <template #actions>
                <ResourceTypeCreateDialog
                    :brands="props.brands"
                    :events="props.events"
                    :options="props.options"
                />
            </template>
        </DataTableToolbar>

        <DataTable
            data-test="resource-types-table"
            :columns="columns"
            :data="props.types.data"
            :sorting="sorting"
            :pagination="pagination"
            items-label="categories"
            empty-message="No categories yet — create one per kind of place."
            @update:sorting="onSortingChange"
            @update:page="setPage"
        />
    </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Head, Link, useForm } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { ArrowLeft } from '@lucide/vue';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import AdminPageHeader from '@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader.vue';
import InputError from '@/components/InputError.vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { useUnsavedChanges } from '@/composables/useUnsavedChanges';
import {
    index as typesIndex,
    update as updateType,
} from '@/routes/admin/resource-types';

/**
 * One category (design §4.1): identity, hold minutes for clocked holds,
 * and what the picker and the editor need — colour token, lucide symbol,
 * sort order and the default place shape the editor uses when it creates
 * places of this category.
 *
 * Event and mode freeze once the category has places: `UpdateResourceType`
 * refuses both, so the form disables them rather than letting someone type
 * into a refusal.
 */
type Props = {
    type: Konventix.Resources.Data.ResourceTypeData & {
        id: string;
        brandName: string;
    };
    events: { id: string; name: string; brandId: string }[];
    options: { mode: string[]; token: string[] };
    places: number;
};

const props = defineProps<Props>();

const form = useForm({
    eventId: props.type.eventId,
    name: props.type.name,
    slug: props.type.slug,
    mode: props.type.mode,
    holdMinutes: props.type.holdMinutes,
    description: props.type.description ?? '',
    token: props.type.token,
    symbol: props.type.symbol ?? '',
    sortOrder: props.type.sortOrder,
});

useUnsavedChanges(() => form.isDirty);

const shapeWidth = ref<number | null>(props.type.defaultShape?.w ?? null);
const shapeHeight = ref<number | null>(props.type.defaultShape?.h ?? null);

const frozen = props.places > 0;

function submit(): void {
    form.transform((data) => ({
        ...data,
        description: data.description === '' ? null : data.description,
        symbol: data.symbol === '' ? null : data.symbol,
        defaultShape:
            shapeWidth.value && shapeHeight.value
                ? { type: 'rect', w: shapeWidth.value, h: shapeHeight.value }
                : null,
    })).put(updateType(props.type.id).url, { preserveScroll: true });
}
</script>

it('answers occupancy per place from the bookings', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = seatingEventWindow($brand);
    [, $admin] = seatingOperator();

    $type = ResourceType::factory()->forEvent($eventId)->create();
    $plan = Plan::factory()->create(['event_id' => $eventId]);
    $booked = seatingPlace($plan, $type, 'A-01');
    $held = seatingPlace($plan, $type, 'A-02');
    $blocked = seatingPlace($plan, $type, 'A-03', blocked: true);
    $free = seatingPlace($plan, $type, 'A-04');

    $registrationId = (string) \Illuminate\Support\Str::ulid();
    $confirmed = ResourceBooking::factory()->create([
        'resource_id' => $booked->getKey(),
        'registration_id' => $registrationId,
        'holder_id' => $registrationId,
        'state' => BookingState::Confirmed,
    ]);
    ResourceBooking::factory()->create([
        'resource_id' => $held->getKey(),
        'state' => BookingState::Held,
        'hold_expires_at' => now()->addMinutes(30),
    ]);
    // History does not occupy: a released booking must read as free.
    ResourceBooking::factory()->create([
        'resource_id' => $free->getKey(),
        'state' => BookingState::Released,
    ]);

    $this->actingAs($admin)
        ->getJson('http://admin.seating.test/admin/plans/'.$plan->getKey().'/occupancy')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$booked->getKey().'.state', 'booked')
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$booked->getKey().'.holderType', 'registration')
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$booked->getKey().'.registrationId', $registrationId)
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$booked->getKey().'.bookingId', $confirmed->getKey())
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$held->getKey().'.state', 'held')
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$blocked->getKey().'.state', 'unavailable')
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$free->getKey().'.state', 'free')
        ->assertJsonPath('places.'.$free->getKey().'.bookingId', null);
});

    $this->actingAs($admin)->post($url)->assertSessionHasErrors('place');

    expect(ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()->where('resource_id', $place->getKey())->count())->toBe(1);

- [ ] **Step 3: `CreatePlan`**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/CreatePlan.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanDocumentData;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;

/**
 * An empty plan (design §4.4) from the console's create dialog: the header
 * only, an empty `konventix.plan/v1` document at version 0, no places.
 * Everything after that goes through `SavePlan` (§6.1), which is why this
 * Action writes no version row and emits nothing — there is no document
 * to version yet.
 *
 * `venue_id` stays null in v1 (§4.4: no venue picker). The event must be
 * one this module knows for the brand — the window projection is the only
 * event fact Resources may read (ADR-0004) — and the name is unique per
 * brand and event (§4.4), refused here so the operator sees a field error
 * rather than a constraint violation.
 */
final class CreatePlan
{
    public function handle(string $brandId, PlanData $data, ?string $actorUserId): Plan
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($brandId, $data, $actorUserId): Plan {
            if (ResourceEventWindow::forEvent($brandId, $data->eventId) === null) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'eventId' => __('Resources does not know this event for the brand yet.'),
                ]);
            }

            $taken = Plan::withoutBrandScope()
                ->where('brand_id', $brandId)
                ->where('event_id', $data->eventId)
                ->where('name', $data->name)
                ->exists();

            if ($taken) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'name' => __('A plan with this name already exists for the event.'),
                ]);
            }

            $plan = new Plan;
            $plan->forceFill([
                'brand_id' => $brandId,
                'event_id' => $data->eventId,
                'venue_id' => null,
                'name' => $data->name,
                'floor_label' => $data->floorLabel,
                'width_mm' => $data->widthMm,
                'height_mm' => $data->heightMm,
                'background' => null,
                'unit_display' => $data->unitDisplay,
                'snap_step' => $data->snapStep,
                'version' => 0,
                'document' => PlanDocumentData::from(['schema' => 'konventix.plan/v1', 'elements' => []]),
                'published_at' => null,
                'origin_id' => null,
                'created_by' => $actorUserId,
            ])->save();

            return $plan;
        });
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The controller**

Replace `app-modules/resources/src/Http/Controllers/Admin/PlanAdminController.php` whole:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Konventix\Platform\Http\Concerns\HasDataTableQuery;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\CreatePlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ExportPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ImportPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\PublishPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ReleaseOperatorReservation;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ReservePlaceForOperator;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\UnpublishPlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanOccupancyData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanRowData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\Permission;
use Konventix\Resources\Exceptions\ResourceUnavailableException;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Operator console: hall plans (design §8.2). This half is the index and
 * the endpoints around a plan — create, publish, unpublish, export, import,
 * occupancy, operator reservations. `edit`, `update` and `validate` (the
 * editor, §8.3) are added by slice S7.
 *
 * Runs on the admin host with no brand in context (ADR-0029): every query
 * escapes `BrandScope` explicitly and every created row gets its
 * `brand_id` from the request or from the plan row (design §8, §10).
 * Booking writes go only through the booking Actions (§10); this class
 * never touches `resource_bookings` directly.
 */
class PlanAdminController
{
    use HasDataTableQuery;

    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $perPage = $this->resolvePerPage($request);
        $sort = $this->resolveSort($request, allowedSorts: ['name', 'version', 'published_at', 'created_at'], default: 'name');
        $filters = $this->resolveFilters($request, ['event' => null]);

        $plans = Plan::withoutBrandScope()
            ->when($request->filled('search'), function ($query) use ($request): void {
                $query->where('name', 'ilike', '%'.$request->string('search')->trim().'%');
            })
            ->when($filters['event'] !== null, fn ($query) => $query->where('event_id', $filters['event']))
            ->orderBy($sort['column'], $sort['direction'])
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->paginate($perPage)
            ->withQueryString();

        $eventNames = ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()
            ->whereIn('event_id', $plans->getCollection()->pluck('event_id')->unique()->all())
            ->pluck('name', 'event_id');

        // Grouped count, not withCount(): the latter re-applies BrandScope
        // on the counted model and reads zero on this host. Soft-deleted
        // places are excluded by the model's own scope.
        $placeCounts = Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->selectRaw('plan_id, count(*) as aggregate')
            ->whereIn('plan_id', $plans->getCollection()->pluck('id'))
            ->groupBy('plan_id')
            ->pluck('aggregate', 'plan_id');

        return Inertia::render('admin/plans/Index', [
            'plans' => $plans->through(fn (Plan $plan): array => (new PlanRowData(
                id: (string) $plan->getKey(),
                name: $plan->name,
                eventName: $eventNames[$plan->event_id] ?? $plan->event_id,
                floorLabel: $plan->floor_label,
                places: (int) ($placeCounts[$plan->getKey()] ?? 0),
                version: $plan->version,
                publishedAt: $plan->published_at?->toIso8601String(),
            ))->toArray()),
            'brands' => $this->brandOptions(),
            'events' => $this->eventOptions(),
            'filters' => $this->currentFilters($request, $sort, $perPage, $filters),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, CreatePlan $createPlan): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $brandId = $request->validate(['brand_id' => ['required', 'ulid', 'exists:brands,id']])['brand_id'];

        $createPlan->handle(
            $brandId,
            PlanData::validateAndCreate($request->all()),
            $request->user()?->getKey(),
        );

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Plan created.')]);

        return to_route('admin.plans.index');
    }

    public function publish(string $plan, PublishPlan $publishPlan): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $publishPlan->handle($this->find($plan));

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Plan published — its places are now bookable.')]);

        return back();
    }

    public function unpublish(string $plan, UnpublishPlan $unpublishPlan): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $unpublishPlan->handle($this->find($plan));

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Plan unpublished — its places are hidden from the picker.')]);

        return back();
    }

    /**
     * The canonical document as a file (design §6.4): the same bytes
     * `resources:plan-export` writes, so a round trip through the console
     * and the command is byte-stable.
     */
    public function export(string $plan, ExportPlan $exportPlan): StreamedResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $model = $this->find($plan);
        $json = $exportPlan->handle($model);

        return response()->streamDownload(
            function () use ($json): void {
                echo $json;
            },
            Str::slug($model->name).'.json',
            ['Content-Type' => 'application/json'],
        );
    }

    /**
     * A full document uploaded on the index becomes a new plan (design
     * §6.4). The file is read here and decoded here; what is inside it is
     * `ImportPlan`'s to validate through `SavePlan`, whose validation
     * errors reach the dialog like any other 422.
     */
    public function import(Request $request, ImportPlan $importPlan): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'brand_id' => ['required', 'ulid', 'exists:brands,id'],
            'eventId' => ['required', 'ulid'],
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            // 2 MB is generous for a document of 2,000 elements (§14 caps
            // v1 there); `mimes` is not used because a JSON body is guessed
            // as text by the sniffer and would be refused for the wrong reason.
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'max:2048'],
        ]);

        $document = json_decode((string) $validated['file']->get(), true);

        if (! is_array($document)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'file' => __('The file is not a JSON document.'),
            ]);
        }

        $importPlan->handle(
            $validated['brand_id'],
            $validated['eventId'],
            $validated['name'],
            $document,
            $request->user()?->getKey(),
        );

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Plan imported.')]);

        return to_route('admin.plans.index');
    }

    /**
     * Who holds what, per place (design §8.2 `PlanOccupancyData`), for the
     * editor overlay. Availability is a query over the bookings, never a
     * column on the place (§6.2); the vocabulary matches the picker's
     * `PlaceState` minus `mine`, which has no meaning for an operator.
     */
    public function occupancy(string $plan): JsonResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $model = $this->find($plan);

        $places = Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('plan_id', $model->getKey())
            ->get(['id', 'blocked']);

        $occupying = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->whereIn('resource_id', $places->pluck('id'))
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->get()
            ->keyBy('resource_id');

        $result = [];

        foreach ($places as $place) {
            /** @var ResourceBooking|null $booking */
            $booking = $occupying->get($place->getKey());

            $result[(string) $place->getKey()] = [
                'state' => match (true) {
                    $place->blocked => 'unavailable',
                    $booking === null => 'free',
                    $booking->state === BookingState::Held => 'held',
                    default => 'booked',
                },
                'holderType' => $booking?->holder_type,
                'registrationId' => $booking?->registration_id,
                'bookingId' => $booking === null ? null : (string) $booking->getKey(),
            ];
        }

        return response()->json(new PlanOccupancyData(places: $result));
    }

    /**
     * An orga reservation on one place (design §7.3): hold plus confirm with
     * holder `operator`. A taken place fails through the exclusion
     * constraint inside the Action and comes back as a field error.
     */
    public function reserve(Request $request, string $plan, string $place, ReservePlaceForOperator $reservePlace): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::BookOnBehalf->value);

        $model = $this->find($plan);
        $resource = $this->findPlace($model, $place);

        try {
            $reservePlace->handle($resource, (string) $request->user()->getKey());
        } catch (ResourceUnavailableException) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'place' => __('Place :ref is already taken.', ['ref' => $resource->ref ?? $resource->label]),
            ]);
        }

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Place :ref reserved.', ['ref' => $resource->ref ?? $resource->label])]);

        return back();
    }

    public function unreserve(string $plan, string $place, ReleaseOperatorReservation $releaseReservation): RedirectResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::BookOnBehalf->value);

        $model = $this->find($plan);
        $resource = $this->findPlace($model, $place);

        /** @var ResourceBooking|null $booking */
        $booking = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('resource_id', $resource->getKey())
            ->where('holder_type', ResourceBooking::HOLDER_OPERATOR)
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->first();

        if ($booking === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'place' => __('Place :ref carries no operator reservation.', ['ref' => $resource->ref ?? $resource->label]),
            ]);
        }

        $releaseReservation->handle($booking);

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Reservation released.')]);

        return back();
    }

    private function find(string $plan): Plan
    {
        /** @var Plan */
        return Plan::withoutBrandScope()->findOrFail($plan);
    }

    /**
     * A place of *this* plan — the plan id in the URL is not decoration: a
     * place id from another plan or brand 404s rather than being acted on.
     */
    private function findPlace(Plan $plan, string $place): Resource
    {
        /** @var Resource */
        return Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('plan_id', $plan->getKey())
            ->findOrFail($place);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{id: string, name: string, brandId: string}>
     */
    private function eventOptions(): array
    {
        return array_values(ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (ResourceEventWindow $window): array => [
                'id' => $window->event_id,
                'name' => (string) ($window->name ?? $window->event_id),
                'brandId' => $window->brand_id,
            ])
            ->all());
    }
}
```

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { Upload } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import InputError from '@/components/InputError.vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { upload as uploadPlan } from '@/routes/admin/plans';

/**
 * A full `konventix.plan/v1` document becomes a new plan (design §6.4).
 * The server runs it through `SavePlan`, so a structural error comes back
 * as an ordinary field error on `document.elements.<index>.<field>`; the
 * dialog shows the first of those under the file input, because a keyed
 * list of every element error is the editor's job, not a dialog's.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    brands: { id: string; name: string }[];
    events: { id: string; name: string; brandId: string }[];
}>();

const open = ref(false);

const form = useForm<{
    brand_id: string;
    eventId: string;
    name: string;
    file: File | null;
}>({
    brand_id: props.brands[0]?.id ?? '',
    eventId: '',
    name: '',
    file: null,
});

const eventsForBrand = computed(() =>
    props.events.filter((event) => event.brandId === form.brand_id),
);

const documentError = computed(() => {
    const key = Object.keys(form.errors).find((name) =>
        name.startsWith('document.'),
    );

    return key ? `${key}: ${form.errors[key as keyof typeof form.errors]}` : undefined;
});

function submit(): void {
    form.post(uploadPlan().url, {
        forceFormData: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            form.reset();
            open.value = false;
        },
    });
}
</script>

<template>
    <Dialog v-model:open="open">
        <DialogTrigger as-child>
            <Button variant="outline">
                <Upload class="size-4" />
                Import
            </Button>
        </DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent>
            <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Import a plan document</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <form class="flex flex-col gap-4" @submit.prevent="submit">
                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="import-brand">Brand</Label>
                    <select
                        id="import-brand"
                        v-model="form.brand_id"
                        class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                        <option
                            v-for="brand in props.brands"
                            :key="brand.id"
                            :value="brand.id"
                        >
                            {{ brand.name }}
                        </option>
                    </select>
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.brand_id" />
                </div>
                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="import-event">Event</Label>
                    <select
                        id="import-event"
                        v-model="form.eventId"
                        class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm"
                    >
                        <option value="" disabled>Choose an event</option>
                        <option
                            v-for="event in eventsForBrand"
                            :key="event.id"
                            :value="event.id"
                        >
                            {{ event.name }}
                        </option>
                    </select>
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.eventId" />
                </div>
                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="import-name">Plan name</Label>
                    <Input id="import-name" v-model="form.name" />
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.name" />
                </div>
                <div class="grid gap-2">
                    <Label for="import-file">Document (JSON)</Label>
                    <input
                        id="import-file"
                        type="file"
                        accept="application/json,.json"
                        class="text-sm"
                        @change="
                            form.file =
                                ($event.target as HTMLInputElement).files?.[0] ??
                                null
                        "
                    />
                    <p class="text-xs text-text-muted">
                        A <code>konventix.plan/v1</code> export. Element ids
                        the export carries are kept; ids that already exist
                        under another plan are refused.
                    </p>
                    <InputError :message="form.errors.file ?? documentError" />
                </div>
                <Button type="submit" :disabled="form.processing || !form.file">
                    Import
                </Button>
            </form>
        </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
</template>

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Head, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import type { ColumnDef, SortingState } from '@tanstack/vue-table';
import { computed, h } from 'vue';
import AdminPageHeader from '@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader.vue';
import DataTable from '@/components/admin/DataTable.vue';
import DataTableToolbar from '@/components/admin/DataTableToolbar.vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import type {
    DataTableFilterDef,
    DataTableFilters,
} from '@/composables/useDataTable';
import { useDataTable } from '@/composables/useDataTable';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/datetime';
import {
    download as downloadPlan,
    index as plansIndex,
    publish as publishPlan,
    unpublish as unpublishPlan,
} from '@/routes/admin/plans';
import PlanCreateDialog from '../../../components/admin/PlanCreateDialog.vue';
import PlanImportDialog from '../../../components/admin/PlanImportDialog.vue';

/**
 * Hall plans of the operator's events (design §8.2): name, event, places,
 * version, published — with the create dialog, the import upload, the
 * export link and the publish toggle. The editor link arrives with the
 * editor itself (slice S7, §8.3); until then a plan is built by import.
 *
 * The export is a plain anchor, not an Inertia link: it is a file, and an
 * Inertia visit would fetch it over XHR and show the JSON in the error
 * modal.
 */
type PlanRow = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanRowData;

interface PaginatedPlans {
    data: PlanRow[];
    current_page: number;
    last_page: number;
    per_page: number;
    total: number;
    from: number | null;
    to: number | null;
}

const props = defineProps<{
    plans: PaginatedPlans;
    brands: { id: string; name: string }[];
    events: { id: string; name: string; brandId: string }[];
    filters: DataTableFilters & { event: string | null };
}>();

const { filters, setSearch, setFilter, toggleSort, setPerPage, setPage } =
    useDataTable(() => plansIndex().url, props.filters);

const filterDefs = computed<DataTableFilterDef[]>(() => [
    {
        name: 'event',
        label: 'Events',
        value: props.filters.event,
        options: props.events.map((event) => ({
            value: event.id,
            label: event.name,
        })),
    },
]);

const sorting = computed<SortingState>(() =>
    filters.sort ? [{ id: filters.sort, desc: filters.dir === 'desc' }] : [],
);

function onSortingChange(next: SortingState): void {
    if (next.length > 0) {
        toggleSort(next[0].id);
    }
}

const pagination = computed(() => ({
    currentPage: props.plans.current_page,
    lastPage: props.plans.last_page,
    total: props.plans.total,
    from: props.plans.from,
    to: props.plans.to,
}));

function togglePublish(row: PlanRow): void {
    const route = row.publishedAt === null ? publishPlan : unpublishPlan;

    router.post(route(row.id).url, {}, { preserveScroll: true });
}

const columns: ColumnDef<PlanRow>[] = [
    {
        accessorKey: 'name',
        header: 'Name',
        enableSorting: true,
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h('div', { class: 'flex flex-col' }, [
                h('span', { class: 'font-medium' }, row.original.name),
                row.original.floorLabel
                    ? h(
                          'span',
                          { class: 'text-xs text-text-muted' },
                          row.original.floorLabel,
                      )
                    : null,
            ]),
    },
    {
        id: 'event',
        header: 'Event',
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h('span', { class: 'text-text-muted' }, row.original.eventName),
    },
    {
        id: 'places',
        header: 'Places',
        cell: ({ row }) => String(row.original.places),
    },
    {
        accessorKey: 'version',
        header: 'Version',
        enableSorting: true,
        cell: ({ row }) => String(row.original.version),
    },
    {
        accessorKey: 'published_at',
        header: 'Published',
        enableSorting: true,
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            row.original.publishedAt === null
                ? h(
                      'span',
                      {
                          class: 'rounded-full bg-subtle px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-text-muted',
                      },
                      'Draft',
                  )
                : h(
                      'span',
                      { class: 'text-success' },
                      formatDateTime(row.original.publishedAt),
                  ),
    },
    {
        id: 'actions',
        header: '',
        cell: ({ row }) =>
            h('div', { class: 'flex justify-end gap-2' }, [
                h(
                    Button,
                    {
                        variant: 'outline',
                        size: 'sm',
                        type: 'button',
                        onClick: () => togglePublish(row.original),
                    },
                    () =>
                        row.original.publishedAt === null
                            ? 'Publish'
                            : 'Unpublish',
                ),
                h(
                    'a',
                    {
                        href: downloadPlan(row.original.id).url,
                        download: '',
                        class: 'inline-flex h-8 items-center rounded-md border border-border px-3 text-sm hover:bg-subtle',
                    },
                    'Export',
                ),
            ]),
    },
];
</script>

<template>
    <Head title="Seating plans" />

    <div class="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <AdminPageHeader
            title="Seating plans"
            description="Hall plans per event: draw or import, publish when the picker may show them"
        />

        <DataTableToolbar
            :search="filters.search ?? ''"
            :per-page="filters.per_page ?? 15"
            :filters="filterDefs"
            search-placeholder="Search plans…"
            @update:search="setSearch"
            @update:per-page="setPerPage"
            @update:filter="setFilter"
        >
            <template #actions>
                <PlanImportDialog :brands="props.brands" :events="props.events" />
                <PlanCreateDialog :brands="props.brands" :events="props.events" />
            </template>
        </DataTableToolbar>

        <DataTable
            data-test="plans-table"
            :columns="columns"
            :data="props.plans.data"
            :sorting="sorting"
            :pagination="pagination"
            items-label="plans"
            empty-message="No plans yet — create one or import a document."
            @update:sorting="onSortingChange"
            @update:page="setPage"
        />
    </div>
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The grants card**

`app-modules/registration/resources/js/components/RegistrationTypeGrantsCard.vue`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Plus, Trash2 } from '@lucide/vue';
import InputError from '@/components/InputError.vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { resolveRegisteredComponent } from '@/lib/moduleComponents';

/**
 * The grants a confirmed registration of a type is entitled to (ADR-0005),
 * extracted from the type editor page (design §7.1). One row per grant:
 * kind, role, quantity. A `seating` grant additionally renders whatever
 * the `registration.type-editor.seating-fields` slot contributes —
 * Resources' category picker and mode select — bound to the grant with
 * `modelValue`/`update:modelValue`, so this module never knows what a
 * category is (ADR-0004). No contribution means Resources is off for the
 * brand, and the row says so.
 */
type Grant = Konventix.Registration.Data.GrantData;

type SlotContribution = {
    module: string;
    component: string;
    props: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const model = defineModel<Grant[]>({ required: true });

const props = defineProps<{
    kinds: string[];
    disabled: boolean;
    error?: string;
    seatingSlots: SlotContribution[];
}>();

function emptyGrant(): Grant {
    return {
        kind: 'admission',
        role: '',
        quantity: 1,
        resourceTypeId: null,
        resourceTypeIds: null,
        seatingMode: null,
    } as Grant;
}

function addGrant(): void {
    model.value = [...model.value, emptyGrant()];
}

function removeGrant(index: number): void {
    model.value = model.value.filter((_, position) => position !== index);
}

function replaceGrant(index: number, next: Grant): void {
    model.value = model.value.map((grant, position) =>
        position === index ? next : grant,
    );
}

/** Switching kind resets the seating fields so a stale category list never rides along. */
function changeKind(index: number, kind: string): void {
    const grant = model.value[index];
    const seating = kind === 'seating';

    replaceGrant(index, {
        ...grant,
        kind: kind as Grant['kind'],
        resourceTypeIds: seating ? (grant.resourceTypeIds ?? []) : null,
        seatingMode: seating ? (grant.seatingMode ?? 'pick') : null,
    } as Grant);
}
</script>

<template>
    <Card>
        <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Grants</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <p class="text-sm text-text-muted">
                What a confirmed registration of this type is entitled to.
                Admission grants become badges; resource claims become
                bookings; a seating grant lets the registrant pick places of
                the chosen categories after confirmation.
            </p>

            <div
                v-for="(grant, index) in model"
                :key="index"
                class="grid gap-3 rounded-md border border-border p-3 sm:grid-cols-[8rem_1fr_6rem_auto]"
            >
                <select
                    :value="grant.kind"
                    :disabled="props.disabled"
                    aria-label="Grant kind"
                    class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm disabled:opacity-60"
                    @change="
                        changeKind(
                            index,
                            ($event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value,
                        )
                    "
                >
                    <option v-for="value in props.kinds" :key="value" :value="value">
                        {{ value }}
                    </option>
                </select>
                <Input
                    v-model="grant.role"
                    placeholder="Role (visitor, exhibitor, crew…)"
                    :disabled="props.disabled"
                    aria-label="Role"
                />
                <Input
                    v-model.number="grant.quantity"
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    :disabled="props.disabled"
                    aria-label="Quantity"
                />
                <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    :disabled="props.disabled"
                    aria-label="Remove grant"
                    @click="removeGrant(index)"
                >
                    <Trash2 class="size-3.5" />
                </Button>

                <template v-if="grant.kind === 'seating'">
                    <template
                        v-for="slot in props.seatingSlots"
                        :key="`${slot.module}-${slot.component}`"
                    >
                        <component
                            :is="resolveRegisteredComponent(slot.component)"
                            v-if="resolveRegisteredComponent(slot.component)"
                            class="sm:col-span-4"
                            :model-value="grant"
                            :disabled="props.disabled"
                            v-bind="slot.props"
                            @update:model-value="
                                (next: Grant) => replaceGrant(index, next)
                            "
                        />
                    </template>
                    <p
                        v-if="props.seatingSlots.length === 0"
                        class="text-sm text-warning sm:col-span-4"
                    >
                        Seat categories come from the Resources module, which
                        is switched off for this brand — a seating grant
                        cannot be configured until it is on.
                    </p>
                </template>
            </div>

            <p v-if="model.length === 0" class="text-sm text-text-muted">
                No grants — a registration of this type entitles its holder
                to nothing yet.
            </p>

            <div>
                <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    :disabled="props.disabled"
                    @click="addGrant"
                >
                    <Plus class="size-4" />
                    Add grant
                </Button>
            </div>

            <InputError :message="props.error" />
        </CardContent>
    </Card>
</template>
```
