- [ ] **Step 7: Resources' contribution**

`app-modules/resources/resources/js/components/SeatingGrantFields.vue`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';

/**
 * Resources' contribution to `registration.type-editor.seating-fields`
 * (design §7.1, §9.3): which categories a seating grant may choose from,
 * and whether the registrant picks or the operator assigns. The
 * categories arrive as closure props resolved for the type's event; the
 * grant itself is Registration's and travels as `modelValue`, edited by
 * emitting a copy — this component never mutates what it was handed.
 *
 * The quantity input in the grant row above is the maximum number of
 * places (§7.1); it is not repeated here.
 */
type Grant = Konventix.Registration.Data.GrantData;
type Category = Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData;

const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<{
        modelValue: Grant;
        categories: Category[];
        disabled?: boolean;
    }>(),
    { disabled: false },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
    (e: 'update:modelValue', value: Grant): void;
}>();

const selected = computed(() => props.modelValue.resourceTypeIds ?? []);

function toggle(id: string, checked: boolean): void {
    emit('update:modelValue', {
        ...props.modelValue,
        resourceTypeIds: checked
            ? [...new Set([...selected.value, id])]
            : selected.value.filter((existing) => existing !== id),
    });
}

function setMode(mode: string): void {
    emit('update:modelValue', {
        ...props.modelValue,
        seatingMode: mode as Grant['seatingMode'],
    });
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="grid gap-4 rounded-md bg-subtle/40 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <fieldset class="grid gap-2">
            <legend class="text-sm font-medium">Seat categories</legend>
            <p v-if="props.categories.length === 0" class="text-sm text-text-muted">
                This event has no categories yet — create them under
                Categories first.
            </p>
            <div
                v-for="category in props.categories"
                :key="category.id"
                class="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
                <Checkbox
                    :id="`seating-category-${category.id}`"
                    :model-value="selected.includes(category.id)"
                    :disabled="props.disabled"
                    @update:model-value="
                        (value: boolean | 'indeterminate') =>
                            toggle(category.id, value === true)
                    "
                />
                <Label
                    :for="`seating-category-${category.id}`"
                    class="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2"
                >
                    <span
                        class="size-3 shrink-0 rounded-full border border-border"
                        :style="{ backgroundColor: `var(--${category.token})` }"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <span>{{ category.name }}</span>
                    <span v-if="category.symbol" class="text-xs text-text-muted">
                        {{ category.symbol }}
                    </span>
                </Label>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        <div class="grid content-start gap-2">
            <Label :for="`seating-mode-${props.modelValue.role || 'grant'}`">
                Seating mode
            </Label>
            <select
                :id="`seating-mode-${props.modelValue.role || 'grant'}`"
                :value="props.modelValue.seatingMode ?? 'pick'"
                :disabled="props.disabled"
                class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm disabled:opacity-60"
                @change="setMode(($event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value)"
            >
                <option value="pick">pick — the registrant chooses</option>
                <option value="assign">assign — the operator seats them</option>
            </select>
            <p class="text-xs text-text-muted">
                The quantity in this row is the maximum number of places.
                Categories freeze with the other terms once anyone has
                registered.
            </p>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Register the slot**

In `ResourcesServiceProvider` add the imports

```php
use Konventix\Platform\Slots\SlotRegistry;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\CategoryData;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;
```

and the method (after `registerNavigation()`):

```php
    /**
     * Design §9.2 / §9.3: the type editor's seating fields. Registration
     * hands over the slot and `{ eventId }`; what comes back — the event's
     * categories as `CategoryData` — is this module's business, resolved
     * by closure at render time under the brand the caller set. Module
     * `resources` and no `feature`: the module's own Pennant feature is
     * the gate (§2).
     *
     * `static` on purpose: `SlotRegistry` is a singleton that outlives the
     * request under Octane, and a closure capturing `$this` would pin this
     * provider with it. Slice S5 adds `registration.mine.show` here.
     */
    protected function registerSlots(): void
    {
        $this->app->make(SlotRegistry::class)->add(
            slot: 'registration.type-editor.seating-fields',
            module: 'resources',
            component: 'resources/SeatingGrantFields',
            props: static fn (array $context): array => [
                'categories' => ResourceType::query()
                    ->where('event_id', $context['eventId'])
                    ->orderBy('sort_order')
                    ->orderBy('name')
                    ->get()
                    ->map(fn (ResourceType $type): array => (new CategoryData(
                        id: (string) $type->getKey(),
                        name: $type->name,
                        token: $type->token,
                        symbol: $type->symbol,
                        description: $type->description,
                    ))->toArray())
                    ->all(),
            ],
            order: 10,
        );
    }
```

## Slice S5: Seat picker page, availability, SeatSummarySlot

**Goal of this slice:** a confirmed registrant with a seat claim opens `/my/registrations/{registration}/seat` on the brand host, sees every published plan of the event as an SVG scene plus a keyboard list, picks up to `claim.quantity` places of their categories, submits, and lands back on "Meine Registrierung" where the Resources slot now shows the chosen refs. Availability refreshes every 15 s while the page is open.

**Consumes (exact names, fixed by the design doc and produced by earlier slices):**

- S1 models under `Konventix\Resources\Models`: `Plan` (table `resource_plans`, `document` cast to `PlanDocumentData`, `published_at`), `ResourceClaim` (table `resource_claims`: `event_id`, `registration_id`, `registrant_user_id`, `amendment_id`, `resource_type_ids` array cast, `seating_mode`, `quantity`, `state`), `Resource` extended with `plan_id`, `ref`, `zone_id`, `group_id`, `accessible`, `blocked`, `SoftDeletes`, `ResourceBooking` extended with `claim_id`, `amendment_id`, `label`, `ResourceType` extended with `description`, `token`, `symbol`, `sort_order`.
- S1 enums under `Konventix\Resources\Enums`: `ClaimState {Unplaced, Placed, Released}`, `SeatingMode {Pick, Assign}`, `PlaceState {Free, Mine, Held, Booked, Unavailable}`, `CategoryToken`, `ElementKind`, `ShapeKind`; existing `BookingState`.
- S1 Data under `Konventix\Resources\Data`: `SeatPickerData { registrationId, claim, categories, plans, availability, currentPlaceIds }`, `SeatClaimData { id, resourceTypeIds, seatingMode, quantity, state }`, `CategoryData { id, name, token, symbol, description }`, `PlanViewData { id, name, floorLabel, widthMm, heightMm, background, document }`, `PlanAvailabilityData { eventId, generatedAt, places }`, `PickPlacesData { placeIds }`, `PlanDocumentData { schema, elements }`, `PlanElementData`, `ShapeData` (design §5, §7.4). Generated TS namespaces `Konventix.Resources.Data.*` and `Konventix.Resources.Enums.*`.
- S3: `Konventix\Resources\Actions\AssignPlacesToRegistration::handle(ResourceClaim $claim, array $placeIds, string $actorType, ?string $actorUserId): array` with actor type `'registrant'` (design §7.3); it throws `Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException` keyed `placeIds`.
- Existing: `Konventix\Resources\Listeners\ProjectEventWindow` (window rows from `EventCreated`), `ResourceEventWindow::forEvent()`, `ResourceBooking::HOLDER_REGISTRATION`, `Konventix\Platform\Slots\SlotRegistry::add()`, `resolveRegisteredComponent()` in `resources/js/lib/moduleComponents.ts`, `MyRegistrationsController@show` rendering `slots` for `registration.mine.show` with context `['registrationId' => …]`.

**Produces:** routes `resources.seating.pick`, `resources.seating.pick.store`, `resources.seating.availability`; controllers `SeatPickController@show/@store`, `SeatAvailabilityController@show`; actions `ComputePlanAvailability`, `FindSeatClaimForRegistrant`; Data `SeatSummaryData`; page `seating/Pick`; components under `app-modules/resources/resources/js/components/plan/` and `resources/SeatSummarySlot`; helpers `seatingEventWindow`, `seatingCategory`, `seatingPublishedPlan`, `seatingClaim`, `seatingBooking` in `app-modules/resources/tests/Helpers.php`.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Konventix\Event\Events\EventCreated;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanDocumentData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\SeatingMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Helpers that more than one file of the seating suite calls. Pest loads
 * every module's tests/Helpers.php from tests/Pest.php, so they exist in
 * every worker of a parallel run; names are process-global across all
 * modules, hence the `seating` prefix (.ai/rules/tests.md).
 *
 * Rows are written with `forceFill()` on purpose: the columns S1 added to
 * `resources`, `resource_types` and `resource_bookings` are projection
 * columns the editor's save pipeline writes, not form input, and a helper
 * that depended on them being mass-assignable would couple the tests to a
 * `$fillable` decision they have no stake in. `BelongsToBrand` still stamps
 * `brand_id` on create, so every call needs an ambient brand
 * (`$this->withBrand()` in the test).
 */
function seatingEventWindow(string $eventId, string $brandId): ResourceEventWindow
{
    event(new EventCreated(
        eventId: $eventId,
        brandId: $brandId,
        slug: 'e-'.Str::lower(Str::random(6)),
        name: 'Seating test event',
        startsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDay()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        endsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDays(3)->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        timezone: 'Europe/Berlin',
        predecessorEventId: null,
    ));

    return ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()->where('event_id', $eventId)->firstOrFail();
}

function seatingCategory(string $eventId, string $name = 'Seat', string $token = 'chart-1', ?string $symbol = 'armchair'): ResourceType
{
    $type = ResourceType::factory()->forEvent($eventId)->make(['name' => $name]);
    $type->forceFill(['token' => $token, 'symbol' => $symbol, 'sort_order' => 0])->save();

    return $type;
}

/**
 * One zone, one group, `$places` places in a row — the document and its
 * projection written side by side, the way SavePlan leaves them: the place
 * element id is the `resources` row id (design §4.2).
 *
 * @return array{plan: Plan, places: list<Resource>}
 */
function seatingPublishedPlan(string $eventId, ResourceType $type, int $places = 2, bool $published = true): array
{
    $zoneId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $groupId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $placeIds = array_map(fn (): string => (string) Str::ulid(), range(1, $places));

    $elements = [
        [
            'id' => $zoneId, 'kind' => 'zone', 'parentId' => null, 'ref' => 'Z1', 'label' => 'Hall',
            'layer' => 'default', 'x' => 0, 'y' => 0, 'rotation' => 0,
            'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 10000, 'h' => 6000],
            'locked' => false, 'token' => 'chart-2', 'accessible' => false, 'detached' => false, 'blocked' => false,
        ],
        [
            'id' => $groupId, 'kind' => 'group', 'parentId' => $zoneId, 'ref' => 'A', 'label' => 'Row A',
            'layer' => 'default', 'x' => 1000, 'y' => 1000, 'rotation' => 0,
            'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 8000, 'h' => 800],
            'locked' => false, 'accessible' => false, 'detached' => false, 'blocked' => false,
        ],
    ];

    foreach ($placeIds as $index => $placeId) {
        $ref = sprintf('A-%02d', $index + 1);
        $elements[] = [
            'id' => $placeId, 'kind' => 'place', 'parentId' => $groupId, 'ref' => $ref, 'label' => $ref,
            'layer' => 'default', 'x' => $index * 900, 'y' => 0, 'rotation' => 0,
            'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 800, 'h' => 800],
            'locked' => false, 'resourceTypeId' => $type->id,
            'accessible' => false, 'detached' => false, 'blocked' => false,
        ];
    }

    $plan = new Plan;
    $plan->forceFill([
        'event_id' => $eventId,
        'venue_id' => null,
        'name' => 'Main hall '.Str::lower(Str::random(4)),
        'floor_label' => null,
        'width_mm' => 10000,
        'height_mm' => 6000,
        'background' => null,
        'unit_display' => 'cm',
        'snap_step' => 100,
        'version' => 1,
        'document' => PlanDocumentData::from(['schema' => 'konventix.plan/v1', 'elements' => $elements]),
        'published_at' => $published ? now() : null,
    ])->save();

    $rows = [];

    foreach ($placeIds as $index => $placeId) {
        $ref = sprintf('A-%02d', $index + 1);
        $place = Resource::factory()->ofType($type)->make(['label' => $ref, 'capacity' => 1]);
        $place->forceFill([
            'id' => $placeId,
            'plan_id' => $plan->getKey(),
            'ref' => $ref,
            'zone_id' => $zoneId,
            'group_id' => $groupId,
            'is_published' => $published,
            'accessible' => false,
            'blocked' => false,
        ])->save();
        $rows[] = $place;
    }

    return ['plan' => $plan, 'places' => $rows];
}

/**
 * @param  list<string>  $resourceTypeIds
 */
function seatingClaim(
    string $eventId,
    string $registrationId,
    string $userId,
    array $resourceTypeIds,
    int $quantity = 1,
    ClaimState $state = ClaimState::Unplaced,
): ResourceClaim {
    $claim = new ResourceClaim;
    $claim->forceFill([
        'event_id' => $eventId,
        'registration_id' => $registrationId,
        'registrant_user_id' => $userId,
        'amendment_id' => null,
        'resource_type_ids' => $resourceTypeIds,
        'seating_mode' => SeatingMode::Pick,
        'quantity' => $quantity,
        'state' => $state,
    ])->save();

    return $claim;
}

/**
 * A booking row as `AssignPlacesToRegistration` leaves it — holder is the
 * registration, interval is the event window, no clock (design §7.3).
 */
function seatingBooking(
    Resource $place,
    ResourceEventWindow $window,
    string $registrationId,
    ?ResourceClaim $claim = null,
    BookingState $state = BookingState::Confirmed,
): ResourceBooking {
    $booking = ResourceBooking::factory()->make([
        'resource_id' => $place->getKey(),
        'holder_type' => ResourceBooking::HOLDER_REGISTRATION,
        'holder_id' => $registrationId,
        'registration_id' => $registrationId,
        'quantity' => 1,
        'is_exclusive' => true,
        'state' => $state,
        'starts_at' => $window->starts_at,
        'ends_at' => $window->ends_at,
        'hold_expires_at' => null,
    ]);
    $booking->forceFill(['claim_id' => $claim?->getKey(), 'label' => $place->label])->save();

    return $booking;
}
```

```php
<?php

use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;

/**
 * The seat picker (design §7.4): a page only the claim's registrant can
 * open, an availability map that is one query over occupying bookings, and
 * a post that goes through `AssignPlacesToRegistration` so the exclusion
 * constraint, not the page, decides a race.
 *
 * `seatPickScene()` is file-local because only this file builds a whole
 * scene; the row builders it calls live in tests/Helpers.php because the
 * slot test in Registration needs them too.
 */

/**
 * @return array{user: User, registrationId: string, eventId: string, type: ResourceType, claim: ResourceClaim, plan: Plan, places: list<Resource>, window: ResourceEventWindow}
 */
function seatPickScene(Brand $brand, int $places = 3, int $quantity = 1): array
{
    $eventId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $window = seatingEventWindow($eventId, $brand->getKey());
    $type = seatingCategory($eventId);
    ['plan' => $plan, 'places' => $rows] = seatingPublishedPlan($eventId, $type, $places);
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    $registrationId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $claim = seatingClaim($eventId, $registrationId, (string) $user->getKey(), [$type->getKey()], $quantity);

    return [
        'user' => $user,
        'registrationId' => $registrationId,
        'eventId' => $eventId,
        'type' => $type,
        'claim' => $claim,
        'plan' => $plan,
        'places' => $rows,
        'window' => $window,
    ];
}

it('marks every published, unblocked place free when nothing is booked', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $scene = seatPickScene($brand, places: 2);

    $availability = app(ComputePlanAvailability::class)->handle($scene['claim']);

    expect($availability->eventId)->toBe($scene['eventId'])
        ->and($availability->places)->toHaveCount(2)
        ->and($availability->places[$scene['places'][0]->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Free)
        ->and($availability->places[$scene['places'][1]->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Free);
});

it('tells the registrant\'s own booking apart from other people\'s holds and bookings', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $scene = seatPickScene($brand, places: 4);
    [$mine, $held, $booked, $free] = $scene['places'];

    seatingBooking($mine, $scene['window'], $scene['registrationId'], $scene['claim']);
    seatingBooking($held, $scene['window'], (string) Str::ulid(), state: BookingState::Held);
    seatingBooking($booked, $scene['window'], (string) Str::ulid());

    $places = app(ComputePlanAvailability::class)->handle($scene['claim'])->places;

    expect($places[$mine->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Mine)
        ->and($places[$held->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Held)
        ->and($places[$booked->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Booked)
        ->and($places[$free->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Free);
});

it('reports blocked places and places on unpublished plans as unavailable', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $scene = seatPickScene($brand, places: 2);
    $scene['places'][1]->forceFill(['blocked' => true])->save();

    expect($places[$scene['places'][0]->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Free)
        ->and($places[$scene['places'][1]->getKey()])->toBe(PlaceState::Unavailable)

it('ignores released bookings and places of other events', function (): void {
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the availability query**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/ComputePlanAvailability.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanAvailabilityData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\PlaceState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * The picker's availability map (design §7.4): one state per place of the
 * claim's event, computed from the projection and the occupying bookings
 * and never from the plan document (design §6.2 — the projection carries
 * no booking state, the document carries no availability).
 *
 * Precedence, highest first: `mine` (a booking of this registration —
 * the registrant must always find their own place, whatever else is true
 * of it), then `held`/`booked` for anybody else's occupying booking, then
 * `unavailable` for a blocked place or one on an unpublished plan, then
 * `free`. Two reads, no join: the place list is short (≤ 2,000 elements
 * per plan, design §12) and the second read is bounded by the first.
 *
 * Brand-scoped through `BelongsToBrand`: this runs on the brand host under
 * the registrant's session, never in the console.
 */
final class ComputePlanAvailability
{
    public function handle(ResourceClaim $claim): PlanAvailabilityData
    {
        $planIds = Plan::query()
            ->where('event_id', $claim->event_id)
            ->pluck('id');

        $places = Resource::query()
            ->whereIn('plan_id', $planIds)
            ->get(['id', 'is_published', 'blocked']);

        /** @var array<string, PlaceState> $states */
        $states = [];

        foreach ($places as $place) {
            $states[$place->getKey()] = ($place->is_published && ! $place->blocked)
                ? PlaceState::Free
                : PlaceState::Unavailable;
        }

        ResourceBooking::query()
            ->whereIn('resource_id', $places->modelKeys())
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->get(['resource_id', 'registration_id', 'state'])
            ->each(function (ResourceBooking $booking) use (&$states, $claim): void {
                if ($booking->registration_id === $claim->registration_id) {
                    $states[$booking->resource_id] = PlaceState::Mine;

                    return;
                }

                if (($states[$booking->resource_id] ?? null) === PlaceState::Mine) {
                    return;
                }

                $states[$booking->resource_id] = $booking->state === BookingState::Held
                    ? PlaceState::Held
                    : PlaceState::Booked;
            });

        return new PlanAvailabilityData(
            eventId: $claim->event_id,
            generatedAt: now()->toIso8601String(),
            places: $states,
        );
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the ownership lookup both controllers share**

`app-modules/resources/src/Actions/FindSeatClaimForRegistrant.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Actions;

use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * The one authorisation the picker has (design §7.4, §9.1): the claim of
 * this registration whose `registrant_user_id` is the signed-in account.
 * No capability is involved — ownership is not something anybody can be
 * granted — so there is no policy either, the same reasoning as
 * `MyRegistrationsController`.
 *
 * Brand-scoped through `BelongsToBrand`, so a registration made with one
 * brand has no seat page on another's host (ADR-0016 from the outside).
 * A `released` claim is a cancelled or rejected registration and has no
 * page any more; where an amendment added a second claim the newest wins
 * (TODO.md carries the multi-claim picker as a follow-up).
 */
final class FindSeatClaimForRegistrant
{
    public function handle(string $registrationId, string $userId): ?ResourceClaim
    {
        return ResourceClaim::query()
            ->where('registration_id', $registrationId)
            ->where('registrant_user_id', $userId)
            ->where('state', '!=', ClaimState::Released)
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->first();
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `transform.ts`**

The world-transform math is LanCore's, ported to millimetres: the rationale and formula at `~/git/lan-software/LanCore/resources/js/components/seating-editor/EditorCanvas.vue:29-47`, the raw-SVG pan tracking at `:421-467`, the cursor-anchored wheel zoom at `:469-503`, `fitViewToBbox` at `resources/js/components/seat-plan/geometry.ts:112-131`, the content-derived `minZoom` at `resources/js/components/seating-editor/useEditorStore.ts:62-122`. The viewBox there was a fixed `1600×1000`; here it is the plan's own `widthMm × heightMm`, fixed per plan, so 1 viewBox unit is 1 mm at zoom 1.

```ts
/**
 * Pan/zoom for the seat plan scene as one world transform (design §7.4).
 *
 * The SVG keeps a fixed viewBox of the plan's size in millimetres and
 * every element sits inside one `<g :transform="worldTransform(...)">`.
 * LanCore first mutated the viewBox and measured the cost — every
 * pointermove re-laid out every child (text metrics, stroke widths, hit
 * testing) — before moving to a single transform on one element, which the
 * browser composites (EditorCanvas.vue:29-47). Ported here with mm units.
 *
 * Mapping, with `c` the viewBox centre:
 *   svg   = (world - pan) * zoom + c
 *   world = (svg - c) / zoom + pan
 * so `pan` is the world point shown at the centre of the viewport.
 *
 * Pure functions; the scene owns the reactive state.
 */
export type Point = { x: number; y: number };
export type View = { panX: number; panY: number; zoom: number };
export type Viewport = { width: number; height: number };
export type Bbox = { minX: number; minY: number; maxX: number; maxY: number };

export const MAX_ZOOM = 8;
export const ABSOLUTE_MIN_ZOOM = 0.05;
export const FIT_PADDING = 1.2;

/** A plan smaller than this still gets a sensible fit (LanCore's 200-unit floor, in mm). */
const MIN_FIT_EXTENT_MM = 1000;

export function viewCenter(viewport: Viewport): Point {
    return { x: viewport.width / 2, y: viewport.height / 2 };
}

export function worldTransform(view: View, viewport: Viewport): string {
    const c = viewCenter(viewport);
    const tx = c.x - view.panX * view.zoom;
    const ty = c.y - view.panY * view.zoom;

    return `translate(${tx} ${ty}) scale(${view.zoom})`;
}

export function worldToSvg(world: Point, view: View, viewport: Viewport): Point {
    const c = viewCenter(viewport);

    return {
        x: (world.x - view.panX) * view.zoom + c.x,
        y: (world.y - view.panY) * view.zoom + c.y,
    };
}

export function svgToWorld(svg: Point, view: View, viewport: Viewport): Point {
    const c = viewCenter(viewport);

    return {
        x: (svg.x - c.x) / view.zoom + view.panX,
        y: (svg.y - c.y) / view.zoom + view.panY,
    };
}

/**
 * The pan for a drag from `startSvg` to `currentSvg`, both in raw viewBox
 * coordinates, against the pan and zoom captured at pointer-down.
 *
 * Raw coordinates on purpose (EditorCanvas.vue:421-431): converting the
 * pointer to world space reads the pan being written, so each frame's
 * delta is measured against a frame that already moved — one frame of
 * under-correction per frame, which reads as jitter.
 */
export function panFrom(startSvg: Point, currentSvg: Point, startPan: Point, zoom: number): Point {
    return {
        x: startPan.x - (currentSvg.x - startSvg.x) / zoom,
        y: startPan.y - (currentSvg.y - startSvg.y) / zoom,
    };
}

export function clampZoom(zoom: number, minZoom: number, maxZoom: number = MAX_ZOOM): number {
    return Math.min(Math.max(zoom, minZoom), maxZoom);
}

/**
 * Zoom by `factor` with the world point `anchor` staying where it is on
 * screen (EditorCanvas.vue:471-497). Returns the same object when the
 * clamp swallows the whole step, so a watcher can skip a no-op.
 */
export function zoomAt(view: View, anchor: Point, factor: number, minZoom: number, maxZoom: number = MAX_ZOOM): View {
    const zoom = clampZoom(view.zoom * factor, minZoom, maxZoom);
    const actual = zoom / view.zoom;

    if (actual === 1) {
        return view;
    }

    return {
        zoom,
        panX: anchor.x + (view.panX - anchor.x) / actual,
        panY: anchor.y + (view.panY - anchor.y) / actual,
    };
}

export function fitZoom(bbox: Bbox, viewport: Viewport, padding: number = FIT_PADDING): number {
    const width = Math.max(bbox.maxX - bbox.minX, MIN_FIT_EXTENT_MM);
    const height = Math.max(bbox.maxY - bbox.minY, MIN_FIT_EXTENT_MM);

    return Math.min(viewport.width / (width * padding), viewport.height / (height * padding));
}

/**
 * The zoom below which nothing more comes into view: the plan just fits
 * with padding. Capped at 1 so a tiny plan still opens at full size and
 * floored so a degenerate one never yields zero (useEditorStore.ts:62-122).
 */
export function minZoomFor(bbox: Bbox | null, viewport: Viewport, padding: number = FIT_PADDING): number {
    if (bbox === null) {
        return ABSOLUTE_MIN_ZOOM;
    }

    return Math.max(ABSOLUTE_MIN_ZOOM, Math.min(fitZoom(bbox, viewport, padding), 1));
}

export function fitToBbox(
    bbox: Bbox,
    viewport: Viewport,
    options: { padding?: number; minZoom?: number; maxZoom?: number } = {},
): View {
    const { padding = FIT_PADDING, minZoom = ABSOLUTE_MIN_ZOOM, maxZoom = MAX_ZOOM } = options;

    return {
        panX: (bbox.minX + bbox.maxX) / 2,
        panY: (bbox.minY + bbox.maxY) / 2,
        zoom: clampZoom(fitZoom(bbox, viewport, padding), minZoom, maxZoom),
    };
}

function distance(a: Point, b: Point): number {
    return Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
}

function midpoint(a: Point, b: Point): Point {
    return { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
}

/**
 * Two-finger pinch from the view at gesture start: the zoom scales by the
 * ratio of finger distances, and the world point that was under the start
 * midpoint is placed under the current midpoint — so a pinch that also
 * drifts pans as well. All points are raw viewBox coordinates.
 */
export function pinch(
    start: View,
    startA: Point,
    startB: Point,
    nowA: Point,
    nowB: Point,
    viewport: Viewport,
    minZoom: number,
    maxZoom: number = MAX_ZOOM,
): View {
    const startDistance = distance(startA, startB);

    if (startDistance === 0) {
        return start;
    }

    const zoom = clampZoom(start.zoom * (distance(nowA, nowB) / startDistance), minZoom, maxZoom);
    const anchorWorld = svgToWorld(midpoint(startA, startB), start, viewport);
    const nowMid = midpoint(nowA, nowB);
    const c = viewCenter(viewport);

    return {
        zoom,
        panX: anchorWorld.x - (nowMid.x - c.x) / zoom,
        panY: anchorWorld.y - (nowMid.y - c.y) / zoom,
    };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Write `geometry.ts`**

```ts
import type { Bbox, Point } from './transform';

/**
 * Geometry over the plan document (design §5): absolute positions from the
 * parent chain, bounding boxes per shape kind, the hit radius that keeps a
 * place tappable at any zoom, and the zone → group → place tree the list
 * view renders.
 *
 * Coordinates are integer millimetres, origin top-left, Y down, each
 * element relative to its parent. `rect` and `polygon` have their origin at
 * the top-left corner, `ellipse` and `point` at the centre. Rotation is
 * ignored for bounding boxes: it is about the element origin and the boxes
 * here only size hit targets and fit the view, where an unrotated box is
 * good enough and a rotated one costs a matrix per element.
 */
type Element = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanElementData;
type Shape = Konventix.Resources.Data.ShapeData;
type Document = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanDocumentData;
type Kind = Konventix.Resources.Enums.ElementKind;

export const DEFAULT_POINT_RADIUS_MM = 250;

/** Deeper than any sane plan; guards `absoluteOrigin` against a cyclic parent chain. */
const MAX_DEPTH = 32;

export type PlanGroupNode = { id: string; label: string; places: Element[] };
export type PlanZoneNode = { id: string; label: string; groups: PlanGroupNode[] };

export function elementIndex(document: Document): Map<string, Element> {
    return new Map(document.elements.map((element) => [element.id, element]));
}

export function absoluteOrigin(element: Element, index: Map<string, Element>): Point {
    let x = element.x;
    let y = element.y;
    let parentId = element.parentId;
    let depth = 0;

    while (parentId !== null && depth < MAX_DEPTH) {
        const parent = index.get(parentId);

        if (!parent) {
            break;
        }

        x += parent.x;
        y += parent.y;
        parentId = parent.parentId;
        depth += 1;
    }

    return { x, y };
}

export function shapeBbox(shape: Shape, origin: Point): Bbox {
    switch (shape.type) {
        case 'rect':
            return { minX: origin.x, minY: origin.y, maxX: origin.x + (shape.w ?? 0), maxY: origin.y + (shape.h ?? 0) };
        case 'ellipse': {
            const rx = shape.rx ?? 0;
            const ry = shape.ry ?? 0;

            return { minX: origin.x - rx, minY: origin.y - ry, maxX: origin.x + rx, maxY: origin.y + ry };
        }
        case 'point': {
            const r = shape.radius ?? DEFAULT_POINT_RADIUS_MM;

            return { minX: origin.x - r, minY: origin.y - r, maxX: origin.x + r, maxY: origin.y + r };
        }
        case 'polygon': {
            const points = shape.points ?? [];

            if (points.length === 0) {
                return { minX: origin.x, minY: origin.y, maxX: origin.x, maxY: origin.y };
            }

            const xs = points.map((point) => origin.x + point[0]);
            const ys = points.map((point) => origin.y + point[1]);

            return { minX: Math.min(...xs), minY: Math.min(...ys), maxX: Math.max(...xs), maxY: Math.max(...ys) };
        }
    }
}

export function shapeCenter(shape: Shape, origin: Point): Point {
    const box = shapeBbox(shape, origin);

    return { x: (box.minX + box.maxX) / 2, y: (box.minY + box.maxY) / 2 };
}

export function polygonPoints(shape: Shape, origin: Point): string {
    return (shape.points ?? []).map((point) => `${origin.x + point[0]},${origin.y + point[1]}`).join(' ');
}

export function elementBbox(element: Element, index: Map<string, Element>): Bbox {
    return shapeBbox(element.shape, absoluteOrigin(element, index));
}

export function unionBbox(a: Bbox, b: Bbox): Bbox {
    return {
        minX: Math.min(a.minX, b.minX),
        minY: Math.min(a.minY, b.minY),
        maxX: Math.max(a.maxX, b.maxX),
        maxY: Math.max(a.maxY, b.maxY),
    };
}

export function contentBbox(document: Document): Bbox | null {
    const index = elementIndex(document);
    let box: Bbox | null = null;

    for (const element of document.elements) {
        const own = elementBbox(element, index);
        box = box === null ? own : unionBbox(box, own);
    }

    return box;
}

/**
 * Half of a 44 px touch target in world millimetres at the current scale
 * (ADR-0055; design §7.4 "44 px touch targets independent of zoom").
 * `pxPerUnit` is screen pixels per viewBox unit, which the scene measures
 * from its own size; a zero (not yet laid out) falls back to 22 mm.
 */
export function hitRadiusWorld(pxPerUnit: number, zoom: number, minTargetPx = 44): number {
    const scale = pxPerUnit * zoom;

    if (scale <= 0) {
        return minTargetPx / 2;
    }

    return minTargetPx / 2 / scale;
}

export function ancestorOfKind(element: Element, index: Map<string, Element>, kind: Kind): Element | null {
    let parentId = element.parentId;
    let depth = 0;

    while (parentId !== null && depth < MAX_DEPTH) {
        const parent = index.get(parentId);

        if (!parent) {
            return null;
        }

        if (parent.kind === kind) {
            return parent;
        }

        parentId = parent.parentId;
        depth += 1;
    }

    return null;
}

/** `A-2` before `A-10`: the label schema counts, the string does not. */
export function compareRefs(a: string, b: string): number {
    return a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
}

const LOOSE_ZONE = 'Other places';
const LOOSE_GROUP = 'Ungrouped';

/**
 * Zone → group → place, zones and groups in document order, places by
 * ref. Places outside any zone or group land in trailing "Other places" /
 * "Ungrouped" nodes so the list view never drops a place the scene shows.
 */
export function planTree(document: Document): PlanZoneNode[] {
    const index = elementIndex(document);
    const zones = new Map<string, PlanZoneNode>();

    for (const element of document.elements) {
        if (element.kind === 'zone') {
            zones.set(element.id, { id: element.id, label: element.label ?? element.ref ?? 'Zone', groups: [] });
        }
    }

    const looseZone: PlanZoneNode = { id: '', label: LOOSE_ZONE, groups: [] };

    for (const element of document.elements) {
        if (element.kind !== 'place') {
            continue;
        }

        const zone = ancestorOfKind(element, index, 'zone');
        const group = ancestorOfKind(element, index, 'group');
        const zoneNode = zone ? zones.get(zone.id) ?? looseZone : looseZone;
        const groupId = group?.id ?? '';
        let groupNode = zoneNode.groups.find((candidate) => candidate.id === groupId);

        if (!groupNode) {
            groupNode = { id: groupId, label: group ? group.label ?? group.ref ?? 'Group' : LOOSE_GROUP, places: [] };
            zoneNode.groups.push(groupNode);
        }

        groupNode.places.push(element);
    }

    const tree = [...zones.values(), looseZone].filter((zone) => zone.groups.length > 0);

    for (const zone of tree) {
        for (const group of zone.groups) {
            group.places.sort((a, b) => compareRefs(a.ref ?? a.label ?? a.id, b.ref ?? b.label ?? b.id));
        }
    }

    return tree;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write `eligibility.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Whether a place can be picked, and why not (design §7.4: "taken" versus
 * "not in your category" versus "limit reached", inline, never a modal —
 * LanCore Picker.vue:348-408 drew that distinction and users understood
 * it). Mirrors the server's rules in `AssignPlacesToRegistration` so the
 * page refuses first and the Action refuses last; the constraint decides
 * a race the page could not see.
 */
type PlaceState = Konventix.Resources.Enums.PlaceState;

export type Reason =
    | 'free'
    | 'selected'
    | 'mine'
    | 'taken'
    | 'not-in-category'
    | 'unavailable'
    | 'limit-reached';

export type PlaceContext = {
    placeId: string;
    resourceTypeId: string | null;
    state: PlaceState | undefined;
    claimTypeIds: string[];
    selectedIds: string[];
    quantity: number;
};

export function placeReason(context: PlaceContext): Reason {
    if (context.selectedIds.includes(context.placeId)) {
        return 'selected';
    }

    if (context.resourceTypeId === null || !context.claimTypeIds.includes(context.resourceTypeId)) {
        return 'not-in-category';
    }

    switch (context.state) {
        case 'mine':
            return 'mine';
        case 'held':
        case 'booked':
            return 'taken';
        case 'free':
            return context.selectedIds.length >= context.quantity ? 'limit-reached' : 'free';
        default:
            return 'unavailable';
    }
}

export function isSelectable(reason: Reason): boolean {
    return reason === 'free' || reason === 'selected' || reason === 'mine';
}

const STATE_TEXT: Record<Reason, string> = {
    free: 'Free',
    selected: 'Selected',
    mine: 'Yours',
    taken: 'Taken',
    'not-in-category': 'Not in your category',
    unavailable: 'Unavailable',
    'limit-reached': 'Limit reached',
};

export function stateText(reason: Reason): string {
    return STATE_TEXT[reason];
}

export function hintFor(reason: Reason, quantity: number): string | null {
    switch (reason) {
        case 'taken':
            return 'This place is already taken.';
        case 'not-in-category':
            return 'This place is not in your category.';
        case 'unavailable':
            return 'This place is not available.';
        case 'limit-reached':
            return quantity === 1
                ? 'You can choose 1 place. Unselect it first.'
                : `You can choose ${quantity} places. Unselect one first.`;
        default:
            return null;
    }
}

export function toggleSelection(selected: string[], placeId: string, quantity: number): string[] {
    if (selected.includes(placeId)) {
        return selected.filter((id) => id !== placeId);
    }

    if (selected.length >= quantity) {
        return selected;
    }

    return [...selected, placeId];
}

/**
 * After an availability poll: a selected place that is no longer free (and
 * not the registrant's own) leaves the selection, and the caller tells the
 * person so — a silent drop and a 422 on submit would be the same surprise
 * twice.
 */
export function reconcileSelection(
    selected: string[],
    availability: Record<string, PlaceState>,
): { selected: string[]; lost: string[] } {
    const lost = selected.filter((id) => {
        const state = availability[id];

        return state !== 'free' && state !== 'mine';
    });

    return { selected: selected.filter((id) => !lost.includes(id)), lost };
}

/** Laravel keys an array-field error on the field or on `field.index`; the page shows the first. */
export function firstPlaceIdsError(errors: Record<string, string>): string | undefined {
    if (errors.placeIds) {
        return errors.placeIds;
    }

    return Object.entries(errors).find(([key]) => key.startsWith('placeIds.'))?.[1];
}
```

`app-modules/resources/resources/js/components/plan/labels.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Label visibility and the sentences the live region speaks (design §7.4:
 * labels hidden below a zoom threshold; `role="status"` announcements).
 * Per-place `<text>` at every zoom was a measurable DOM cost in LanCore
 * (EditorCanvas.vue:639-674 rendered one per seat); here they only exist
 * once they are legible.
 */
export const LABEL_MIN_PX = 9;
export const DEFAULT_LABEL_MM = 250;

/** `pxPerUnit` is screen pixels per viewBox millimetre at zoom 1. */
export function labelsVisible(zoom: number, pxPerUnit: number, fontMm: number = DEFAULT_LABEL_MM): boolean {
    return fontMm * pxPerUnit * zoom >= LABEL_MIN_PX;
}

export function placeLabel(element: { label: string | null; ref: string | null }): string {
    return element.label ?? element.ref ?? '';
}

export function containerLabel(element: { label: string | null; ref: string | null }, fallback: string): string {
    return element.label ?? element.ref ?? fallback;
}

export function selectionAnnouncement(refs: string[], quantity: number): string {
    if (refs.length === 0) {
        return `No place selected. You can choose ${quantity} ${quantity === 1 ? 'place' : 'places'}.`;
    }

    const list = refs.join(', ');

    return quantity === 1 ? `Selected ${list}.` : `Selected ${list} (${refs.length} of ${quantity}).`;
}
```

`app-modules/resources/resources/js/components/plan/tokens.ts` — the token names are the `--chart-1`…`--chart-5`, `--accent`, `--success`, `--warning`, `--danger` custom properties of `resources/css/app.css` (`:root` block lines 146-176, `.dark` block 178-208); a category carries the token name, never a colour (design §4.1, ADR-0008):

```ts
/**
 * `CategoryToken` → the CSS custom property it names (design §4.1). Only
 * `var(--…)` references leave this file: `konventix/no-palette-colors`
 * rejects any literal colour, and a brand re-colours these at runtime by
 * redeclaring the property (resources/css/app.css, layer 1).
 */
type CategoryToken = Konventix.Resources.Enums.CategoryToken;

const TOKEN_VARS: Record<CategoryToken, string> = {
    'chart-1': 'var(--chart-1)',
    'chart-2': 'var(--chart-2)',
    'chart-3': 'var(--chart-3)',
    'chart-4': 'var(--chart-4)',
    'chart-5': 'var(--chart-5)',
    accent: 'var(--accent)',
    success: 'var(--success)',
    warning: 'var(--warning)',
    danger: 'var(--danger)',
};

export function tokenVar(token: CategoryToken | null): string {
    return token === null ? TOKEN_VARS['chart-1'] : TOKEN_VARS[token];
}

/** Fills that say state, not category — colour is never the only signal (ADR-0055). */
export const STATE_FILL = {
    mine: 'var(--success)',
    taken: 'var(--surface-muted)',
    unavailable: 'var(--surface-muted)',
    selectedStroke: 'var(--accent)',
    outline: 'var(--border)',
    zone: 'var(--surface-muted)',
    text: 'var(--text)',
    textMuted: 'var(--text-muted)',
} as const;
```

```ts
import {
    Accessibility,
    Armchair,
    Circle,
    Crown,
    Gamepad2,
    Laptop,
    Monitor,
    Sofa,
    Star,
    Users,
} from '@lucide/vue';
import type { Component } from 'vue';

/**
 * Category symbols (design §4.1: a lucide key, mandatory in the picker so
 * category is never told by colour alone — BFSG). The console offers
 * these keys; an unknown one falls back to a plain circle rather than to
 * nothing, the same rule as `navIcons.ts`.
 */
const symbolMap: Record<string, Component> = {
    accessibility: Accessibility,
    armchair: Armchair,
    crown: Crown,
    'gamepad-2': Gamepad2,
    laptop: Laptop,
    monitor: Monitor,
    sofa: Sofa,
    star: Star,
    users: Users,
};

export const SYMBOL_KEYS = Object.keys(symbolMap);

export function symbolFor(symbol: string | null): Component {
    return (symbol !== null && symbolMap[symbol]) || Circle;
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { DEFAULT_POINT_RADIUS_MM, polygonPoints } from './geometry';
import type { Point } from './transform';

/**
 * One document shape as SVG (design §5): rect and polygon from their
 * top-left origin, ellipse and point from their centre, rotated about the
 * origin. Fill and stroke arrive as `var(--token)` strings from tokens.ts.
 */
type Shape = Konventix.Resources.Data.ShapeData;

const props = withDefaults(
    defineProps<{
        shape: Shape;
        origin: Point;
        rotation?: number;
        fill: string;
        stroke?: string;
        strokeWidth?: number;
        opacity?: number;
    }>(),
    { rotation: 0, stroke: 'none', strokeWidth: 0, opacity: 1 },
);

const rotate = computed(() =>
    props.rotation === 0
        ? undefined
        : `rotate(${props.rotation} ${props.origin.x} ${props.origin.y})`,
);
</script>

<template>
    <rect
        v-if="shape.type === 'rect'"
        :x="origin.x"
        :y="origin.y"
        :width="shape.w ?? 0"
        :height="shape.h ?? 0"
        :rx="shape.radius ?? 0"
        :fill="fill"
        :stroke="stroke"
        :stroke-width="strokeWidth"
        :opacity="opacity"
        :transform="rotate"
    />
    <ellipse
        v-else-if="shape.type === 'ellipse'"
        :cx="origin.x"
        :cy="origin.y"
        :rx="shape.rx ?? 0"
        :ry="shape.ry ?? 0"
        :fill="fill"
        :stroke="stroke"
        :stroke-width="strokeWidth"
        :opacity="opacity"
        :transform="rotate"
    />
    <circle
        v-else-if="shape.type === 'point'"
        :cx="origin.x"
        :cy="origin.y"
        :r="shape.radius ?? DEFAULT_POINT_RADIUS_MM"
        :fill="fill"
        :stroke="stroke"
        :stroke-width="strokeWidth"
        :opacity="opacity"
    />
    <polygon
        v-else
        :points="polygonPoints(shape, origin)"
        :fill="fill"
        :stroke="stroke"
        :stroke-width="strokeWidth"
        :opacity="opacity"
        :transform="rotate"
    />
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `SeatPlanScene.vue`**

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useElementSize } from '@vueuse/core';
import { Minus, Plus, Scan } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed, reactive, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { Reason } from './eligibility';
import { isSelectable, placeReason } from './eligibility';
import {
    absoluteOrigin,
    contentBbox,
    elementIndex,
    hitRadiusWorld,
    shapeBbox,
    shapeCenter,
} from './geometry';
import { labelsVisible, placeLabel } from './labels';
import PlanShape from './PlanShape.vue';
import { symbolFor } from './symbols';
import { STATE_FILL, tokenVar } from './tokens';
import type { Bbox, Point, View } from './transform';
import {
    ABSOLUTE_MIN_ZOOM,
    fitToBbox,
    minZoomFor,
    panFrom,
    pinch,
    svgToWorld,
    worldTransform,
    zoomAt,
} from './transform';

/**
 * The plan as an SVG scene (design §7.4): a fixed viewBox of the plan's
 * size in mm, one world `<g transform>`, pointer pan flushed once per
 * animation frame, wheel zoom anchored at the cursor, two-finger pinch
 * through a pointer map, a `<pattern>` grid, one `<symbol>` per category
 * that every place `<use>`s, labels only above a legibility threshold, and
 * an invisible enlarged hit shape so a place stays a 44 px target at any
 * zoom. The math is transform.ts / geometry.ts; this file only wires
 * events to it.
 *
 * Not the keyboard path: the SVG is an image with a pointer, the list view
 * beside it is the same choice as buttons. Every ineligible place still
 * renders, hatched and with a text state in the list.
 */
type Plan = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanViewData;
type Category = Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData;
type Claim = Konventix.Resources.Data.SeatClaimData;
type Element = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanElementData;
type PlaceState = Konventix.Resources.Enums.PlaceState;

type Placed = { element: Element; origin: Point; center: Point; box: Bbox };
type RenderedPlace = Placed & { category: Category | undefined; reason: Reason };

const props = defineProps<{
    plan: Plan;
    categories: Category[];
    claim: Claim;
    availability: Record<string, PlaceState>;
    selectedIds: string[];
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
    toggle: [placeId: string];
    hint: [reason: Reason];
}>();

const svgRef = ref<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
const { width: clientWidth, height: clientHeight } = useElementSize(svgRef);

const viewport = computed(() => ({ width: props.plan.widthMm, height: props.plan.heightMm }));

/** Screen pixels per viewBox unit under `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"`. */
const pxPerUnit = computed(() => {
    if (!clientWidth.value || !clientHeight.value) {
        return 0;
    }

    return Math.min(clientWidth.value / viewport.value.width, clientHeight.value / viewport.value.height);
});

const index = computed(() => elementIndex(props.plan.document));
const bbox = computed(() => contentBbox(props.plan.document));
const minZoom = computed(() => minZoomFor(bbox.value, viewport.value));

function initialView(): View {
    const box = bbox.value ?? { minX: 0, minY: 0, maxX: viewport.value.width, maxY: viewport.value.height };

    return fitToBbox(box, viewport.value, { minZoom: minZoom.value });
}

const view = reactive<View>(initialView());

watch(() => props.plan.id, () => Object.assign(view, initialView()));

const transform = computed(() => worldTransform(view, viewport.value));
const showLabels = computed(() => labelsVisible(view.zoom, pxPerUnit.value));
const hitRadius = computed(() => hitRadiusWorld(pxPerUnit.value, view.zoom));
const categoryById = computed(() => new Map(props.categories.map((category) => [category.id, category])));

function place(element: Element): Placed {
    const origin = absoluteOrigin(element, index.value);

    return { element, origin, center: shapeCenter(element.shape, origin), box: shapeBbox(element.shape, origin) };
}

const zones = computed(() => props.plan.document.elements.filter((e) => e.kind === 'zone').map(place));
const fixtures = computed(() => props.plan.document.elements.filter((e) => e.kind === 'fixture').map(place));
const annotations = computed(() => props.plan.document.elements.filter((e) => e.kind === 'annotation').map(place));

const places = computed<RenderedPlace[]>(() =>
    props.plan.document.elements
        .filter((e) => e.kind === 'place')
        .map((element) => ({
            ...place(element),
            category: element.resourceTypeId === null ? undefined : categoryById.value.get(element.resourceTypeId),
            reason: placeReason({
                placeId: element.id,
                resourceTypeId: element.resourceTypeId,
                state: props.availability[element.id],
                claimTypeIds: props.claim.resourceTypeIds,
                selectedIds: props.selectedIds,
                quantity: props.claim.quantity,
            }),
        })),
);

function fillFor(item: RenderedPlace): string {
    switch (item.reason) {
        case 'mine':
            return STATE_FILL.mine;
        case 'taken':
            return STATE_FILL.taken;
        case 'unavailable':
            return STATE_FILL.unavailable;
        default:
            return tokenVar(item.category?.token ?? null);
    }
}

function hatched(item: RenderedPlace): boolean {
    return !isSelectable(item.reason);
}

function symbolSize(item: RenderedPlace): number {
    return Math.min(item.box.maxX - item.box.minX, item.box.maxY - item.box.minY) * 0.6;
}

function hitR(item: RenderedPlace): number {
    const half = Math.hypot(item.box.maxX - item.box.minX, item.box.maxY - item.box.minY) / 2;

    return Math.max(hitRadius.value, half);
}

/* --- Pointer handling: one map of active pointers in raw viewBox coordinates --- */

const pointers = new Map<number, Point>();
let pan: { startSvg: Point; startPan: Point; zoom: number; pending: Point; raf: number | null } | null = null;
let pinchStart: { view: View; a: Point; b: Point; ids: [number, number] } | null = null;
let moved = false;

function svgPointRaw(event: PointerEvent | WheelEvent): Point {
    const svg = svgRef.value;

    if (!svg) {
        return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    }

    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
    pt.x = event.clientX;
    pt.y = event.clientY;
    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();

    if (!ctm) {
        return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    }

    const p = pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());

    return { x: p.x, y: p.y };
}

function flushPan(): void {
    if (!pan) {
        return;
    }

    pan.raf = null;
    view.panX = pan.pending.x;
    view.panY = pan.pending.y;
}

function stopPan(): void {
    if (pan?.raf !== null && pan?.raf !== undefined) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(pan.raf);
        flushPan();
    }

    pan = null;
}

function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    const svg = svgRef.value;

    if (!svg) {
        return;
    }

    svg.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    pointers.set(event.pointerId, svgPointRaw(event));
    moved = false;

    if (pointers.size === 1) {
        pinchStart = null;
        pan = {
            startSvg: svgPointRaw(event),
            startPan: { x: view.panX, y: view.panY },
            zoom: view.zoom,
            pending: { x: view.panX, y: view.panY },
            raf: null,
        };

        return;
    }

    if (pointers.size === 2) {
        stopPan();
        const [[idA, a], [idB, b]] = [...pointers.entries()];
        pinchStart = { view: { ...view }, a, b, ids: [idA, idB] };
    }
}

function onPointerMove(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) {
        return;
    }

    const current = svgPointRaw(event);
    pointers.set(event.pointerId, current);

    if (pinchStart) {
        const nowA = pointers.get(pinchStart.ids[0]);
        const nowB = pointers.get(pinchStart.ids[1]);

        if (nowA && nowB) {
            Object.assign(view, pinch(pinchStart.view, pinchStart.a, pinchStart.b, nowA, nowB, viewport.value, minZoom.value));
            moved = true;
        }

        return;
    }

    if (!pan) {
        return;
    }

    pan.pending = panFrom(pan.startSvg, current, pan.startPan, pan.zoom);

    if (Math.hypot(current.x - pan.startSvg.x, current.y - pan.startSvg.y) * pxPerUnit.value > 4) {
        moved = true;
    }

    if (pan.raf === null) {
        pan.raf = requestAnimationFrame(flushPan);
    }
}

function onPointerUp(event: PointerEvent): void {
    pointers.delete(event.pointerId);

    try {
        svgRef.value?.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    } catch {
        /* already released */
    }

    stopPan();
    pinchStart = null;
}

function onWheel(event: WheelEvent): void {
    const anchor = svgToWorld(svgPointRaw(event), view, viewport.value);
    Object.assign(view, zoomAt(view, anchor, event.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1, minZoom.value));
}

function zoomStep(factor: number): void {
    Object.assign(view, zoomAt(view, { x: view.panX, y: view.panY }, factor, minZoom.value));
}

function resetView(): void {
    Object.assign(view, initialView());
}

function onPlaceClick(item: RenderedPlace): void {
    if (moved) {
        return;
    }

    if (isSelectable(item.reason)) {
        emit('toggle', item.element.id);

        return;
    }

    emit('hint', item.reason);
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-raised">
        <svg
            ref="svgRef"
            :viewBox="`0 0 ${viewport.width} ${viewport.height}`"
            preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
            class="block h-[60vh] w-full touch-none select-none"
            role="img"
            :aria-label="`Seat plan ${plan.name}. Drag to pan, pinch or scroll to zoom. Use the list below to choose by keyboard.`"
            @pointerdown="onPointerDown"
            @pointermove="onPointerMove"
            @pointerup="onPointerUp"
            @pointercancel="onPointerUp"
            @wheel.prevent="onWheel"
        >
            <defs>
                <pattern id="seat-grid" width="1000" height="1000" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                    <path d="M 1000 0 L 0 0 0 1000" fill="none" :stroke="STATE_FILL.outline" stroke-width="10" />
                </pattern>
                <pattern id="seat-hatch" width="200" height="200" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
                    <rect width="80" height="200" :fill="STATE_FILL.textMuted" opacity="0.35" />
                </pattern>
                <symbol
                    v-for="category in categories"
                    :id="`seat-symbol-${category.id}`"
                    :key="category.id"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                    <component :is="symbolFor(category.symbol)" />
                </symbol>
            </defs>

            <g :transform="transform">
                <rect x="-100000" y="-100000" width="200000" height="200000" fill="url(#seat-grid)" />

                <g v-for="zone in zones" :key="zone.element.id">
                    <PlanShape
                        :shape="zone.element.shape"
                        :origin="zone.origin"
                        :rotation="zone.element.rotation"
                        :fill="tokenVar(zone.element.token)"
                        :stroke="STATE_FILL.outline"
                        :stroke-width="20"
                        :opacity="0.12"
                    />
                    <text
                        :x="zone.box.minX + 200"
                        :y="zone.box.minY + 500"
                        font-size="400"
                        :fill="STATE_FILL.text"
                    >
                        {{ zone.element.label ?? zone.element.ref ?? '' }}
                    </text>
                </g>

                <PlanShape
                    v-for="fixture in fixtures"
                    :key="fixture.element.id"
                    :shape="fixture.element.shape"
                    :origin="fixture.origin"
                    :rotation="fixture.element.rotation"
                    :fill="STATE_FILL.zone"
                    :stroke="STATE_FILL.outline"
                    :stroke-width="20"
                />

                <text
                    v-for="note in annotations"
                    :key="note.element.id"
                    :x="note.origin.x"
                    :y="note.origin.y"
                    :font-size="note.element.fontSizeMm ?? 300"
                    :fill="STATE_FILL.textMuted"
                >
                    {{ note.element.text ?? '' }}
                </text>

                <g
                    v-for="item in places"
                    :key="item.element.id"
                    :data-place-id="item.element.id"
                    :data-state="item.reason"
                    :class="isSelectable(item.reason) ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-not-allowed'"
                    @click="onPlaceClick(item)"
                >
                    <PlanShape
                        :shape="item.element.shape"
                        :origin="item.origin"
                        :rotation="item.element.rotation"
                        :fill="fillFor(item)"
                        :stroke="item.reason === 'selected' ? STATE_FILL.selectedStroke : STATE_FILL.outline"
                        :stroke-width="item.reason === 'selected' ? 80 : 15"
                    />
                    <PlanShape
                        v-if="hatched(item)"
                        :shape="item.element.shape"
                        :origin="item.origin"
                        :rotation="item.element.rotation"
                        fill="url(#seat-hatch)"
                    />
                    <use
                        v-if="item.category"
                        :href="`#seat-symbol-${item.category.id}`"
                        :x="item.center.x - symbolSize(item) / 2"
                        :y="item.center.y - symbolSize(item) / 2"
                        :width="symbolSize(item)"
                        :height="symbolSize(item)"
                        class="pointer-events-none text-text"
                    />
                    <text
                        v-if="showLabels"
                        :x="item.center.x"
                        :y="item.box.maxY + 280"
                        text-anchor="middle"
                        font-size="250"
                        :fill="STATE_FILL.text"
                        class="pointer-events-none"
                    >
                        {{ placeLabel(item.element) }}
                    </text>
                    <circle :cx="item.center.x" :cy="item.center.y" :r="hitR(item)" fill="transparent" />
                </g>
            </g>
        </svg>

        <div class="absolute right-3 bottom-3 flex flex-col gap-1">
            <button
                type="button"
                class="inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-border bg-surface text-text hover:bg-subtle"
                aria-label="Zoom in"
                @click="zoomStep(1.25)"
            >
                <Plus class="size-4" />
            </button>
            <button
                type="button"
                class="inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-border bg-surface text-text hover:bg-subtle"
                aria-label="Zoom out"
                @click="zoomStep(0.8)"
            >
                <Minus class="size-4" />
            </button>
            <button
                type="button"
                class="inline-flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-border bg-surface text-text hover:bg-subtle"
                aria-label="Show the whole plan"
                @click="resetView"
            >
                <Scan class="size-4" />
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `PlanListView.vue`**

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { Reason } from './eligibility';
import { hintFor, isSelectable, placeReason, stateText } from './eligibility';
import { planTree } from './geometry';
import { placeLabel } from './labels';

/**
 * The same choice as the scene, as buttons (design §7.4; ADR-0055): zone
 * → group → place, `aria-pressed` for the selection, `aria-disabled`
 * rather than `disabled` so an ineligible place still explains itself on
 * activation instead of being skipped by the tab order. Every place the
 * scene renders is here, with its state as text.
 */
type Plan = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanViewData;
type Category = Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData;
type Claim = Konventix.Resources.Data.SeatClaimData;
type Element = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanElementData;
type PlaceState = Konventix.Resources.Enums.PlaceState;

const props = defineProps<{
    plan: Plan;
    categories: Category[];
    claim: Claim;
    availability: Record<string, PlaceState>;
    selectedIds: string[];
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
    toggle: [placeId: string];
    hint: [reason: Reason];
}>();

const tree = computed(() => planTree(props.plan.document));
const categoryName = computed(() => new Map(props.categories.map((c) => [c.id, c.name])));

function reasonOf(element: Element): Reason {
    return placeReason({
        placeId: element.id,
        resourceTypeId: element.resourceTypeId,
        state: props.availability[element.id],
        claimTypeIds: props.claim.resourceTypeIds,
        selectedIds: props.selectedIds,
        quantity: props.claim.quantity,
    });
}

function onActivate(element: Element): void {
    const reason = reasonOf(element);

    if (isSelectable(reason)) {
        emit('toggle', element.id);

        return;
    }

    emit('hint', reason);
}

function describe(element: Element): string {
    const reason = reasonOf(element);
    const category = element.resourceTypeId ? categoryName.value.get(element.resourceTypeId) : undefined;

    return [category, stateText(reason), hintFor(reason, props.claim.quantity)].filter(Boolean).join('. ');
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <p v-if="tree.length === 0" class="text-sm text-text-muted">
            This plan has no places yet.
        </p>
        <section
            v-for="zone in tree"
            :key="zone.id || 'loose'"
            class="flex flex-col gap-3"
            :aria-labelledby="`plan-zone-${plan.id}-${zone.id || 'loose'}`"
        >
            <h3 :id="`plan-zone-${plan.id}-${zone.id || 'loose'}`" class="text-base font-medium">
                {{ zone.label }}
            </h3>
            <div v-for="group in zone.groups" :key="group.id || 'loose'" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <h4 class="text-sm text-text-muted">{{ group.label }}</h4>
                <ul class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <li v-for="element in group.places" :key="element.id">
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="inline-flex min-h-11 min-w-11 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-md border px-3 py-1 text-sm aria-pressed:border-accent aria-pressed:bg-accent aria-pressed:text-on-accent aria-disabled:cursor-not-allowed aria-disabled:opacity-60"
                            :class="reasonOf(element) === 'mine' ? 'border-success text-success' : 'border-border'"
                            :aria-pressed="selectedIds.includes(element.id)"
                            :aria-disabled="!isSelectable(reasonOf(element))"
                            :aria-label="`${placeLabel(element)}. ${describe(element)}`"
                            @click="onActivate(element)"
                        >
                            <span class="font-medium">{{ placeLabel(element) }}</span>
                            <span class="text-xs">{{ stateText(reasonOf(element)) }}</span>
                        </button>
                    </li>
                </ul>
            </div>
        </section>
    </div>
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `PlanTabs.vue` and `SelectionHints.vue`**

`PlanTabs.vue` — no shadcn tabs component ships in `resources/js/components/ui/` (Task-time listing: alert, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, button, card, checkbox, collapsible, dialog, dropdown-menu, input, label, navigation-menu, select, separator, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, sonner, spinner, tooltip), so this is a hand-rolled WAI-ARIA tab list:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
/**
 * One tab per published plan (design §7.4). Roving tabindex with arrow
 * keys, Home and End — the tab list is the first thing a keyboard user
 * meets on the page, and a plan that cannot be reached cannot be chosen
 * from.
 */
type Plan = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanViewData;

const props = defineProps<{
    plans: Plan[];
    modelValue: string;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
    'update:modelValue': [id: string];
}>();

function select(id: string): void {
    emit('update:modelValue', id);
}

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent, index: number): void {
    const last = props.plans.length - 1;
    const next: Record<string, number> = {
        ArrowRight: index === last ? 0 : index + 1,
        ArrowLeft: index === 0 ? last : index - 1,
        Home: 0,
        End: last,
    };

    if (!(event.key in next)) {
        return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    const target = props.plans[next[event.key]];
    select(target.id);
    (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).parentElement
        ?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="tab"]')
        [next[event.key]]?.focus();
}
</script>

<template>
    <div role="tablist" aria-label="Plans" class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-border">
        <button
            v-for="(plan, index) in plans"
            :id="`plan-tab-${plan.id}`"
            :key="plan.id"
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            :aria-selected="plan.id === modelValue"
            :aria-controls="`plan-panel-${plan.id}`"
            :tabindex="plan.id === modelValue ? 0 : -1"
            class="-mb-px min-h-11 border-b-2 px-3 text-sm aria-selected:border-accent aria-selected:font-medium aria-selected:text-text"
            :class="plan.id === modelValue ? '' : 'border-transparent text-text-muted hover:text-text'"
            @click="select(plan.id)"
            @keydown="onKeydown($event, index)"
        >
            {{ plan.name }}<template v-if="plan.floorLabel"> · {{ plan.floorLabel }}</template>
        </button>
    </div>
</template>
```

```php
        ->and($scene['claim']->fresh()->state)->toBe(ClaimState::Placed);
});

it('reports a place taken meanwhile as a placeIds error and books nothing', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $scene = seatPickScene($brand, places: 1);
    seatingBooking($scene['places'][0], $scene['window'], (string) Str::ulid());

    $this->actingAs($scene['user'])
        ->from('/my/registrations/'.$scene['registrationId'].'/seat')
        ->post('/my/registrations/'.$scene['registrationId'].'/seat', ['placeIds' => [$scene['places'][0]->getKey()]])
        ->assertRedirect('/my/registrations/'.$scene['registrationId'].'/seat')
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('placeIds');

    // The refusal happened inside the Action's own transaction (a
    // savepoint under RefreshDatabase), so the connection is still usable.
    expect(ResourceBooking::query()->where('registration_id', $scene['registrationId'])->count())->toBe(0)
        ->and($scene['claim']->fresh()->state)->toBe(ClaimState::Unplaced);
});

it('refuses an empty pick before touching the Action', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $scene = seatPickScene($brand);

    $this->actingAs($scene['user'])
        ->from('/my/registrations/'.$scene['registrationId'].'/seat')
        ->post('/my/registrations/'.$scene['registrationId'].'/seat', ['placeIds' => []])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('placeIds');
});
```

```php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Konventix\Resources\Http\Controllers\SeatAvailabilityController;
use Konventix\Resources\Http\Controllers\SeatPickController;

// The seat picker (design §7.4). `{registration}` is a plain ULID, not a
// route-model binding: Resources may not import Registration's model
// (ADR-0004), and the claim row is what authorises anyway — the controller
// loads the `ResourceClaim` by registration id under the brand scope and
// 404s unless the signed-in account is its registrant. No `require-consent`,
// for the same reason `registration.mine.*` carries none: choosing a seat
// for a contract already entered is not a new contract. The module gate
// comes from the provider (gateable module), never from this file.
Route::middleware(['auth'])->group(function (): void {
    Route::get('/my/registrations/{registration}/seat', [SeatPickController::class, 'show'])
        ->name('resources.seating.pick');

    Route::post('/my/registrations/{registration}/seat', [SeatPickController::class, 'store'])
        ->name('resources.seating.pick.store');

    Route::get('/my/registrations/{registration}/seat/availability', [SeatAvailabilityController::class, 'show'])
        ->name('resources.seating.availability');
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `SeatPickController`**

`app-modules/resources/src/Http/Controllers/SeatPickController.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\AssignPlacesToRegistration;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ComputePlanAvailability;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\FindSeatClaimForRegistrant;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\CategoryData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PickPlacesData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanViewData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\SeatClaimData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\SeatPickerData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * The seat picker (design §7.4): the page a confirmed registrant opens from
 * "Meine Registrierung" to choose their places, and the post that saves the
 * choice. Translates HTTP to Data and Actions and nothing more.
 *
 * No `Gate::authorize()` here, deliberately (design §9.1): the picker needs
 * no capability, ownership of the claim is the whole authorisation, and
 * `FindSeatClaimForRegistrant` answers null — a 404, so a stranger learns
 * nothing about whether the registration exists — for anybody else.
 *
 * Every category of the event is sent, not only the claim's: all places
 * render and the ineligible ones say why (design §7.4). Only published
 * plans are sent; availability still names places on unpublished plans as
 * `unavailable` so the map and the plan list cannot disagree.
 */
final class SeatPickController
{
    public function show(
        Request $request,
        string $registration,
        FindSeatClaimForRegistrant $claims,
        ComputePlanAvailability $availability,
    ): Response {
        $claim = $claims->handle($registration, (string) $request->user()->getAuthIdentifier());
        abort_if($claim === null, 404);

        $categories = ResourceType::query()
            ->where('event_id', $claim->event_id)
            ->orderBy('sort_order')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (ResourceType $type): CategoryData => new CategoryData(
                id: $type->getKey(),
                name: $type->name,
                token: $type->token,
                symbol: $type->symbol,
                description: $type->description,
            ))
            ->all();

        $plans = Plan::query()
            ->where('event_id', $claim->event_id)
            ->whereNotNull('published_at')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (Plan $plan): PlanViewData => new PlanViewData(
                id: $plan->getKey(),
                name: $plan->name,
                floorLabel: $plan->floor_label,
                widthMm: $plan->width_mm,
                heightMm: $plan->height_mm,
                background: $plan->background,
                document: $plan->document,
            ))
            ->all();

        $currentPlaceIds = ResourceBooking::query()
            ->where('claim_id', $claim->getKey())
            ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->pluck('resource_id')
            ->all();

        $data = new SeatPickerData(
            registrationId: $registration,
            claim: new SeatClaimData(
                id: $claim->getKey(),
                resourceTypeIds: $claim->resource_type_ids,
                seatingMode: $claim->seating_mode,
                quantity: $claim->quantity,
                state: $claim->state,
            ),
            categories: $categories,
            plans: $plans,
            availability: $availability->handle($claim),
            currentPlaceIds: $currentPlaceIds,
        );

        return Inertia::render('seating/Pick', $data->toArray());
    }

    /**
     * Ownership before validation, on purpose: a stranger posting garbage
     * gets the same 404 as a stranger reading, not a 422 that confirms the
     * address. The Action throws `ValidationException` on `placeIds` for a
     * refused place, and Inertia carries that back to the form.
     */
    public function store(
        Request $request,
        string $registration,
        FindSeatClaimForRegistrant $claims,
        AssignPlacesToRegistration $assign,
    ): RedirectResponse {
        $userId = (string) $request->user()->getAuthIdentifier();
        $claim = $claims->handle($registration, $userId);
        abort_if($claim === null, 404);

        $data = PickPlacesData::validateAndCreate($request);

        $assign->handle($claim, $data->placeIds, 'registrant', $userId);

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Your seat is saved.')]);

        return to_route('registration.mine.show', ['registration' => $registration]);
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ComputePlanAvailability;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\FindSeatClaimForRegistrant;

/**
 * The picker's 15-second poll (design §7.4): plain JSON, the same
 * `PlanAvailabilityData` the page was rendered with, behind the same
 * ownership check. Not an Inertia partial reload — the page keeps the
 * person's selection in local state and only wants the map, and a JSON
 * endpoint is what `useHttp` is for (Inertia v3). Same shape as
 * `WaitingRoomController::status()`.
 */
final class SeatAvailabilityController
{
    public function show(
        Request $request,
        string $registration,
        FindSeatClaimForRegistrant $claims,
        ComputePlanAvailability $availability,
    ): JsonResponse {
        $claim = $claims->handle($registration, (string) $request->user()->getAuthIdentifier());
        abort_if($claim === null, 404);

        return response()->json($availability->handle($claim));
    }
}
```
