- [ ] **Step 7: Write the page**

`app-modules/resources/resources/js/pages/seating/Pick.vue`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Form, Head, Link, useHttp } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { ArrowLeft } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import SeatAvailabilityController from '@/actions/Konventix/Resources/Http/Controllers/SeatAvailabilityController';
import SeatPickController from '@/actions/Konventix/Resources/Http/Controllers/SeatPickController';
import Heading from '@/components/Heading.vue';
import InputError from '@/components/InputError.vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { show as showRegistration } from '@/routes/registration/mine';
import type { Reason } from '../../components/plan/eligibility';
import {
    firstPlaceIdsError,
    hintFor,
    reconcileSelection,
    toggleSelection,
} from '../../components/plan/eligibility';
import { placeLabel } from '../../components/plan/labels';
import { selectionAnnouncement } from '../../components/plan/labels';
import PlanListView from '../../components/plan/PlanListView.vue';
import PlanTabs from '../../components/plan/PlanTabs.vue';
import SeatPlanScene from '../../components/plan/SeatPlanScene.vue';
import SelectionHints from '../../components/plan/SelectionHints.vue';

/**
 * Choose your seat (design §7.4). One tab per published plan, the SVG
 * scene and the list view side by side over the same selection, hints in
 * a live region, and a plain form post of `placeIds[]` to
 * `SeatPickController@store` — the Action and the exclusion constraint
 * decide, the page only refuses what it can already see.
 *
 * Availability polls every 15 s through `useHttp` against the JSON
 * endpoint while the tab is visible; a selected place somebody else took
 * meanwhile leaves the selection with a spoken hint, so the submit does
 * not fail on something the person could not know.
 */
type Props = Konventix.Resources.Data.SeatPickerData;
type Availability = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanAvailabilityData;
type PlaceState = Konventix.Resources.Enums.PlaceState;

const props = defineProps<Props>();

const activePlanId = ref(props.plans[0]?.id ?? '');
const activePlan = computed(() => props.plans.find((plan) => plan.id === activePlanId.value) ?? null);

const availability = ref<Record<string, PlaceState>>({ ...props.availability.places });
const selected = ref<string[]>([...props.currentPlaceIds]);
const hint = ref<string | null>(null);

const refById = computed(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, string>();

    for (const plan of props.plans) {
        for (const element of plan.document.elements) {
            if (element.kind === 'place') {
                map.set(element.id, placeLabel(element));
            }
        }
    }

    return map;
});

const announcement = computed(() =>
    selectionAnnouncement(
        selected.value.map((id) => refById.value.get(id) ?? id),
        props.claim.quantity,
    ),
);

function onToggle(placeId: string): void {
    hint.value = null;
    selected.value = toggleSelection(selected.value, placeId, props.claim.quantity);
}

function onHint(reason: Reason): void {
    hint.value = hintFor(reason, props.claim.quantity);
}

const http = useHttp<Record<string, never>, Availability>();
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;

function refreshAvailability(): void {
    if (document.hidden || http.processing) {
        return;
    }

    http.get(SeatAvailabilityController.show.url(props.registrationId), {
        onSuccess: (response) => {
            availability.value = response.places;
        },
    }).catch(() => undefined);
}

onMounted(() => {
    timer = setInterval(refreshAvailability, 15_000);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    if (timer) {
        clearInterval(timer);
    }

    http.cancel();
});

watch(availability, (places) => {
    const result = reconcileSelection(selected.value, places);

    if (result.lost.length === 0) {
        return;
    }

    selected.value = result.selected;
    const names = result.lost.map((id) => refById.value.get(id) ?? id).join(', ');
    hint.value = `${names} ${result.lost.length === 1 ? 'was' : 'were'} just taken by somebody else.`;
});
</script>

<template>
    <Head title="Choose your seat" />

    <div class="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 py-6">
        <div>
            <Link
                :href="showRegistration(props.registrationId)"
                class="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-text-muted hover:text-text"
            >
                <ArrowLeft class="size-4" />
                Your registration
            </Link>

            <Heading
                as="h1"
                title="Choose your seat"
                :description="
                    props.claim.quantity === 1
                        ? 'Pick one place from the categories your registration includes.'
                        : `Pick up to ${props.claim.quantity} places from the categories your registration includes.`
                "
            />
        </div>

        <p v-if="props.plans.length === 0" class="text-sm text-text-muted" role="status">
            No seat plan has been published for this event yet. Come back later.
        </p>

        <template v-else>
            <PlanTabs v-if="props.plans.length > 1" v-model="activePlanId" :plans="props.plans" />

            <div
                v-if="activePlan"
                :id="`plan-panel-${activePlan.id}`"
                role="tabpanel"
                :aria-labelledby="props.plans.length > 1 ? `plan-tab-${activePlan.id}` : undefined"
                class="flex flex-col gap-6"
            >
                <ul class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-xs text-text-muted" aria-label="Categories">
                    <li v-for="category in props.categories" :key="category.id" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span
                            class="inline-block size-3 rounded-sm"
                            :class="props.claim.resourceTypeIds.includes(category.id) ? '' : 'opacity-40'"
                            :style="{ background: `var(--${category.token})` }"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                        />
                        {{ category.name }}<template v-if="!props.claim.resourceTypeIds.includes(category.id)"> (not yours)</template>
                    </li>
                </ul>

                <SeatPlanScene
                    :plan="activePlan"
                    :categories="props.categories"
                    :claim="props.claim"
                    :availability="availability"
                    :selected-ids="selected"
                    @toggle="onToggle"
                    @hint="onHint"
                />

                <SelectionHints :announcement="announcement" :hint="hint" />

                <Form
                    v-bind="SeatPickController.store.form(props.registrationId)"
                    #default="{ errors, processing }"
                    class="flex flex-col gap-4"
                >
                    <input v-for="id in selected" :key="id" type="hidden" name="placeIds[]" :value="id" />

                    <InputError :message="firstPlaceIdsError(errors)" />

                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                        <Button type="submit" :disabled="processing || selected.length === 0">
                            {{ processing ? 'Saving…' : 'Save my seat' }}
                        </Button>
                        <span class="text-sm text-text-muted">{{ announcement }}</span>
                    </div>
                </Form>

                <section class="flex flex-col gap-3" aria-labelledby="plan-list-heading">
                    <h2 id="plan-list-heading" class="text-lg font-medium">Choose from the list</h2>
                    <PlanListView
                        :plan="activePlan"
                        :categories="props.categories"
                        :claim="props.claim"
                        :availability="availability"
                        :selected-ids="selected"
                        @toggle="onToggle"
                        @hint="onHint"
                    />
                </section>
            </div>
        </template>
    </div>
</template>
```

Two notes on that file. The category legend paints `var(--${category.token})` inline: the token *is* the custom property name (design §4.1), so this is the one place a template composes a `var()` — `no-palette-colors` accepts it. The relative imports (`../../components/plan/...`) are the module's own files; `@/` resolves to the host's `resources/js` only (`tsconfig.json` `paths`).

```markdown
## Surfaces

Brand host, `routes/web/resources.php`, `web` + `auth` + the module gate
(seating design 2026-09-10, §7.4):

| Route | Name | What |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /my/registrations/{registration}/seat` | `resources.seating.pick` | The seat picker, `seating/Pick` with `SeatPickerData`. 404 unless the signed-in account is the claim's registrant. |
| `POST /my/registrations/{registration}/seat` | `resources.seating.pick.store` | `PickPlacesData { placeIds }` → `AssignPlacesToRegistration`, then back to `registration.mine.show`. |
| `GET /my/registrations/{registration}/seat/availability` | `resources.seating.availability` | JSON `PlanAvailabilityData`, polled every 15 s by the open picker. |

The picker needs no capability: ownership of the `resource_claims` row is
the authorisation (ADR-0013 has nothing to grant for "your own seat").
Availability is a read over `resource_bookings` and the projection, never
over the plan document.
```

`app-modules/registration/tests/RegistrationMineSeatSlotTest.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia;
use Konventix\Identity\Models\User;
use Konventix\Registration\Models\Registration;

/**
 * Resources' contribution to the registrant's own page (seating design
 * §7.4): the chosen place refs, or the way to the picker while the claim
 * is unplaced. The direction matters as with Commerce's settlement slot —
 * Registration has already decided the row is the reader's; Resources
 * answers for one registration id and reads no Registration table.
 *
 * Row builders (`seatingClaim`, `seatingPublishedPlan`, …) are Resources'
 * tests/Helpers.php, loaded for every worker by tests/Pest.php.
 */
function seatSlotProps(AssertableInertia $page): ?array
{
    $slot = collect($page->toArray()['props']['slots'])
        ->firstWhere('component', 'resources/SeatSummarySlot');

    return $slot === null ? null : $slot['props']['summary'];
}

it('offers the picker while the claim is unplaced', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    $registration = Registration::factory()->confirmed()->create(['registrant_user_id' => $user->getKey()]);
    $type = seatingCategory($registration->event_id);
    seatingClaim($registration->event_id, $registration->getKey(), (string) $user->getKey(), [$type->getKey()], quantity: 2);

    $this->actingAs($user)
        ->get('/my/registrations/'.$registration->getKey())
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(function (AssertableInertia $page) use ($registration): void {
            $summary = seatSlotProps($page);

            expect($summary)->not->toBeNull()
                ->and($summary['registrationId'])->toBe($registration->getKey())
                ->and($summary['claimState'])->toBe('unplaced')
                ->and($summary['quantity'])->toBe(2)
                ->and($summary['placeRefs'])->toBe([]);
        });
});

it('lists the chosen place refs once placed', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $this->activateModule('resources', $brand);
    $user = User::factory()->create();
    $registration = Registration::factory()->confirmed()->create(['registrant_user_id' => $user->getKey()]);
    $window = seatingEventWindow($registration->event_id, $brand->getKey());
    $type = seatingCategory($registration->event_id);
    ['places' => $places] = seatingPublishedPlan($registration->event_id, $type, 3);
    $claim = seatingClaim($registration->event_id, $registration->getKey(), (string) $user->getKey(), [$type->getKey()], quantity: 2, state: \Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState::Placed);
    seatingBooking($places[2], $window, $registration->getKey(), $claim);
    seatingBooking($places[0], $window, $registration->getKey(), $claim);
    // Somebody else's place on the same plan never leaks into the summary.
    seatingBooking($places[1], $window, (string) Str::ulid());

    $this->actingAs($user)
        ->get('/my/registrations/'.$registration->getKey())
        ->assertInertia(function (AssertableInertia $page): void {
            $summary = seatSlotProps($page);

            expect($summary['claimState'])->toBe('placed')
                ->and($summary['placeRefs'])->toBe(['A-01', 'A-03']);
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Data;

/**
 * What the registrant's own page shows about their seat (design §7.4,

{

     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $registrationId,
        public readonly string $claimState,
        public readonly int $quantity,
        public readonly array $placeRefs,
    ) {}

    /**

     * @param  list<string>  $placeRefs
     */
    public static function ofClaim(ResourceClaim $claim, array $placeRefs): self
    {
        return new self(

            claimState: $claim->state->value,
            quantity: $claim->quantity,
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Providers/ResourcesServiceProvider.php` — add the imports

```php
use Konventix\Platform\Slots\SlotRegistry;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\SeatSummaryData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
```

and the method below. If an earlier slice already added `registerSlots()` (design §9.2 also puts `registration.type-editor.seating-fields` there), add only the `$slots->add(...)` call to the existing method:

```php
    /**
     * Resources' card on "Meine Registrierung" (ADR-0003 enforcement point
     * 3; seating design §7.4). Registration hands over a registration id
     * it has already checked belongs to the reader; this closure answers
     * with the claim's state and place refs, reading nothing of
     * Registration's (ADR-0004). `module: 'resources'` and no `feature`:
     * the module gate is the only switch (design §2).
     *
     * `static` for the same reason as Registration's closures: the registry
     * is a singleton that outlives the request under Octane, and a closure
     * capturing `$this` would pin this provider in memory with it.
     */
    protected function registerSlots(): void
    {
        $slots = $this->app->make(SlotRegistry::class);

        $slots->add(
            slot: 'registration.mine.show',
            module: 'resources',
            component: 'resources/SeatSummarySlot',
            props: static function (array $context): array {
                $claim = ResourceClaim::query()
                    ->where('registration_id', $context['registrationId'])
                    ->where('state', '!=', ClaimState::Released)
                    ->orderByDesc('created_at')
                    ->first();

                if ($claim === null) {
                    return ['summary' => null];
                }

                $placeIds = ResourceBooking::query()
                    ->where('claim_id', $claim->getKey())
                    ->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())
                    ->pluck('resource_id');

                $refs = Resource::query()
                    ->whereKey($placeIds)
                    ->get(['id', 'ref', 'label'])
                    ->map(fn (Resource $place): string => $place->ref ?? $place->label)
                    ->sort(SORT_NATURAL)
                    ->values()
                    ->all();

                return ['summary' => SeatSummaryData::ofClaim($claim, $refs)->toArray()];
            },
            order: 20,
        );
    }
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Konventix\Event\Events\EventCreated;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\AssignPlacesToRegistration;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ConfirmResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\HoldResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\ReleaseResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\BookingState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\SeatingMode;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\ResourceBookingRefused;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceEventWindow;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;

/**
 * Resources' own numbers (ADR-0059, design §9.6): booking outcomes from the
 * module's events, plan-save outcomes in Task 44, claims and the sweep
 * heartbeat as scrape-time gauges. Brands appear as slugs; no label ever
 * carries a registration, a user or a place. Helper names prefixed
 * `seating` — Pest helpers are process-global (.ai/rules/tests.md).
 */
function seatingMetricsEventWindow(string $eventId, string $brandId): ResourceEventWindow
{
    event(new EventCreated(
        eventId: $eventId,
        brandId: $brandId,
        slug: 'e-'.Str::lower(Str::random(6)),
        name: 'Metrics event',
        startsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDay()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        endsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDays(3)->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
        timezone: 'Europe/Berlin',
        predecessorEventId: null,
    ));

    return ResourceEventWindow::withoutBrandScope()->where('event_id', $eventId)->firstOrFail();
}

it('counts held, confirmed, released and expired bookings per brand slug', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $resource = Resource::factory()->ofType(ResourceType::factory()->create())->create();

    $held = app(HoldResourceBooking::class)->handle(
        resource: $resource,
        holderType: ResourceBooking::HOLDER_REGISTRATION,
        holderId: (string) Str::ulid(),
        startsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDay(),
        endsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDays(2),
    );
    $confirmed = app(ConfirmResourceBooking::class)->handle($held);
    app(ReleaseResourceBooking::class)->handle($confirmed, BookingState::Released, 'repicked');

    $clocked = app(HoldResourceBooking::class)->handle(
        resource: $resource,
        holderType: ResourceBooking::HOLDER_REGISTRATION,
        holderId: (string) Str::ulid(),
        startsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDays(3),
        endsAt: now()->startOfHour()->addDays(4),
    );
    app(ReleaseResourceBooking::class)->handle($clocked, BookingState::Expired, 'expired');

    expect(seatingMetricsRendered())
        ->toContain('konventix_resource_bookings_total{brand="'.$brand->slug.'",outcome="held"} 2')
        ->toContain('konventix_resource_bookings_total{brand="'.$brand->slug.'",outcome="confirmed"} 1')
        ->toContain('konventix_resource_bookings_total{brand="'.$brand->slug.'",outcome="released"} 1')
        ->toContain('konventix_resource_bookings_total{brand="'.$brand->slug.'",outcome="expired"} 1');
});

it('counts a refused booking from the refusal event', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();

    event(new ResourceBookingRefused(
        brandId: $brand->id,
        eventId: (string) Str::ulid(),
        registrationId: (string) Str::ulid(),
        reason: 'unavailable',
    ));

    expect(seatingMetricsRendered())
        ->toContain('konventix_resource_bookings_total{brand="'.$brand->slug.'",outcome="refused"} 1');
});

it('records a refused pick when the exclusion constraint stops the assignment', function (): void {
    $brand = $this->withBrand();
    $eventId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $window = seatingMetricsEventWindow($eventId, $brand->id);

    $type = ResourceType::factory()->forEvent($eventId)->create();
    $plan = Plan::factory()->create(['event_id' => $eventId, 'published_at' => now()]);
    $place = Resource::factory()->ofType($type)->create(['plan_id' => $plan->id, 'ref' => 'A-01', 'label' => 'A-01', 'is_published' => true]);

    // Somebody else already holds the place for the whole event window.
    ResourceBooking::factory()->create([
        'resource_id' => $place->id,
        'starts_at' => $window->starts_at,
        'ends_at' => $window->ends_at,
    ]);

    $registrantUserId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $claim = ResourceClaim::factory()->create([
        'event_id' => $eventId,
        'registration_id' => (string) Str::ulid(),
        'registrant_user_id' => $registrantUserId,
        'resource_type_ids' => [$type->id],
        'seating_mode' => SeatingMode::Pick,
        'quantity' => 1,
        'state' => ClaimState::Unplaced,
    ]);

    // The constraint fires inside the Action's nested transaction (a
    // savepoint), so the assertions after it can still query the database.
    expect(fn () => app(AssignPlacesToRegistration::class)->handle($claim, [$place->id], 'registrant', $registrantUserId))
        ->toThrow(ValidationException::class);

    expect(seatingMetricsRendered())
        ->toContain('konventix_resource_bookings_total{brand="'.$brand->slug.'",outcome="refused"} 1')
        ->and(ResourceBooking::query()->where('claim_id', $claim->id)->whereIn('state', BookingState::occupyingValues())->count())->toBe(0);
});
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Metrics;

use Konventix\Platform\Observability\MetricDefinition;
use Konventix\Platform\Observability\MetricKind;

/**
 * Resources' entries in the metric catalogue (ADR-0059, design §9.6).
 *
 * Counters are incremented by the listeners in src/Listeners/Metrics on
 * this module's own events; gauges are answered by ResourcesGauges at
 * scrape time. Labels are bounded sets — the brand slug and an outcome —
 * never a registration, a user or a place (.ai/rules/observability.md).
 *
 * `refused` is a pick that lost the race for a place: the exclusion
 * constraint or a deadlock refused the hold and the registrant was told to
 * pick again. It is the one outcome that is not a booking state, which is
 * why it needs its own event (`ResourceBookingRefused`) rather than a row.
 */
final class ResourcesMetrics
{
    public const array BOOKING_OUTCOMES = ['held', 'confirmed', 'released', 'expired', 'refused'];

    public const array PLAN_SAVE_OUTCOMES = ['saved', 'conflict', 'invalid', 'stale'];

    /** @return list<MetricDefinition> */
    public static function definitions(): array
    {
        return [
            new MetricDefinition('resource_bookings_total', MetricKind::Counter, 'Bookings by outcome: held, confirmed, released, expired, refused.', ['brand', 'outcome']),
            new MetricDefinition('resource_plan_saves_total', MetricKind::Counter, 'Plan saves by outcome: saved, conflict, invalid, stale.', ['brand', 'outcome']),
            new MetricDefinition('resource_seat_claims_unplaced', MetricKind::Gauge, 'Seat claims whose registrant has not picked a place yet.', ['brand']),
            new MetricDefinition('resource_hold_sweep_last_run_timestamp_seconds', MetricKind::Gauge, 'When resources:expire-holds last finished a run.'),
        ];
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the gauges**

`app-modules/resources/src/Metrics/ResourcesGauges.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Metrics;

use Konventix\Platform\Brands\BrandSlugs;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Brand;
use Konventix\Resources\Console\Commands\ExpireResourceHoldsCommand;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\ClaimState;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;
use Spatie\Prometheus\Collectors\Collector;
use Spatie\Prometheus\Facades\Prometheus;

/**
 * Scrape-time gauges (ADR-0059). Each closure runs when /metrics is
 * rendered, outside any brand context, so the claim query drops the brand
 * scope and groups by brand itself.
 *
 * The unplaced-claims gauge is the number the operator watches instead of
 * a category-versus-quota validation Resources cannot perform (design §12):
 * a confirmed registration that cannot find a free place in its categories
 * stays `unplaced`, and this is where that shows.
 *
 * The heartbeat has no row until `resources:expire-holds` has run once, so
 * an instance whose brands never switched Resources on emits no series and
 * KonventixResourceHoldSweepStale stays quiet there.
 */
final class ResourcesGauges implements Collector
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        Prometheus::addGauge('Seat claims unplaced')
            ->name('resource_seat_claims_unplaced')
            ->label('brand')
            ->helpText('Seat claims whose registrant has not picked a place yet.')
            ->value(function (): array {
                $slugs = Brand::query()->pluck('slug', 'id');

                return ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
                    ->where('state', ClaimState::Unplaced)
                    ->selectRaw('brand_id, count(*) as unplaced')
                    ->groupBy('brand_id')
                    ->get()
                    ->map(fn (ResourceClaim $row): array => [
                        (int) $row->getAttribute('unplaced'),
                        [(string) ($slugs[$row->brand_id] ?? BrandSlugs::UNKNOWN)],
                    ])
                    ->all();
            });

        Prometheus::addGauge('Hold sweep heartbeat')
            ->name('resource_hold_sweep_last_run_timestamp_seconds')
            ->helpText('When resources:expire-holds last finished a run.')
            ->value(function (): array {
                $at = ExpireResourceHoldsCommand::lastRunAt();

                return $at === null ? [] : [[(float) $at->getTimestamp(), []]];
            });
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Events/ResourceBookingRefused.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Events;

/**
 * A pick lost the race for a place: the exclusion constraint (23P01) or a
 * deadlock (40P01) refused the hold inside `AssignPlacesToRegistration`,
 * nothing was written, and the registrant was asked to pick again.
 *
 * Internal to Resources — an observability signal, not part of the
 * cross-module contract (SPEC.md "Internal events"). No place id: the
 * refusal is counted per brand, never per seat or person.
 *
 * Payload is scalars/ULIDs only (ADR-0004). `reason` is `unavailable` or
 * `deadlock`.
 */
final readonly class ResourceBookingRefused
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $brandId,
        public string $eventId,
        public string $registrationId,
        public string $reason,
    ) {}
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Listeners/Metrics/RecordBookingMetrics.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Listeners\Metrics;

use Konventix\Platform\Brands\BrandSlugs;
use Konventix\Platform\Observability\Metrics;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\ResourceBookingConfirmed;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\ResourceBookingHeld;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\ResourceBookingRefused;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\ResourceBookingReleased;

/**
 * One listener for the five booking outcomes (ADR-0059, design §9.6).
 *
 * `expired` is a release with reason `expired` — the hold sweep releases
 * through `ReleaseResourceBooking` like everything else, so the counter
 * reads the reason instead of needing a fourth event. Every other release
 * reason (`registration_cancelled`, `repicked`, `plan_conflict`, …) is
 * `released`; the reason itself is not a label, it would multiply series
 * for a question nobody asks a dashboard.
 *
 * Scoped bindings are resolved inside handle() (.ai/rules/listeners.md).
 */
final class RecordBookingMetrics
{
    public function handle(ResourceBookingHeld|ResourceBookingConfirmed|ResourceBookingReleased|ResourceBookingRefused $event): void
    {
        $outcome = match (true) {
            $event instanceof ResourceBookingHeld => 'held',
            $event instanceof ResourceBookingConfirmed => 'confirmed',
            $event instanceof ResourceBookingRefused => 'refused',
            $event->reason === 'expired' => 'expired',
            default => 'released',
        };

        app(Metrics::class)->increment('resource_bookings_total', [
            'brand' => BrandSlugs::of($event->brandId),
            'outcome' => $outcome,
        ]);
    }
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Events/PlanSaveRefused.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Events;

/**
 * `SavePlan` refused a save before writing anything (design §6.1 steps
 * 0–4): `stale` for a wrong `expectedVersion`, `invalid` for a document
 * that fails the structural invariants or names a foreign id, `conflict`
 * for an occupied place removed, recategorised or blocked without a
 * resolution.
 *
 * Internal to Resources — an observability signal, not part of the
 * cross-module contract (SPEC.md "Internal events"). Dispatched after the
 * exception is caught and before it is rethrown, outside any transaction:
 * the refusing steps are read-only, the save transaction (step 6) has not
 * started. Payload is scalars/ULIDs only (ADR-0004).
 */
final readonly class PlanSaveRefused
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $planId,
        public string $eventId,
        public string $brandId,
        public string $outcome,
    ) {}
}
```

`app-modules/resources/src/Listeners/Metrics/RecordPlanMetrics.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Listeners\Metrics;

use Konventix\Platform\Brands\BrandSlugs;
use Konventix\Platform\Observability\Metrics;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\PlanSaved;
use Konventix\Resources\Events\PlanSaveRefused;

/**
 * Plan saves by outcome (ADR-0059, design §9.6): `saved` from the contract
 * event, the three refusals from the internal one. A 422 the request's
 * Data rules produce before `SavePlan` is reached is a shape error the
 * HTTP counters already see (`http_requests_total{status="422"}`) and is
 * deliberately not counted twice here.
 *
 * Scoped bindings are resolved inside handle() (.ai/rules/listeners.md).
 */
final class RecordPlanMetrics
{
    public function handle(PlanSaved|PlanSaveRefused $event): void
    {
        $outcome = $event instanceof PlanSaved ? 'saved' : $event->outcome;

        app(Metrics::class)->increment('resource_plan_saves_total', [
            'brand' => BrandSlugs::of($event->brandId),
            'outcome' => $outcome,
        ]);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Wrap the save pipeline**

In `app-modules/resources/src/Actions/SavePlan.php` rename the existing `handle()` to `private function save(Plan $plan, PlanSaveData $data, ?string $actorUserId, PlanVersionSource $source): PlanSaveResultData` (same parameters, same body, no other change) and add the public `handle()` plus the helper in front of it:

```php
    /**
     * Design §6.1. The pipeline itself is `save()`; this wrapper only turns
     * the three refusals into `PlanSaveRefused` so the plan-save counter
     * moves (ADR-0059), then rethrows unchanged — the HTTP mapping (409,
     * 422) stays with the controller.
     */
    public function handle(Plan $plan, PlanSaveData $data, ?string $actorUserId, PlanVersionSource $source): PlanSaveResultData
    {
        try {
            return $this->save($plan, $data, $actorUserId, $source);
        } catch (PlanStaleException $e) {
            $this->refused($plan, 'stale');

            throw $e;
        } catch (PlanConflictException $e) {
            $this->refused($plan, 'conflict');

            throw $e;
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->refused($plan, 'invalid');

            throw $e;
        }
    }

    private function refused(Plan $plan, string $outcome): void
    {
        event(new PlanSaveRefused(
            planId: $plan->id,
            eventId: $plan->event_id,
            brandId: $plan->brand_id,
            outcome: $outcome,
        ));
    }
```

Add the imports the file does not already have: `use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;`, `use Konventix\Resources\Events\PlanSaveRefused;` (`PlanStaleException` and `PlanConflictException` are already imported since S2 throws them). `ValidatePlan` (the dry run) is not touched: a validation request is not a save and must not count as a refused one.

```
### KonventixResourceHoldSweepStale

`resources:expire-holds` has not finished a run for ten minutes. The
scheduler runs it every minute; it releases *clocked* holds (direct holds
with a `hold_expires_at`) with reason `expired`. Seat bookings a
registrant picked are confirmed in the same transaction as their hold and
are never touched by it (ADR-0060), so nothing a participant sees is lost
while this fires — but an expired direct hold keeps its resource until
someone tries to confirm it, and the place looks taken. If
KonventixScheduleStale fires too, the scheduler is the cause. Otherwise
the command itself is failing: its `schedule.task` records on the Logs
dashboard carry the exception, and
`kubectl -n konventix exec deploy/konventix-scheduler -- php artisan
resources:expire-holds` runs one sweep by hand. The series only exists
once the command has completed at least once on the instance, so an
instance whose brands never switched Resources on never trips this alert;
the sale dashboard's "Seconds since hold sweep" stat shows the same age.
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the handler**

`app-modules/resources/src/Gdpr/ResourcesGdprHandler.php`:

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Gdpr;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Konventix\Compliance\Enums\DeletionMode;
use Konventix\Compliance\Gdpr\GdprHandler;
use Konventix\Compliance\Gdpr\SubjectRef;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\PlanVersion;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Resource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceBooking;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceClaim;

/**
 * Resources' contribution to GDPR export and deletion (design §9.5).
 *
 * Three places point at a person: `resource_claims.registrant_user_id`
 * (who may pick for a registration), `resource_plans.created_by` and
 * `resource_plan_versions.created_by` (who drew the plan), and
 * `resource_bookings.holder_id` where `holder_type` is `operator` (an
 * orga reservation made by that user). Everything else references a
 * registration, which Registration tombstones itself.
 *
 * Export is what those rows say about the person: the claims, the seat
 * bookings they fulfil (plan name, ref, label, state, interval), their
 * operator reservations, and the versions they authored — never the plan
 * document itself, which is the operator's work, not the subject's.
 *
 * Deletion nulls the pointers and keeps the rows in both modes: a booking
 * is the event's occupancy history and a plan version its editing history.
 * The subject is a person, not a person-at-a-brand (ADR-0050 §2): every
 * query drops the brand scope. An email-only subject cannot be answered —
 * nothing here keys on an address. Both methods are idempotent.
 */
final class ResourcesGdprHandler implements GdprHandler
{
    public function module(): string
    {
        return 'resources';
    }

    public function exportFor(SubjectRef $subject): array
    {
        if (! $subject->isAccountBacked()) {
            return [];
        }

        $subjectId = (string) $subject->userId;

        $claims = ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('registrant_user_id', $subjectId)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->get();

        $bookings = ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where(function (Builder $query) use ($subjectId, $claims): void {
                $query->whereIn('claim_id', $claims->modelKeys())
                    ->orWhere(fn (Builder $reservations): Builder => $reservations
                        ->where('holder_type', ResourceBooking::HOLDER_OPERATOR)
                        ->where('holder_id', $subjectId));
            })
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->get();

        $places = $this->placesOf($bookings);

        $versions = PlanVersion::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('created_by', $subjectId)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->get();

        $planNames = $this->planNames([
            ...$places->pluck('plan_id')->filter()->all(),
            ...$versions->pluck('plan_id')->all(),
        ]);

        return [
            'claims' => $claims
                ->map(fn (ResourceClaim $claim): array => [
                    'id' => $claim->id,
                    'event_id' => $claim->event_id,
                    'registration_id' => $claim->registration_id,
                    'seating_mode' => $claim->seating_mode->value,
                    'quantity' => $claim->quantity,
                    'state' => $claim->state->value,
                    'created_at' => $claim->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                ])
                ->all(),
            'bookings' => $bookings
                ->map(fn (ResourceBooking $booking): array => [
                    'id' => $booking->id,
                    'holder_type' => $booking->holder_type,
                    'registration_id' => $booking->registration_id,
                    'plan' => $planNames[$places[$booking->resource_id]?->plan_id ?? ''] ?? null,
                    'ref' => $places[$booking->resource_id]?->ref,
                    'label' => $booking->label ?? $places[$booking->resource_id]?->label,
                    'state' => $booking->state->value,
                    'starts_at' => $booking->starts_at->toIso8601String(),
                    'ends_at' => $booking->ends_at->toIso8601String(),
                    'created_at' => $booking->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                ])
                ->all(),
            'plan_versions' => $versions
                ->map(fn (PlanVersion $version): array => [
                    'plan_id' => $version->plan_id,
                    'plan' => $planNames[$version->plan_id] ?? null,
                    'version' => $version->version,
                    'source' => $version->source->value,
                    'created_at' => $version->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                ])
                ->all(),
        ];
    }

    public function delete(SubjectRef $subject, DeletionMode $mode): void
    {
        if (! $subject->isAccountBacked()) {
            return;
        }

        $subjectId = (string) $subject->userId;

        ResourceClaim::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('registrant_user_id', $subjectId)
            ->update(['registrant_user_id' => null]);

        Plan::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('created_by', $subjectId)
            ->update(['created_by' => null]);

        PlanVersion::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('created_by', $subjectId)
            ->update(['created_by' => null]);

        ResourceBooking::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('holder_type', ResourceBooking::HOLDER_OPERATOR)
            ->where('holder_id', $subjectId)
            ->update(['holder_id' => null]);
    }

    /**
     * The places behind the bookings, keyed by resource id. Soft-deleted
     * places are included: a booking on a place the operator later removed
     * from the plan is still part of the person's history.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, ResourceBooking>  $bookings
     * @return Collection<string, Resource>
     */
    private function placesOf(Collection $bookings): Collection
    {
        return Resource::withoutBrandScope()
            ->withTrashed()
            ->whereIn('id', $bookings->pluck('resource_id')->unique()->all())
            ->get(['id', 'plan_id', 'ref', 'label'])
            ->keyBy('id');
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $planIds
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function planNames(array $planIds): array
    {
        if ($planIds === []) {
            return [];
        }

        return Plan::withoutBrandScope()
            ->whereIn('id', array_values(array_unique($planIds)))
            ->pluck('name', 'id')
            ->all();
    }
}
```

````markdown
# Resources — Specification

> Stable document. Describes what this module *is*. Task tracking lives in
> `TODO.md`. Seating (plans, places, seat claims, the picker) was merged
> into this document from `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-seating-design.md`;
> ADR-0060 records why it lives here.

## Purpose

Resources owns everything an event has a limited amount of and that somebody can
hold for a period of time: seats, rooms, booth space, loanable devices. It
generalizes LanCore's Seating domain, and the generalization is the point — a
seat is **one resource type with a time dimension**, not a special case with a
booking layer bolted on. Every resource type goes through the same entity, the
same availability model, and the same booking state machine. A booking always
occupies an interval, even when that interval is "the whole event", which is
how LanCore's implicit seat model reappears here without its assumptions.

Domain language (ADR-0060): a **Place** is a unit-mode `Resource` projected from
a plan; a **Kategorie** (category) is a `ResourceType`; a seat booking is a
`ResourceBooking`; a registrant's entitlement to pick is a `ResourceClaim`.

## Owns

- **ResourceType** (= Kategorie) — what kind of thing is bookable and the rules
  that apply: capacity mode (`unit` or `quantity`, ADR-0034), `hold_minutes`
  for clocked holds, and for seat categories the presentation the picker
  needs: `token` (a semantic colour token, never a hex), `symbol` (a lucide
  icon key, mandatory so state is never conveyed by colour alone), a
  description, a sort order and a default shape.
- **Resource** (= Place) — one bookable unit, belonging to an event and
  referencing a venue by ULID. A plan-placed resource carries `plan_id`,
  `ref` (unique per plan), the derived `zone_id`/`group_id`, `accessible`,
  `blocked` (operator lock), `neighbors` and soft deletion, and its
  `is_published` is derived from the plan on every save. Plan-less resources
  (booths, devices) keep the manual flag.
- **Plan and plan versions** — `resource_plans` holds one hall plan per
  event and name: dimensions in millimetres, optional raster background,
  display unit, snap step, a `version` incremented per save, `published_at`,
  and the plan **document** (`konventix.plan/v1`, `PlanDocumentData`) with
  zones, groups, places, fixtures and annotations. `resource_plan_versions`
  keeps one row per save (source `editor|import|copy`), pruned to the last
  50 per plan.
- **Geometry projection** — `SavePlan` projects every `place` element of the
  document into a `resources` row whose id equals the element id, recomputes
  the derived columns, soft-deletes removed places and detects conflicts
  with occupied places. The document is the only home of geometry; booking
  logic reads only the projection and never the document.
- **ResourceClaim** — the Resources-owned snapshot of a `seating` grant
  (decision log D-EVT-06): event, registration, `registrant_user_id`,
  amendment, the category ids the registrant may choose from, the seating
  mode (`pick|assign`), the maximum quantity and a state
  (`unplaced|placed|released`). An unplaced claim is a row, never a fake
  booking.
- **ResourceBooking** — a claim on a resource for a half-open interval by a
  holder referenced by ULID (`registration` or `operator`), plus its state:
  held, confirmed, released, cancelled, expired. Seat bookings carry
  `claim_id`, `amendment_id` and a `label` snapshot.
- **Two hold kinds** (ADR-0060 narrows the earlier "every hold has a
  deadline"): a *clocked* direct hold carries `hold_expires_at` and is
  released by `resources:expire-holds`; a registrant's seat booking is held
  and confirmed in one transaction and never has a clock.
- **Conflict prevention** — two bookings never overlap on the same resource
  beyond its capacity. In unit mode the PostgreSQL exclusion constraint
  `resource_bookings_no_overlap` decides (ADR-0020); in quantity mode a
  locked, summed check inside the Action does (ADR-0034). A lost race is
  `ResourceUnavailableException` (23P01) or a deadlock (40P01), translated by
  the Action into a domain or validation error.
- **Claim fulfilment** — turning `resource_claim` grants into first-fit
  bookings (`n` unit bookings for quantity `n`, ordered by plan, zone, group,
  ref) and `seating` grants into claims, idempotently per
  `(registration_id, amendment_id)`; releasing all of it when the
  registration is cancelled or rejected.
- **Event window read model** — `resource_event_windows`, projected from
  Event's events with timezone-aware instants, name and slug, so whole-event
  bookings have an interval and the console can name events without reading
  Event's models.

## Does not own

| Nearby concept | Owned by |
|---|---|
| What was bought, by whom, and under which registration type — including the `resource_claim` and `seating` grants that entitle a booking or a pick | **Registration** (ADR-0005). Resources fulfils grants; it does not grant them. Registration status is never touched by Resources. |
| Prices, orders, invoices, refunds for a booked resource | **Commerce** (ADR-0006). Resources never prices anything and never emits money-shaped events. |
| A person's right to be on site, badge, check-in | **Admission**. A booking is not an access right. |
| The event and the venue as lifecycle entities | **Event**. Resources references `venue_id` and `event_id` as plain ULIDs. |
| Who works when and where | **Staffing**. |
| Game servers and match sessions | **GameOps** (ADR-0012). |
| Matches, brackets, tournament schedules that need a room | **Competition** |
| Public brand pages that embed a seat plan | **Platform** / **Content**. |
| Notifying a holder that a booking expired or a seat was released | **Messaging**. No mail is sent for a plan-conflict release in v1 (operator decision 2026-09-10). |
| Which roles may book on someone else's behalf | **Platform** (per-brand role data, ADR-0013) |
| Raster backgrounds of a plan | **Platform** media library (`MediaPicker`); Resources stores a media id. |

## Public contract (events)

Events are the only way other modules may react to this one (ADR-0004).
Payloads carry ULIDs and scalars — never Eloquent models.

| Event | Emitted when | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `ResourceBookingHeld` | A provisional hold is placed; nothing irreversible may react to it | `bookingId`, `resourceId`, `brandId`, `eventId`, `resourceTypeId`, `holderType`, `holderId`, `registrationId?`, `claimId?`, `label`, `ref`, `quantity`, `startsAt`, `endsAt`, `holdExpiresAt?` |
| `ResourceBookingConfirmed` | A hold becomes firm — **the event other modules act on** (a badge, a bill) | as above plus `confirmedAt`, without `holdExpiresAt` |
| `ResourceBookingReleased` | A booking gives its interval back | `bookingId`, `resourceId`, `brandId`, `eventId`, `resourceTypeId`, `holderType`, `holderId`, `registrationId?`, `claimId?`, `label`, `ref`, `reason`, `releasedAt`; reasons `registration_cancelled`, `registration_rejected`, `plan_conflict`, `repicked`, `operator_released`, `expired` |
| `PlanSaved` | A plan save committed | `planId`, `eventId`, `brandId`, `version`, `changedPlaceIds` |
| `PlanPublished` / `PlanUnpublished` | A plan reaches or leaves the picker | `planId`, `eventId`, `brandId` |
| `SeatClaimCreated` | A confirmed registration with a `seating` grant may pick | `claimId`, `registrationId`, `eventId`, `brandId` |
| `SeatClaimPlaced` | The registrant's places are confirmed | `claimId`, `registrationId`, `eventId`, `brandId`, `placeIds` |
| `SeatClaimReleased` | The claim ended with its registration | `claimId`, `registrationId`, `eventId`, `brandId` |

Admission's SPEC once referred to `ResourceBookingCreated`; the settled name is
`ResourceBookingConfirmed` — a hold is provisional and must never reach a badge.

### Internal events (observability only)

Not part of the cross-module contract; other modules must not listen to them.

| Event | Emitted when | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `ResourceBookingRefused` | `AssignPlacesToRegistration` lost the race for a place (23P01 or 40P01) and wrote nothing | `brandId`, `eventId`, `registrationId`, `reason` (`unavailable|deadlock`) |
| `PlanSaveRefused` | `SavePlan` refused before writing: stale version, invalid document, unresolved conflict | `planId`, `eventId`, `brandId`, `outcome` (`stale|invalid|conflict`) |

## Consumes

| Event | Owning module | Listener and behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `RegistrationConfirmed` | Registration | `FulfilClaimsOnRegistrationConfirmed`, gated per brand: `resource_claim` grants become first-fit bookings, `seating` grants become one `unplaced` claim each with `registrant_user_id` from the payload; idempotent on `(registration_id, amendment_id null)` |
| `RegistrationAmended` | Registration | `FulfilClaimsOnRegistrationAmended`, the same keyed on `amendment_id` |
| `RegistrationCancelled` | Registration | `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationCancelled`, **ungated** (see Activation): every active booking of the registration released with `registration_cancelled`, claims → `released` |
| `RegistrationRejected` | Registration | `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationRejected`, ungated, reason `registration_rejected` |
| `EventCreated`, `EventRescheduled`, `EventDetailsUpdated` | Event | `ProjectEventWindow`, ungated: upsert of `resource_event_windows` by `(brand_id, event_id)` with timezone-aware instants (ADR-0027), name and slug; `event:replay-details` backfills existing events |
| `DataExportRequested` / `UserDeletionRequested` | Compliance | `ResourcesGdprHandler` via the registry: exports claims, bookings, operator reservations and plan versions of the subject; erasure nulls `registrant_user_id`, `created_by` on plans and versions, and the `holder_id` of the subject's operator reservations |

Resources does **not** listen to Commerce: payment reaches Registration, which
confirms, and Resources reacts to Registration only (ADR-0006). It keeps no
read model of people — a holder is a ULID plus a holder type.

## Surfaces

- **Console** (operator host, `routes/admin/resources.php`): categories
  (`admin/resource-types`), plans (`admin/plans`: index, create, import,
  export, publish, occupancy, operator reservations) and the plan editor
  (`admin/plans/{plan}/edit`, SVG, `SavePlan` through `useHttp` with
  `expectedVersion`; 409 stale, 422 conflicts or invalid). Console code runs
  without a brand: `withoutBrandScope()` at every query level, `brand_id`
  forceFilled from the plan or event window row.
- **Picker** (brand host, `routes/web/resources.php`, module gate):
  `GET|POST /my/registrations/{registration}/seat` and the availability poll.
  Ownership of the claim authorises (`registrant_user_id === auth()->id()`);
  no capability is needed. Only published plans reach the picker.
- **Slots**: `registration.mine.show` → `SeatSummarySlot`;
  `registration.type-editor.seating-fields` → `SeatingGrantFields`; both with
  `module: 'resources'` and no feature.
- **Commands**: `resources:expire-holds` (every minute), `resources:plan-import`,
  `resources:plan-export`, `resources:assign-place`.

## Capabilities

Declared in `src/Enums/Permission.php`; roles that grant them are per-brand
data (ADR-0013), with the module's defaults in
`ResourcesServiceProvider::defaultRoles()` (ADR-0045): `resources.planner` and
`resources.desk`.

- `ViewResources` — view the booking list of an event, including holder ids.
- `ManageResourceTypes` — categories and their booking rules.
- `ManageResources` — create, publish and withdraw plan-less resources.
- `ManagePlans` — plans, the editor, import, export, publish.
- `BookOnBehalf` — pick or reserve for somebody else (operator reservations,
  `resources:assign-place`, the Phase 3 reseat).
- `ReleaseBookings` — release another holder's booking.

Booking one's own places is not a capability: the claim authorises.

## Observability (ADR-0059)

Catalogue in `src/Metrics/ResourcesMetrics.php`, recorders in
`src/Listeners/Metrics/`, gauges in `ResourcesGauges`:
`resource_bookings_total{brand,outcome=held|confirmed|released|expired|refused}`,
`resource_plan_saves_total{brand,outcome=saved|conflict|invalid|stale}`,
`resource_seat_claims_unplaced{brand}`,
`resource_hold_sweep_last_run_timestamp_seconds`. Dashboard row "Seating" on
`konventix-sale`; alert `KonventixResourceHoldSweepStale` (warning, sweep older
than ten minutes; runbook in `docs/operations.md`). The unplaced-claims gauge
is the operator's substitute for a category-versus-quota check Resources cannot
perform.

## Activation

Pennant feature `module:resources`, gated per brand at the four enforcement
points (ADR-0003): the brand-host route group carries `ensure-module:resources`
(added by the base provider), Platform's nav registry filters the module's
entries, the two slots pass `module: 'resources'`, and the fulfilment listeners
short-circuit through `ModuleGate::isActiveForBrand($brandId)` because
`RegistrationConfirmed` may arrive without an ambient brand (a Stripe webhook).
Admin routes carry no module gate; `BrandScope` hardens their queries instead.

Two listener kinds are deliberately **not** gated, recorded in ADR-0060 as the
explicit exception to ADR-0003: `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationCancelled` and
`ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationRejected` release bookings for a brand that has
switched the module off — a release is safe and idempotent, and a brand that
switches Resources off must not keep seats parked for cancelled registrations;
and `ProjectEventWindow` keeps the event-window read model current so a brand
switching Resources on mid-event finds its windows already projected.

With the feature off a brand sells registrations but allocates nothing. A type
that grants claims still registers people correctly — the claims stay
unfulfilled rather than failing the registration, and switching the module on
later fulfils them retroactively through `event:replay-details` and a replayed
confirmation.

## Settled questions

- Capacity greater than one: per type, `unit` or `quantity` mode (ADR-0034).
- No-overlap enforcement: a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint over a range
  type (ADR-0020); the suite runs on PostgreSQL.
- Waitlists belong to Registration (D-REG-04); a waitlist conversion is an
  ordinary confirmation followed by a pick.
- Interval granularity: minute-precision half-open ranges; the whole event
  is the degenerate case (D-BATCH-7).
- Transfers follow the registration's amendment rules (ADR-0036); a seat
  belongs to the registration, Umschreibung is not modelled (#16).
- Resources exist per event only (D-EVT-13); floors and templates are
  deferred.
- Where a seat plan lives: in this module as a document behind a typed cast,
  projected into `resources`; element id equals resource id (ADR-0060).
- When a registrant picks: after confirmation, never in the registration
  form and never with a hold at submit (operator decision 2026-09-10).
````

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `.ai/rules/seating.md`**

```markdown
---
paths:
  - 'app-modules/resources/**'
---

# Seating (Resources)

## Booking writes go through the three Actions; the exclusion constraint is the invariant
`HoldResourceBooking`, `ConfirmResourceBooking`, `ReleaseResourceBooking` — never an insert or update on `resource_bookings` from anywhere else, including the plan save and the sweep. The partial exclusion constraint `resource_bookings_no_overlap` decides every race (ADR-0020); an application check would lose one it cannot see. Catch SQLSTATE `23P01` (`ResourceUnavailableException`) and `40P01` (deadlock) inside the Action and translate them into a domain or validation exception with the place ref in the text. A registrant's seat booking is held and confirmed in one transaction and carries no clock; only direct holds have `hold_expires_at` and only those the sweep touches (ADR-0060).

## Geometry lives in the document, availability in the projection
A plan's zones, groups, places, fixtures and annotations exist only in `resource_plans.document` (`PlanDocumentData`, `konventix.plan/v1`, integer millimetres, camelCase keys). `SavePlan` projects places into `resources` (element id equals resource id, `ref` unique per plan, derived `zone_id`/`group_id`/`neighbors`/`is_published`). Booking logic, the picker's availability and the console's occupancy read only `resources` and `resource_bookings` — never parse the document for availability, never write geometry into the projection by hand.

## Console code runs without a brand
Admin-host requests resolve no brand and `BrandScope` hardens every brand-owned query to zero rows: `withoutBrandScope()` at every query level, including relations and nested `whereHas`, and `forceFill(['brand_id' => …])` from the plan or event-window row on every create. `Gate::authorize(Permission::X->value)` is the first line of every controller method.

## Listeners resolve scoped bindings inside handle(); the release listeners are ungated on purpose
Every listener is registered with `Event::listen` in `ResourcesServiceProvider` (discovery is off) and reads `ModuleGate`/`BrandContext` at call time. Fulfilment listeners gate with `ModuleGate::isActiveForBrand($brandId)` because a confirmation may arrive without an ambient brand (webhook, scheduler). `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationCancelled` and `ReleaseBookingsOnRegistrationRejected` are **not** gated (ADR-0060's ADR-0003 exception): a release is safe and idempotent, and a brand that switched the module off must not keep seats parked. Do not "fix" that by adding the gate.

## Registration status is never touched by Resources; grants are frozen once a type has registrations
A plan conflict releases the booking (`plan_conflict`) and sets the claim back to `unplaced`; it never cancels, rejects or amends the registration. Seating grants (`GrantKind::Seating`, `resourceTypeIds`, `seatingMode`) are configured when the type is created; `GuardsTypeConfiguration` freezes `grants` afterwards.

## Tests
`Event::fake([...])` always with explicit classes (a blanket fake swallows `BelongsToBrand`'s creating hook). Shared helpers live in `app-modules/resources/tests/Helpers.php`, prefixed `seating`. An assertion after a constraint violation needs the failure inside a savepoint — the Actions' nested `DB::transaction` provides one; a raw insert does not. Admin-host tests create their rows before the request. `vendor/bin/sail npm run build` before a test that renders a new Inertia page. Never two test processes at once.

## Observability
Every operational state here has a metric, a panel and, where it can fail silently, an alert (ADR-0059): catalogue in `src/Metrics/ResourcesMetrics.php`, recorders in `src/Listeners/Metrics/` on this module's own events (`ResourceBookingRefused` and `PlanSaveRefused` exist only for that), gauges in `ResourcesGauges`, the Seating row in `contrib/observability/src/sale.mjs`. A new metric without a panel fails `ObservabilityCoverageTest`.
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Konventix\Identity\Models\User;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Brand;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Operator;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Permission as PermissionModel;
use Konventix\Platform\Models\Role;
use Konventix\Resources\Actions\SavePlan;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanDocumentData;
use Konventix\Resources\Data\PlanSaveData;
use Konventix\Resources\Enums\PlanVersionSource;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\Plan;
use Konventix\Resources\Models\ResourceType;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Helpers that more than one file of this module's suite calls. Pest loads
 * every module's tests/Helpers.php from tests/Pest.php, so they exist in
 * every worker of a parallel run; the names are process-global across all
 * modules, hence the `seating` prefix (.ai/rules/tests.md).
 */

/**
 * An operator with its own admin host and the given capabilities, the
 * pattern of RegistrationTypeAdminTest: the capability rows are created by
 * hand because `permissions:sync` does not run inside a test.
 *
 * @param  list<string>  $permissions
 * @return array{0: Operator, 1: User}
 */
function seatingEditorOperator(array $permissions = [
    'platform.access-admin',
    'resources.manage-plans',
    'resources.book-on-behalf',
]): array
{
    $operator = Operator::factory()->create();
    $operator->forceFill(['admin_host' => 'admin.seating-editor.test'])->save();

    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($operator->getKey());

    foreach ($permissions as $name) {
        PermissionModel::query()->firstOrCreate(['name' => $name, 'guard_name' => 'web']);
    }

    $role = Role::query()->create([
        'name' => 'Seating Planner',
        'guard_name' => 'web',
        'brand_id' => $operator->getKey(),
    ]);
    $role->givePermissionTo($permissions);

    $admin = User::factory()->create();
    $admin->assignRole($role);

    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$operator, $admin];
}

function seatingEditorEmptyDocument(): PlanDocumentData
{
    return PlanDocumentData::from(['schema' => 'konventix.plan/v1', 'elements' => []]);
}

/**
 * One group at (1000, 1000) with `count($placeIds)` places 800 mm apart,
 * labelled A-01, A-02, … — the smallest document the projection, the
 * conflict list and the editor all have something to say about.
 *
 * @param  list<string>  $placeIds
 */
function seatingEditorDocument(string $groupId, array $placeIds, string $categoryId): PlanDocumentData
{
    $elements = [[
        'id' => $groupId,
        'kind' => 'group',
        'parentId' => null,
        'label' => 'A',
        'x' => 1000,
        'y' => 1000,
        'shape' => ['type' => 'point'],
        'layout' => ['type' => 'linear', 'count' => count($placeIds), 'spacing' => 800, 'startIndex' => 1],
        'labelSchema' => ['row' => '{row}', 'place' => '{row}-{n:02}'],
    ]];

    foreach (array_values($placeIds) as $index => $placeId) {
        $label = sprintf('A-%02d', $index + 1);

        $elements[] = [
            'id' => $placeId,
            'kind' => 'place',
            'parentId' => $groupId,
            'ref' => $label,
            'label' => $label,
            'x' => $index * 800,
            'y' => 0,
            'shape' => ['type' => 'rect', 'w' => 800, 'h' => 800],
            'resourceTypeId' => $categoryId,
        ];
    }

    return PlanDocumentData::from(['schema' => 'konventix.plan/v1', 'elements' => $elements]);
}

/**
 * A plan of the ambient brand with its places already projected into
 * `resources` through the real save pipeline, so ids equal resource ids.
 *
 * @return array{0: Plan, 1: list<string>, 2: string}
 */
function seatingEditorPlan(Brand $brand, string $eventId, ResourceType $category, int $places = 2): array
{
    $groupId = (string) Str::ulid();
    $placeIds = [];

    for ($index = 0; $index < $places; $index++) {
        $placeIds[] = (string) Str::ulid();
    }

    $plan = Plan::factory()->create([
        'event_id' => $eventId,
        'name' => 'Hall '.Str::lower(Str::random(4)),
        'width_mm' => 20000,
        'height_mm' => 10000,
        'document' => seatingEditorEmptyDocument(),
    ]);

    app(SavePlan::class)->handle(
        $plan,
        PlanSaveData::from([
            'expectedVersion' => $plan->version,
            'document' => seatingEditorDocument($groupId, $placeIds, $category->getKey()),
            'resolutions' => [],
        ]),
        null,
        PlanVersionSource::Editor,
    );

    return [$plan->refresh(), $placeIds, $groupId];
}
```

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Konventix\Resources\Data;

use Spatie\LaravelData\Attributes\DataCollectionOf;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Data;
use Spatie\TypeScriptTransformer\Attributes\TypeScript;

/**
 * Everything the plan editor page needs in one prop (ADR-0009): the plan
 * as the viewer sees it, the version the next save must name, the grid
 * step, the event's categories for the inspector's select, and the
 * occupancy the inspector shows before anyone touches a place.
 *
 * `publishedAt` is an ISO-8601 instant and the page only uses it as a flag
 * (.ai/rules/js.md: never print a raw timestamp).
 */
#[TypeScript]
final class PlanEditorData extends Data
{
    /**
     * @param  list<CategoryData>  $categories
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly PlanViewData $plan,
        public readonly string $eventId,
        public readonly int $version,
        public readonly int $snapStep,
        public readonly string $unitDisplay,
        public readonly ?string $publishedAt,
        public readonly bool $canReserve,
        #[DataCollectionOf(CategoryData::class)]
        public readonly array $categories,
        public readonly PlanOccupancyData $occupancy,
    ) {}
}
```

```php
    /**
     * The editor (design §8.3). Categories and occupancy travel with the
     * page so the inspector has something to show before the first save;
     * the page refreshes occupancy through the `occupancy` action after a
     * reservation.
     */
    public function edit(string $plan): Response
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $plan = $this->editorPlan($plan);

        return Inertia::render('admin/plans/Edit', [
            'editor' => new PlanEditorData(
                plan: new PlanViewData(
                    id: $plan->getKey(),
                    name: $plan->name,
                    floorLabel: $plan->floor_label,
                    widthMm: $plan->width_mm,
                    heightMm: $plan->height_mm,
                    background: $plan->background,
                    document: $plan->document,
                ),
                eventId: $plan->event_id,
                version: $plan->version,
                snapStep: $plan->snap_step,
                unitDisplay: $plan->unit_display,
                publishedAt: $plan->published_at?->toIso8601String(),
                canReserve: Gate::allows(Permission::BookOnBehalf->value),
                categories: $this->editorCategories($plan),
                occupancy: $this->occupancyFor($plan),
            ),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * The editor's save (design §6.1): 409 `{ currentVersion }` when the
     * version moved, 422 `{ conflicts }` when an occupied place would be
     * deleted, recategorised or blocked without a resolution, 200 with the
     * result otherwise. Data validation answers the framework's 422.
     *
     * The version pre-check keeps §6.1's order on the HTTP surface (stale
     * before invalid); `SavePlan` re-checks under its row lock, which is
     * the check that counts. The conflict list is mirrored under
     * `errors.conflicts` because Inertia's `useHttp` hands a 422's `errors`
     * key to `onError` and nothing else of the body.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, string $plan, SavePlan $savePlan): JsonResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $plan = $this->editorPlan($plan);

        if ($request->integer('expectedVersion', -1) !== $plan->version) {
            return response()->json(['currentVersion' => $plan->version], 409);
        }

        $data = PlanSaveData::validateAndCreate($request->all());

        try {
            $result = $savePlan->handle($plan, $data, $request->user()?->getKey(), PlanVersionSource::Editor);
        } catch (PlanStaleException $exception) {
            return response()->json(['currentVersion' => $exception->currentVersion], 409);
        } catch (PlanConflictException $exception) {
            $conflicts = array_map(
                fn (PlanConflictData $conflict): array => $conflict->toArray(),
                $exception->conflicts,
            );

            return response()->json(['conflicts' => $conflicts, 'errors' => ['conflicts' => $conflicts]], 422);
        }

        return response()->json($result);
    }

    /**
     * The dry run behind the editor's "Check" button: the same pipeline
     * without step 6, answering the conflict and warning lists as data.
     */
    public function validate(Request $request, string $plan, ValidatePlan $validatePlan): JsonResponse
    {
        Gate::authorize(Permission::ManagePlans->value);

        $plan = $this->editorPlan($plan);

        if ($request->integer('expectedVersion', -1) !== $plan->version) {
            return response()->json(['currentVersion' => $plan->version], 409);
        }

        $data = PlanSaveData::validateAndCreate($request->all());

        try {
            return response()->json($validatePlan->handle($plan, $data));
        } catch (PlanStaleException $exception) {
            return response()->json(['currentVersion' => $exception->currentVersion], 409);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Admin host: BrandScope hardens to zero rows, so the lookup escapes it
     * (ADR-0029, .ai/rules/app-modules-src.md).
     */
    private function editorPlan(string $plan): Plan
    {
        /** @var Plan */
        return Plan::withoutBrandScope()->findOrFail($plan);
    }

    /**
     * The categories a place of this plan may carry: the plan's event and
     * brand only, in the operator's sort order.
     *
     * @return list<CategoryData>
     */
    private function editorCategories(Plan $plan): array
    {
        return ResourceType::withoutBrandScope()
            ->where('brand_id', $plan->brand_id)
            ->where('event_id', $plan->event_id)
            ->orderBy('sort_order')
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (ResourceType $type): CategoryData => new CategoryData(
                id: $type->getKey(),
                name: $type->name,
                token: $type->token,
                symbol: $type->symbol,
                description: $type->description,
            ))
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `ulid.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * A ULID minted in the browser (design §5: element ids are client-minted
 * and never change). Crockford base32, 48-bit millisecond time, 80 random
 * bits — the shape Laravel's `ulid` validation rule and `Str::isUlid`
 * accept. The random source is injectable so a test can pin the output.
 */
const ENCODING = '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ';

function fillRandom(bytes: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
    crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);

    return bytes;
}

export function newUlid(
    now: number = Date.now(),
    random: (bytes: Uint8Array) => Uint8Array = fillRandom,
): string {
    let time = now;
    let timePart = '';

    for (let index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
        timePart = ENCODING[time % 32] + timePart;
        time = Math.floor(time / 32);
    }

    const bytes = random(new Uint8Array(16));
    let randomPart = '';

    for (let index = 0; index < 16; index++) {
        randomPart += ENCODING[bytes[index] % 32];
    }

    return timePart + randomPart;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `snap.ts`**

```ts
import type { Point } from './document';

/**
 * Grid snapping in plan millimetres (design §5): `round(v / step) * step`
 * with the four steps the plan's `snap_step` column allows.
 */
export type SnapStep = 1 | 10 | 100 | 1000;

export const SNAP_STEPS: readonly SnapStep[] = [1, 10, 100, 1000];

export function snapValue(value: number, step: SnapStep): number {
    return Math.round(value / step) * step;
}

export function snapPoint(point: Point, step: SnapStep): Point {
    return { x: snapValue(point.x, step), y: snapValue(point.y, step) };
}

/**
 * The delta that moves `anchor` by `delta` and lands it on the grid. A
 * drag snaps its destination, not its distance: an element sitting on the
 * grid stays on it, and one that was off the grid is pulled onto it.
 */
export function snapDelta(anchor: Point, delta: Point, step: SnapStep): Point {
    const target = snapPoint({ x: anchor.x + delta.x, y: anchor.y + delta.y }, step);

    return { x: target.x - anchor.x, y: target.y - anchor.y };
}
```
