- [ ] **Step 3: Write `document.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * The editor's view of `konventix.plan/v1` (design §5): the generated Data
 * types made writable for drafts, the parent rules, per-kind defaults and
 * the tree walks every panel needs. Pure — no Vue, no DOM — so the
 * generator, the invariants and the store can be unit-tested on their own.
 *
 * Geometry (absolute bounding boxes, hit testing) lives in `../geometry`
 * and is shared with the viewer; this file only knows the tree.
 */
export type PlanDocument = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanDocumentData;
export type PlanElement = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanElementData;
export type Shape = Konventix.Resources.Data.ShapeData;
export type Layout = Konventix.Resources.Data.LayoutData;
export type LabelSchema = Konventix.Resources.Data.LabelSchemaData;
export type ElementKind = Konventix.Resources.Enums.ElementKind;

export type Point = { x: number; y: number };

export type Mutable<T> = T extends readonly (infer U)[]
    ? Mutable<U>[]
    : T extends object
      ? { -readonly [K in keyof T]: Mutable<T[K]> }
      : T;

export type DraftDocument = Mutable<PlanDocument>;
export type DraftElement = Mutable<PlanElement>;

/** Allowed parents per kind (design §5); `null` is the plan root. */
export const ALLOWED_PARENTS: Record<ElementKind, ReadonlyArray<ElementKind | null>> = {
    zone: [null, 'zone'],
    group: [null, 'zone', 'group'],
    place: ['group', 'zone', null],
    fixture: [null, 'zone', 'group'],
    annotation: [null, 'zone', 'group', 'place', 'fixture', 'annotation'],
};

function shape(type: Shape['type'], dims: Partial<Shape> = {}): Shape {
    return { type, w: null, h: null, radius: null, rx: null, ry: null, points: null, ...dims };
}

/** Sane defaults from design §5: a LAN place is a table share, 800 × 800. */
export const DEFAULT_SHAPES: Record<ElementKind, Shape> = {
    zone: shape('rect', { w: 4000, h: 4000 }),
    group: shape('point'),
    place: shape('rect', { w: 800, h: 800 }),
    fixture: shape('rect', { w: 1600, h: 800 }),
    annotation: shape('point'),
};

export function clone<T>(value: T): T {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T;
}

export function newElement(
    kind: ElementKind,
    id: string,
    overrides: Partial<DraftElement> = {},
): DraftElement {
    return {
        id,
        kind,
        parentId: null,
        ref: null,
        label: null,
        layer: 'default',
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        rotation: 0,
        shape: clone(DEFAULT_SHAPES[kind]),
        locked: false,
        originId: null,
        token: null,
        layout: null,
        labelSchema: null,
        resourceTypeId: null,
        accessible: false,
        detached: false,
        blocked: false,
        fixtureType: kind === 'fixture' ? 'table' : null,
        text: kind === 'annotation' ? 'Text' : null,
        fontSizeMm: kind === 'annotation' ? 300 : null,
        ...overrides,
    };
}

export function elementById(document: PlanDocument, id: string): PlanElement | undefined {
    return document.elements.find((element) => element.id === id);
}

/** One pass over the flat list; the tree and the inspector walk this. */
export function childrenIndex(document: PlanDocument): Map<string | null, PlanElement[]> {
    const index = new Map<string | null, PlanElement[]>();

    for (const element of document.elements) {
        const siblings = index.get(element.parentId) ?? [];
        siblings.push(element);
        index.set(element.parentId, siblings);
    }

    return index;
}

export function childrenOf(document: PlanDocument, parentId: string | null): PlanElement[] {
    return document.elements.filter((element) => element.parentId === parentId);
}

export function descendantIds(document: PlanDocument, id: string): string[] {
    const index = childrenIndex(document);
    const out: string[] = [];
    const queue = [id];

    while (queue.length > 0) {
        const current = queue.shift() as string;

        for (const child of index.get(current) ?? []) {
            out.push(child.id);
            queue.push(child.id);
        }
    }

    return out;
}

/**
 * The element's origin in plan millimetres: its own `x, y` plus every
 * ancestor's. Parent rotation is ignored in v1 (recorded in TODO.md).
 */
export function absolutePosition(document: PlanDocument, id: string): Point {
    const byId = new Map(document.elements.map((element) => [element.id, element]));
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    let current = byId.get(id);
    const point = { x: 0, y: 0 };

    while (current && !seen.has(current.id)) {
        seen.add(current.id);
        point.x += current.x;
        point.y += current.y;
        current = current.parentId === null ? undefined : byId.get(current.parentId);
    }

    return point;
}

/** A, B, … Z, AA, AB — the first label no group carries yet. */
export function nextGroupLabel(document: PlanDocument): string {
    const taken = new Set(
        document.elements.filter((element) => element.kind === 'group').map((element) => element.label),
    );

    for (let number = 0; ; number++) {
        let label = '';
        let rest = number;

        do {
            label = String.fromCharCode(65 + (rest % 26)) + label;
            rest = Math.floor(rest / 26) - 1;
        } while (rest >= 0);

        if (!taken.has(label)) {
            return label;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write `invariants.ts`**

```ts
import type { PlanDocument, PlanElement } from './document';
import { ALLOWED_PARENTS } from './document';

/**
 * The client mirror of `PlanInvariants::check()` (design §6.1 step 2).
 * Same rules, same keys (`document.elements.<index>.<field>`) as the
 * server's 422, so the validation panel lists both sources alike and the
 * Save button can stay disabled for what the server would refuse anyway.
 */
export type InvariantIssue = {
    index: number;
    elementId: string;
    field: string;
    key: string;
    message: string;
};

type Indexed = { element: PlanElement; index: number };

function hasCycle(byId: Map<string, Indexed>, element: PlanElement): boolean {
    const seen = new Set<string>([element.id]);
    let current = element.parentId;

    while (current !== null) {
        if (seen.has(current)) {
            return true;
        }

        seen.add(current);
        current = byId.get(current)?.element.parentId ?? null;
    }

    return false;
}

export function checkInvariants(
    document: PlanDocument,
    categoryIds: readonly string[],
): InvariantIssue[] {
    const issues: InvariantIssue[] = [];
    const byId = new Map<string, Indexed>();
    const refs = new Set<string>();
    const categories = new Set(categoryIds);

    const report = (index: number, element: PlanElement, field: string, message: string): void => {
        issues.push({
            index,
            elementId: element.id,
            field,
            key: `document.elements.${index}.${field}`,
            message,
        });
    };

    document.elements.forEach((element, index) => {
        if (byId.has(element.id)) {
            report(index, element, 'id', `Id ${element.id} is used twice.`);
        } else {
            byId.set(element.id, { element, index });
        }
    });

    document.elements.forEach((element, index) => {
        if (element.parentId !== null) {
            const parent = byId.get(element.parentId);

            if (!parent) {
                report(index, element, 'parentId', 'The parent does not exist.');
            } else if (!ALLOWED_PARENTS[element.kind].includes(parent.element.kind)) {
                report(index, element, 'parentId', `A ${element.kind} cannot sit inside a ${parent.element.kind}.`);
            } else if (hasCycle(byId, element)) {
                report(index, element, 'parentId', 'The parent chain loops back to this element.');
            }
        }

        if (element.ref !== null && element.ref !== '') {
            if (refs.has(element.ref)) {
                report(index, element, 'ref', `Ref ${element.ref} is used twice.`);
            } else {
                refs.add(element.ref);
            }
        }

        if (element.kind === 'place') {
            if (!element.resourceTypeId) {
                report(index, element, 'resourceTypeId', 'A place needs a category.');
            } else if (!categories.has(element.resourceTypeId)) {
                report(index, element, 'resourceTypeId', 'The category does not belong to this event.');
            }
        }

        if (element.shape.type === 'polygon' && (element.shape.points?.length ?? 0) < 3) {
            report(index, element, 'shape.points', 'A polygon needs at least three points.');
        }
    });

    return issues;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `generator.ts`**

```ts
import type { DraftElement, LabelSchema, Layout, PlanElement, Shape } from './document';
import { clone, newElement } from './document';

/**
 * The group generator (design §5): a linear row or a grid of places from a
 * layout and a label schema. Regeneration is the same function run over
 * the group's existing children — non-detached places keep their ids and
 * whatever the operator changed on them, get their position and labels
 * rewritten, and the count decides what is appended or dropped at the end.
 * Detached places (moved by hand) are left alone and returned after the
 * generated ones.
 */
export type LayoutSlot = { x: number; y: number; row: number; col: number };

export type GeneratorSeed = {
    parentId: string;
    groupLabel: string;
    layout: Layout;
    labelSchema: LabelSchema;
    resourceTypeId: string;
    shape: Shape;
    existing: readonly PlanElement[];
    newId: () => string;
};

export function renderLabel(
    schema: string,
    vars: { row: string; n: number; col: number },
): string {
    return schema.replace(
        /\{(row|n|col)(?::0(\d))?\}/g,
        (_match: string, name: string, pad?: string): string => {
            const value = name === 'row' ? vars.row : String(name === 'n' ? vars.n : vars.col);

            return pad === undefined ? value : value.padStart(Number(pad), '0');
        },
    );
}

export function layoutSlots(layout: Layout): LayoutSlot[] {
    const slots: LayoutSlot[] = [];

    if (layout.type === 'linear') {
        const count = Math.max(0, layout.count ?? 0);

        for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
            slots.push({ x: index * layout.spacing, y: 0, row: 1, col: index + 1 });
        }

        return slots;
    }

    const rows = Math.max(0, layout.rows ?? 0);
    const cols = Math.max(0, layout.cols ?? 0);
    const rowSpacing = layout.rowSpacing ?? layout.spacing;

    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
        for (let col = 0; col < cols; col++) {
            slots.push({ x: col * layout.spacing, y: row * rowSpacing, row: row + 1, col: col + 1 });
        }
    }

    return slots;
}

export function generatePlaces(seed: GeneratorSeed): DraftElement[] {
    const slots = layoutSlots(seed.layout);
    const attached = seed.existing.filter((element) => element.kind === 'place' && !element.detached);
    const untouched = seed.existing.filter((element) => element.kind !== 'place' || element.detached);

    const generated = slots.map((slot, index): DraftElement => {
        const rowLabel = renderLabel(seed.labelSchema.row, { row: seed.groupLabel, n: slot.row, col: slot.col });
        const label = renderLabel(seed.labelSchema.place, {
            row: rowLabel,
            n: seed.layout.startIndex + index,
            col: slot.col,
        });

        const base: DraftElement = attached[index]
            ? (clone(attached[index]) as DraftElement)
            : newElement('place', seed.newId(), {
                  parentId: seed.parentId,
                  resourceTypeId: seed.resourceTypeId,
                  shape: clone(seed.shape),
              });

        return { ...base, x: slot.x, y: slot.y, label, ref: label };
    });

    return [...generated, ...untouched.map((element) => clone(element) as DraftElement)];
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { PlanDocument } from './document';
import { newElement } from './document';
import { createPlanStore } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * Design §8.3: `applyMutation(label, fn)` with same-label coalescing within
 * 500 ms, a 50-step undo ring, and `isDirty` against the last saved
 * document. The clock is injected so the coalescing window is testable.
 */
function documentOf(): PlanDocument {
    return {
        schema: 'konventix.plan/v1',
        elements: [
            newElement('group', 'g1', { label: 'A' }),
            newElement('place', 'p1', { parentId: 'g1', label: 'A-01', resourceTypeId: 'c1' }),
            newElement('place', 'p2', { parentId: 'g1', label: 'A-02', resourceTypeId: 'c1', locked: true }),
        ],
    } as PlanDocument;
}

function storeWithClock() {
    const clock = { now: 0 };
    const store = createPlanStore(documentOf(), { now: () => clock.now });

    return { store, clock };
}

describe('createPlanStore', () => {
    it('starts clean and becomes dirty on the first mutation', () => {
        const { store } = storeWithClock();

        expect(store.isDirty.value).toBe(false);

        store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:label', (element) => {
            element.label = 'A-1';
        });

        expect(store.isDirty.value).toBe(true);
        expect(store.document.value.elements[1].label).toBe('A-1');
    });

    it('coalesces same-label mutations inside 500 ms into one undo step', () => {
        const { store, clock } = storeWithClock();

        store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:label', (element) => {
            element.label = 'B';
        });
        clock.now = 400;
        store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:label', (element) => {
            element.label = 'BC';
        });

        store.undo();

        expect(store.document.value.elements[1].label).toBe('A-01');
        expect(store.canUndo.value).toBe(false);
    });

    it('starts a new step after the window or for another label', () => {
        const { store, clock } = storeWithClock();

        store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:label', (element) => {
            element.label = 'B';
        });
        clock.now = 600;
        store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:label', (element) => {
            element.label = 'BC';
        });
        clock.now = 700;
        store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:ref', (element) => {
            element.ref = 'BC';
        });

        store.undo();
        expect(store.document.value.elements[1]).toMatchObject({ label: 'BC', ref: null });
        store.undo();
        expect(store.document.value.elements[1].label).toBe('B');
        store.undo();
        expect(store.document.value.elements[1].label).toBe('A-01');
    });

    it('redoes and drops the redo stack on a new mutation', () => {
        const { store, clock } = storeWithClock();

        store.updateElement('p1', 'a', (element) => {
            element.label = 'B';
        });
        store.undo();
        expect(store.canRedo.value).toBe(true);
        store.redo();
        expect(store.document.value.elements[1].label).toBe('B');

        store.undo();
        clock.now = 5000;
        store.updateElement('p1', 'b', (element) => {
            element.label = 'C';
        });

        expect(store.canRedo.value).toBe(false);
    });

    it('keeps at most 50 undo steps', () => {
        const { store, clock } = storeWithClock();

        for (let step = 1; step <= 60; step++) {
            clock.now = step * 1000;
            store.updateElement('p1', 'inspector:label', (element) => {
                element.label = `L${step}`;
            });
        }

        let undone = 0;

        while (store.canUndo.value) {
            store.undo();
            undone++;
        }

        expect(undone).toBe(50);
        expect(store.document.value.elements[1].label).toBe('L10');
    });

    it('is clean again after markSaved and dirty after the next edit', () => {
        const { store, clock } = storeWithClock();

        store.updateElement('p1', 'a', (element) => {
            element.label = 'B';
        });
        store.markSaved();
        expect(store.isDirty.value).toBe(false);

        clock.now = 1000;
        store.updateElement('p1', 'b', (element) => {
            element.label = 'C';
        });
        expect(store.isDirty.value).toBe(true);
    });

    it('marks the sent snapshot as saved, not edits made meanwhile', () => {
        const { store, clock } = storeWithClock();

        store.updateElement('p1', 'a', (element) => {
            element.label = 'B';
        });
        const sent = store.document.value;
        clock.now = 1000;
        store.updateElement('p1', 'b', (element) => {
            element.label = 'C';
        });

        store.markSaved(sent);

        expect(store.isDirty.value).toBe(true);
    });

    it('removes descendants with their parent and prunes the selection', () => {
        const { store } = storeWithClock();

        store.select(['g1', 'p1']);
        store.removeElements(['g1']);

        expect(store.document.value.elements).toEqual([]);
        expect(store.selection.value).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('moves the given elements but never a locked one', () => {
        const { store } = storeWithClock();

        store.moveElements(['p1', 'p2'], 100, -50);

        expect(store.document.value.elements[1]).toMatchObject({ x: 100, y: -50 });
        expect(store.document.value.elements[2]).toMatchObject({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    });

    it('toggles membership in the selection', () => {
        const { store } = storeWithClock();

        store.select(['p1']);
        store.toggleSelected('p2');
        store.toggleSelected('p1');

        expect(store.selection.value).toEqual(['p2']);
        expect(store.selectedElements.value.map((element) => element.id)).toEqual(['p2']);
    });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `usePlanStore.ts`**

```ts
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { DraftDocument, DraftElement, PlanDocument, PlanElement } from './document';
import { clone, descendantIds } from './document';

/**
 * Working copy, selection and undo ring of the plan editor (design §8.3).
 *
 * Every edit goes through `applyMutation`, which replaces the document
 * with a mutated clone — the document is never mutated in place, so a
 * snapshot is just the previous object and costs nothing. Mutations with
 * the same label inside `coalesceMs` share one undo step, so typing a
 * label is one step instead of one per keystroke (the LanCore lesson).
 * `isDirty` compares against the last saved document; `markSaved` takes
 * the snapshot that was actually sent, so an edit made while the request
 * was in flight stays unsaved.
 */
export type Tool = 'select' | 'place' | 'annotation' | 'delete' | 'pan';

export type PlanStoreOptions = {
    now?: () => number;
    coalesceMs?: number;
    historyLimit?: number;
};

type Snapshot = { document: DraftDocument; label: string };

function serialise(document: PlanDocument | DraftDocument): string {
    return JSON.stringify(document);
}

export function createPlanStore(initial: PlanDocument, options: PlanStoreOptions = {}) {
    const now = options.now ?? ((): number => Date.now());
    const coalesceMs = options.coalesceMs ?? 500;
    const historyLimit = options.historyLimit ?? 50;

    const document = shallowRef<DraftDocument>(clone(initial) as DraftDocument);
    const selection = ref<string[]>([]);
    const tool = ref<Tool>('select');
    const past = shallowRef<Snapshot[]>([]);
    const future = shallowRef<Snapshot[]>([]);
    const baseline = ref(serialise(initial));
    let lastLabel: string | null = null;
    let lastAt = 0;

    const isDirty = computed(() => serialise(document.value) !== baseline.value);
    const canUndo = computed(() => past.value.length > 0);
    const canRedo = computed(() => future.value.length > 0);
    const selectedElements = computed<PlanElement[]>(() => {
        const ids = new Set(selection.value);

        return document.value.elements.filter((element) => ids.has(element.id));
    });

    function pruneSelection(): void {
        const ids = new Set(document.value.elements.map((element) => element.id));
        selection.value = selection.value.filter((id) => ids.has(id));
    }

    function applyMutation(
        label: string,
        fn: (draft: DraftDocument) => void,
        coalesce = true,
    ): void {
        const at = now();
        const merge = coalesce && lastLabel === label && at - lastAt < coalesceMs && past.value.length > 0;

        if (!merge) {
            past.value = [...past.value, { document: document.value, label }].slice(-historyLimit);
        }

        future.value = [];

        const draft = clone(document.value);
        fn(draft);
        document.value = draft;
        lastLabel = coalesce ? label : null;
        lastAt = at;
    }

    function undo(): void {
        const snapshot = past.value[past.value.length - 1];

        if (!snapshot) {
            return;
        }

        past.value = past.value.slice(0, -1);
        future.value = [...future.value, { document: document.value, label: snapshot.label }];
        document.value = snapshot.document;
        lastLabel = null;
        pruneSelection();
    }

    function redo(): void {
        const snapshot = future.value[future.value.length - 1];

        if (!snapshot) {
            return;
        }

        future.value = future.value.slice(0, -1);
        past.value = [...past.value, { document: document.value, label: snapshot.label }];
        document.value = snapshot.document;
        lastLabel = null;
        pruneSelection();
    }

    function markSaved(saved: PlanDocument | DraftDocument = document.value): void {
        baseline.value = serialise(saved);
    }

    function replaceDocument(next: PlanDocument): void {
        document.value = clone(next) as DraftDocument;
        past.value = [];
        future.value = [];
        selection.value = [];
        lastLabel = null;
        markSaved();
    }

    function select(ids: string[]): void {
        selection.value = [...new Set(ids)];
    }

    function toggleSelected(id: string): void {
        selection.value = selection.value.includes(id)
            ? selection.value.filter((selected) => selected !== id)
            : [...selection.value, id];
    }

    function clearSelection(): void {
        selection.value = [];
    }

    function updateElement(id: string, label: string, patch: (element: DraftElement) => void): void {
        applyMutation(label, (draft) => {
            const element = draft.elements.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);

            if (element) {
                patch(element);
            }
        });
    }

    function moveElements(ids: string[], dx: number, dy: number): void {
        const moving = new Set(ids);

        applyMutation(
            'move',
            (draft) => {
                for (const element of draft.elements) {
                    if (moving.has(element.id) && !element.locked) {
                        element.x += dx;
                        element.y += dy;
                    }
                }
            },
            false,
        );
    }

    function removeElements(ids: string[]): void {
        const doomed = new Set(ids);

        for (const id of ids) {
            for (const descendant of descendantIds(document.value, id)) {
                doomed.add(descendant);
            }
        }

        applyMutation(
            'delete',
            (draft) => {
                draft.elements = draft.elements.filter((element) => !doomed.has(element.id));
            },
            false,
        );
        pruneSelection();
    }

    function addElements(label: string, elements: DraftElement[]): void {
        applyMutation(
            label,
            (draft) => {
                draft.elements.push(...elements);
            },
            false,
        );
    }

    return {
        document,
        selection,
        tool,
        isDirty,
        canUndo,
        canRedo,
        selectedElements,
        applyMutation,
        undo,
        redo,
        markSaved,
        replaceDocument,
        select,
        toggleSelected,
        clearSelection,
        updateElement,
        moveElements,
        removeElements,
        addElements,
    };
}

export type PlanStore = ReturnType<typeof createPlanStore>;
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write `usePlanShortcuts.ts`**

```ts
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted } from 'vue';
import type { PlanStore, Tool } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * The editor's keyboard (design §8.3): V select, S place, L annotation,
 * D delete, Space pans while held, Esc clears, Del deletes, Ctrl+Z /
 * Shift+Ctrl+Z undo and redo, Ctrl+S saves. Nothing fires while focus is
 * in a form control, so the inspector keeps its own keys.
 */
const TOOL_KEYS: Record<string, Tool> = { v: 'select', s: 'place', l: 'annotation', d: 'delete' };

function inFormControl(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
    const element = target as HTMLElement | null;

    return (
        element !== null &&
        (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(element.tagName) || element.isContentEditable)
    );
}

export function usePlanShortcuts(handlers: {
    store: PlanStore;
    save: () => void;
    deleteSelection: () => void;
}): void {
    let toolBeforePan: Tool | null = null;

    function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
        if (inFormControl(event.target)) {
            return;
        }

        const key = event.key.toLowerCase();

        if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && key === 'z') {
            event.preventDefault();

            if (event.shiftKey) {
                handlers.store.redo();
            } else {
                handlers.store.undo();
            }

            return;
        }

        if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && key === 's') {
            event.preventDefault();
            handlers.save();

            return;
        }

        if (event.key === 'Delete' || event.key === 'Backspace') {
            if (handlers.store.selection.value.length > 0) {
                event.preventDefault();
                handlers.deleteSelection();
            }

            return;
        }

        if (event.key === 'Escape') {
            handlers.store.clearSelection();
            handlers.store.tool.value = 'select';

            return;
        }

        if (event.key === ' ' && toolBeforePan === null) {
            event.preventDefault();
            toolBeforePan = handlers.store.tool.value;
            handlers.store.tool.value = 'pan';

            return;
        }

        const tool = TOOL_KEYS[key];

        if (tool && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.altKey) {
            handlers.store.tool.value = tool;

            if (tool === 'delete') {
                handlers.store.clearSelection();
            }
        }
    }

    function onKeyup(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
        if (event.key === ' ' && toolBeforePan !== null) {
            handlers.store.tool.value = toolBeforePan;
            toolBeforePan = null;
        }
    }

    onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
        window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyup);
    });

    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
        window.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyup);
    });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `PlanCanvas.vue`**

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import type { Bbox } from '../geometry';
import { absoluteBbox, documentBbox, hitTest } from '../geometry';
import SeatPlanScene from '../SeatPlanScene.vue';
import type { Point } from './document';
import type { SnapStep } from './snap';
import { snapDelta } from './snap';
import type { PlanStore } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * The viewer's scene plus the editor overlay (design §8.3). The wrapper
 * captures every pointer-down first: with the pan tool or the middle
 * button it lets the scene pan as it does for participants; otherwise it
 * stops the event and decides — hit an element (select, drag), hit the
 * floor (marquee), or hand the point to the page for the place and
 * annotation tools. A drag is one `move` mutation on pointer-up; while it
 * lasts, ghost boxes in the overlay show where things will land.
 */
type PlaceState = Konventix.Resources.Enums.PlaceState;

type Drag = { pointerId: number; origin: Point; anchor: Point; ids: string[]; offset: Point };
type Marquee = { pointerId: number; origin: Point; corner: Point };
type Box = { id: string; box: Bbox };

const props = defineProps<{
    store: PlanStore;
    plan: Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanViewData;
    categories: Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData[];
    states: Record<string, PlaceState>;
    snapStep: SnapStep;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'canvas-click': [point: Point] }>();

const store = props.store;
const scene = ref<InstanceType<typeof SeatPlanScene> | null>(null);
const drag = ref<Drag | null>(null);
const marquee = ref<Marquee | null>(null);

const scenePlan = computed(() => ({ ...props.plan, document: store.document.value }));

const cursorClass = computed(() => {
    switch (store.tool.value) {
        case 'pan':
            return 'cursor-grab';
        case 'delete':
            return 'cursor-not-allowed';
        case 'place':
        case 'annotation':
            return 'cursor-crosshair';
        default:
            return 'cursor-default';
    }
});

/** A point-shaped element still needs something to grab and to ring. */
function padded(box: Bbox): Bbox {
    const w = Math.max(box.w, 200);
    const h = Math.max(box.h, 200);

    return { x: box.x - (w - box.w) / 2, y: box.y - (h - box.h) / 2, w, h };
}

const selectionBoxes = computed<Box[]>(() =>
    store.selection.value.map((id) => ({ id, box: padded(absoluteBbox(store.document.value, id)) })),
);

const ghostBoxes = computed<Box[]>(() => {
    const current = drag.value;

    if (!current || (current.offset.x === 0 && current.offset.y === 0)) {
        return [];
    }

    return current.ids.map((id) => {
        const box = padded(absoluteBbox(store.document.value, id));

        return { id, box: { ...box, x: box.x + current.offset.x, y: box.y + current.offset.y } };
    });
});

const marqueeRect = computed<Bbox | null>(() => {
    const current = marquee.value;

    if (!current) {
        return null;
    }

    return {
        x: Math.min(current.origin.x, current.corner.x),
        y: Math.min(current.origin.y, current.corner.y),
        w: Math.abs(current.corner.x - current.origin.x),
        h: Math.abs(current.corner.y - current.origin.y),
    };
});

function worldPoint(event: PointerEvent): Point | null {
    return scene.value?.svgPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY) ?? null;
}

function contains(outer: Bbox, inner: Bbox): boolean {
    return (
        inner.x >= outer.x &&
        inner.y >= outer.y &&
        inner.x + inner.w <= outer.x + outer.w &&
        inner.y + inner.h <= outer.y + outer.h
    );
}

function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (store.tool.value === 'pan' || event.button === 1) {
        return;
    }

    if (event.button !== 0) {
        return;
    }

    const point = worldPoint(event);

    if (!point) {
        return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
    const hit = hitTest(store.document.value, point);

    if (store.tool.value === 'delete') {
        if (hit !== null) {
            store.removeElements([hit]);
        }

        return;
    }

    if (store.tool.value === 'place' || store.tool.value === 'annotation') {
        emit('canvas-click', point);

        return;
    }

    const target = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;

    if (hit === null) {
        if (!event.shiftKey) {
            store.clearSelection();
        }

        marquee.value = { pointerId: event.pointerId, origin: point, corner: point };
        target.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);

        return;
    }

    if (event.shiftKey) {
        store.toggleSelected(hit);

        return;
    }

    if (!store.selection.value.includes(hit)) {
        store.select([hit]);
    }

    const ids = store.selectedElements.value.filter((element) => !element.locked).map((element) => element.id);

    if (ids.length === 0) {
        return;
    }

    const anchorBox = absoluteBbox(store.document.value, ids[0]);
    drag.value = { pointerId: event.pointerId, origin: point, anchor: { x: anchorBox.x, y: anchorBox.y }, ids, offset: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
    target.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}

function onPointerMove(event: PointerEvent): void {
    const point = worldPoint(event);

    if (!point) {
        return;
    }

    if (drag.value && drag.value.pointerId === event.pointerId) {
        drag.value.offset = snapDelta(
            drag.value.anchor,
            { x: point.x - drag.value.origin.x, y: point.y - drag.value.origin.y },
            props.snapStep,
        );

        return;
    }

    if (marquee.value && marquee.value.pointerId === event.pointerId) {
        marquee.value.corner = point;
    }
}

function onPointerUp(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (drag.value && drag.value.pointerId === event.pointerId) {
        const { ids, offset } = drag.value;
        drag.value = null;

        if (offset.x !== 0 || offset.y !== 0) {
            store.moveElements(ids, offset.x, offset.y);
        }

        return;
    }

    if (marquee.value && marquee.value.pointerId === event.pointerId) {
        const rect = marqueeRect.value;
        marquee.value = null;

        if (!rect || (rect.w === 0 && rect.h === 0)) {
            return;
        }

        const inside = store.document.value.elements
            .filter((element) => contains(rect, absoluteBbox(store.document.value, element.id)))
            .map((element) => element.id);

        store.select(event.shiftKey ? [...store.selection.value, ...inside] : inside);
    }
}

function focusBbox(bbox: Bbox): void {
    scene.value?.fitToBbox(bbox);
}

function fitAll(): void {
    const bbox = documentBbox(store.document.value);

    if (bbox) {
        scene.value?.fitToBbox(bbox);
    }
}

defineExpose({ focusBbox, fitAll });
</script>

<template>
    <div
        class="relative h-full w-full touch-none select-none"
        :class="cursorClass"
        @pointerdown.capture="onPointerDown"
        @pointermove="onPointerMove"
        @pointerup="onPointerUp"
        @pointercancel="onPointerUp"
    >
        <SeatPlanScene ref="scene" :plan="scenePlan" :categories="categories" :states="states">
            <template #overlay>
                <g class="pointer-events-none">
                    <rect
                        v-for="entry in selectionBoxes"
                        :key="`sel-${entry.id}`"
                        :x="entry.box.x - 40"
                        :y="entry.box.y - 40"
                        :width="entry.box.w + 80"
                        :height="entry.box.h + 80"
                        class="fill-none stroke-accent"
                        stroke-width="2"
                        vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
                    />
                    <rect
                        v-for="entry in ghostBoxes"
                        :key="`ghost-${entry.id}`"
                        :x="entry.box.x"
                        :y="entry.box.y"
                        :width="entry.box.w"
                        :height="entry.box.h"
                        class="fill-accent/15 stroke-accent"
                        stroke-width="1.5"
                        stroke-dasharray="6 4"
                        vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
                    />
                    <rect
                        v-if="marqueeRect"
                        :x="marqueeRect.x"
                        :y="marqueeRect.y"
                        :width="marqueeRect.w"
                        :height="marqueeRect.h"
                        class="fill-accent/10 stroke-accent"
                        stroke-width="1"
                        vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
                    />
                </g>
            </template>
        </SeatPlanScene>
    </div>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Ban, Hand, Maximize, MousePointer2, Redo2, Square, Type, Undo2 } from '@lucide/vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import type { SnapStep } from './snap';
import { SNAP_STEPS } from './snap';
import type { PlanStore, Tool } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * Tools, undo/redo, the grid step and "fit". Every button is a real button
 * with an accessible name and `aria-pressed` for the active tool, so the
 * keyboard path (.ai/rules/js.md) and the shortcut path meet in one state.
 */
const props = defineProps<{ store: PlanStore; snapStep: SnapStep }>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:snapStep': [step: SnapStep]; fit: [] }>();

const store = props.store;

const tools: { tool: Tool; label: string; key: string; icon: typeof MousePointer2 }[] = [
    { tool: 'select', label: 'Select (V)', key: 'V', icon: MousePointer2 },
    { tool: 'place', label: 'Add place (S)', key: 'S', icon: Square },
    { tool: 'annotation', label: 'Add annotation (L)', key: 'L', icon: Type },
    { tool: 'delete', label: 'Delete on click (D)', key: 'D', icon: Ban },
    { tool: 'pan', label: 'Pan (hold Space)', key: 'Space', icon: Hand },
];

function onSnapChange(event: Event): void {
    emit('update:snapStep', Number((event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value) as SnapStep);
}
</script>

<template>
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2" role="toolbar" aria-label="Editor tools">
        <Button
            v-for="entry in tools"
            :key="entry.tool"
            type="button"
            size="icon-sm"
            :variant="store.tool.value === entry.tool ? 'default' : 'outline'"
            :aria-pressed="store.tool.value === entry.tool"
            :aria-label="entry.label"
            :title="entry.label"
            @click="store.tool.value = entry.tool"
        >
            <component :is="entry.icon" class="size-4" />
        </Button>

        <span class="mx-1 h-6 w-px bg-border" aria-hidden="true" />

        <Button type="button" size="icon-sm" variant="outline" aria-label="Undo (Ctrl+Z)" :disabled="!store.canUndo.value" @click="store.undo()">
            <Undo2 class="size-4" />
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" size="icon-sm" variant="outline" aria-label="Redo (Shift+Ctrl+Z)" :disabled="!store.canRedo.value" @click="store.redo()">
            <Redo2 class="size-4" />
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" size="icon-sm" variant="outline" aria-label="Fit plan into view" @click="emit('fit')">
            <Maximize class="size-4" />
        </Button>

        <label class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-text-muted">
            Grid
            <select
                :value="snapStep"
                aria-label="Snap step in millimetres"
                class="h-8 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-2 text-sm text-text"
                @change="onSnapChange"
            >
                <option v-for="step in SNAP_STEPS" :key="step" :value="step">{{ step }} mm</option>
            </select>
        </label>
    </div>
</template>
```

**Files:**
- Create: `app-modules/resources/resources/js/components/plan/editor/PlanElementTree.vue`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `usePlanStore.ts`, `document.ts`, S5 `tokens.ts` (`categoryTokenVar`), S4 routes `reserve`, `unreserve` from `@/routes/admin/plans`, `PlanOccupancyData`.
- Produces: `PlanElementTree` props `{ store }`; `PlanInspector` props `{ store, planId, categories, occupancy, canReserve }`, emits `regenerate(groupId)`, `occupancy-changed`; `PlanInspectorKindFields` props `{ store, element, categories }`, emits `regenerate(groupId)`; `PlanInspectorReservation` props `{ planId, placeId, entry, canReserve, dirty }`, emits `changed`.

Ported idea from LanCore `PropertiesPanel.vue:29-61` (context-sensitive panel: nothing / one / many selected) and the LanCore map's lesson that the panel must not push one undo step per keystroke — every field goes through `store.updateElement` with a stable label, which the store coalesces.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write `PlanElementTree.vue`**

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CircleAlert, Lock } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { PlanElement } from './document';
import { childrenIndex } from './document';
import type { PlanStore } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * The second navigation next to the canvas (LanCore lesson: a container has
 * no reliable hit area, so the list is how you reach a group or a zone).
 * Buttons with `aria-pressed` carry the selection, so the whole tree is a
 * keyboard path (.ai/rules/js.md).
 */
const props = defineProps<{ store: PlanStore }>();

const store = props.store;

type Row = { element: PlanElement; depth: number };

const rows = computed<Row[]>(() => {
    const index = childrenIndex(store.document.value);
    const out: Row[] = [];

    const walk = (parentId: string | null, depth: number): void => {
        for (const element of index.get(parentId) ?? []) {
            out.push({ element, depth });
            walk(element.id, depth + 1);
        }
    };

    walk(null, 0);

    return out;
});

function title(element: PlanElement): string {
    return element.label ?? element.ref ?? element.text ?? element.kind;
}

function onClick(element: PlanElement, event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.shiftKey) {
        store.toggleSelected(element.id);
    } else {
        store.select([element.id]);
    }
}
</script>

<template>
    <nav aria-label="Plan elements" class="flex h-full flex-col overflow-y-auto">
        <p v-if="rows.length === 0" class="p-3 text-sm text-text-muted">
            No elements yet. Add a group, or press S and click the floor to place a seat.
        </p>
        <ul v-else class="flex flex-col py-1">
            <li v-for="row in rows" :key="row.element.id">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 py-1 pr-2 text-left text-sm text-text hover:bg-subtle aria-pressed:bg-accent/15"
                    :style="{ paddingLeft: `${0.5 + row.depth}rem` }"
                    :aria-pressed="store.selection.value.includes(row.element.id)"
                    @click="onClick(row.element, $event)"
                >
                    <span class="w-16 shrink-0 text-xs uppercase text-text-muted">{{ row.element.kind }}</span>
                    <span class="truncate">{{ title(row.element) }}</span>
                    <Lock v-if="row.element.locked" class="ml-auto size-3 shrink-0 text-text-muted" aria-label="Locked" />
                    <CircleAlert v-if="row.element.blocked" class="size-3 shrink-0 text-warning" aria-label="Blocked" />
                </button>
            </li>
        </ul>
    </nav>
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `PlanInspectorReservation.vue`**

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useHttp } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { Bookmark, BookmarkX } from '@lucide/vue';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { reserve, unreserve } from '@/routes/admin/plans';

/**
 * The operator's own reservation on one place (design §7.3,
 * `ReservePlaceForOperator` / `ReleaseOperatorReservation`, both behind
 * `BookOnBehalf`). A reservation needs the projected resource row, so the
 * buttons wait for a clean document: an unsaved place has no row yet.
 */
type Entry = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanOccupancyData['places'][string];

const props = defineProps<{
    planId: string;
    placeId: string;
    entry: Entry | null;
    canReserve: boolean;
    dirty: boolean;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ changed: [] }>();

const error = ref<string | null>(null);
const http = useHttp<Record<string, never>, unknown>({});

function run(request: Promise<unknown>): void {
    error.value = null;
    request.then(() => emit('changed')).catch(() => {
        error.value = 'The reservation could not be changed. Reload the occupancy and try again.';
    });
}

function reservePlace(): void {
    run(http.post(reserve({ plan: props.planId, place: props.placeId }).url));
}

function releasePlace(): void {
    run(http.delete(unreserve({ plan: props.planId, place: props.placeId }).url));
}
</script>

<template>
    <section class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3" aria-labelledby="inspector-reservation">
        <h3 id="inspector-reservation" class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-text-muted">Occupancy</h3>

        <p v-if="entry === null" class="text-sm text-text-muted">Free.</p>
        <p v-else-if="entry.holderType === 'operator'" class="text-sm text-text">Reserved by the organisation.</p>
        <p v-else class="text-sm text-text">
            {{ entry.state === 'held' ? 'Held' : 'Booked' }} by registration
            <span class="font-mono text-xs">{{ entry.registrationId }}</span>
        </p>

        <template v-if="canReserve">
            <Button
                v-if="entry === null"
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                :disabled="dirty || http.processing"
                @click="reservePlace"
            >
                <Bookmark class="size-4" />
                Reserve for the organisation
            </Button>
            <Button
                v-else-if="entry.holderType === 'operator'"
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                :disabled="dirty || http.processing"
                @click="releasePlace"
            >
                <BookmarkX class="size-4" />
                Release reservation
            </Button>
            <p v-if="dirty" class="text-xs text-text-muted">Save the plan first — a reservation needs the saved place.</p>
        </template>

        <p v-if="error" role="alert" class="text-sm text-danger">{{ error }}</p>
    </section>
</template>
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `PlanInspectorKindFields.vue`**

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RefreshCw } from '@lucide/vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { categoryTokenVar } from '../tokens';
import type { DraftElement, PlanElement } from './document';
import type { PlanStore } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * The fields that exist for one kind only (design §5): zone token, group
 * layout and label schema, place category and flags, fixture type,
 * annotation text. Every change is one labelled mutation the store
 * coalesces while the operator types.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    store: PlanStore;
    element: PlanElement;
    categories: Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData[];
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ regenerate: [groupId: string] }>();

const store = props.store;
const TOKENS: Konventix.Resources.Enums.CategoryToken[] = ['chart-1', 'chart-2', 'chart-3', 'chart-4', 'chart-5', 'accent', 'success', 'warning', 'danger'];
const FIXTURES: Konventix.Resources.Enums.FixtureType[] = ['table', 'counter', 'stage', 'wall', 'pillar', 'custom'];

function patch(field: string, apply: (element: DraftElement) => void): void {
    store.updateElement(props.element.id, `inspector:${field}`, apply);
}

function number(value: string | number | null): number | null {
    if (value === null || value === '') {
        return null;
    }

    const parsed = Number(value);

    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? Math.round(parsed) : null;
}

function patchLayout(field: 'count' | 'rows' | 'cols' | 'spacing' | 'rowSpacing' | 'startIndex', value: string | number | null): void {
    patch(`layout.${field}`, (element) => {
        if (element.layout) {
            element.layout[field] = number(value) ?? (field === 'spacing' || field === 'startIndex' ? 1 : null);
        }
    });
}

function setLayoutType(event: Event): void {
    const type = (event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as Konventix.Resources.Enums.LayoutKind;

    patch('layout.type', (element) => {
        element.layout = element.layout
            ? { ...element.layout, type }
            : { type, count: 8, rows: 2, cols: 4, spacing: 800, rowSpacing: 1000, startIndex: 1 };
    });
}

function patchSchema(field: 'row' | 'place', value: string | number | null): void {
    patch(`labelSchema.${field}`, (element) => {
        element.labelSchema = { row: '{row}', place: '{row}-{n:02}', ...element.labelSchema, [field]: String(value ?? '') };
    });
}

function onCategory(event: Event): void {
    const value = (event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value;

    patch('resourceTypeId', (element) => {
        element.resourceTypeId = value === '' ? null : value;
    });
}

function onFlag(field: 'accessible' | 'blocked' | 'detached', value: boolean | 'indeterminate'): void {
    patch(field, (element) => {
        element[field] = value === true;
    });
}
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Trash2 } from '@lucide/vue';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import type { DraftElement } from './document';
import PlanInspectorKindFields from './PlanInspectorKindFields.vue';
import PlanInspectorReservation from './PlanInspectorReservation.vue';
import type { PlanStore } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * Context-sensitive panel: the plan when nothing is selected, one
 * element's fields when one is, bulk actions when several are. Common
 * fields live here, kind-specific ones in `PlanInspectorKindFields`, the
 * operator reservation in `PlanInspectorReservation`.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    store: PlanStore;
    planId: string;
    categories: Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData[];
    occupancy: Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanOccupancyData;
    canReserve: boolean;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ regenerate: [groupId: string]; 'occupancy-changed': [] }>();

const store = props.store;

const selected = computed(() => store.selectedElements.value);
const single = computed(() => (selected.value.length === 1 ? selected.value[0] : null));
const selectedPlaces = computed(() => selected.value.filter((element) => element.kind === 'place'));

const counts = computed(() => {
    const out: Record<string, number> = {};

    for (const element of store.document.value.elements) {
        out[element.kind] = (out[element.kind] ?? 0) + 1;
    }

    return out;
});

function patch(field: string, apply: (element: DraftElement) => void): void {
    if (single.value) {
        store.updateElement(single.value.id, `inspector:${field}`, apply);
    }
}

function patchNumber(field: 'x' | 'y' | 'rotation', value: string | number | null): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
        return;
    }

    patch(field, (element) => {
        element[field] = field === 'rotation' ? parsed : Math.round(parsed);
    });
}

function patchShape(field: 'w' | 'h' | 'rx' | 'ry' | 'radius', value: string | number | null): void {
    const parsed = Number(value);

    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
        return;
    }

    patch(`shape.${field}`, (element) => {
        element.shape[field] = Math.max(1, Math.round(parsed));
    });
}

function bulkCategory(event: Event): void {
    const value = (event.target as HTMLSelectElement).value;
    const ids = new Set(selectedPlaces.value.map((element) => element.id));

    store.applyMutation(
        'bulk:category',
        (draft) => {
            for (const element of draft.elements) {
                if (ids.has(element.id)) {
                    element.resourceTypeId = value || null;
                }
            }
        },
        false,
    );
}

function bulkFlag(field: 'blocked' | 'locked', value: boolean): void {
    const ids = new Set(selected.value.map((element) => element.id));

    store.applyMutation(
        `bulk:${field}`,
        (draft) => {
            for (const element of draft.elements) {
                if (ids.has(element.id)) {
                    element[field] = value;
                }
            }
        },
        false,
    );
}
</script>
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write `planEditing.ts`**

```ts
import type { Bbox } from '../geometry';
import { documentBbox } from '../geometry';
import type { DraftElement, LabelSchema, Layout, PlanDocument, Point } from './document';
import { absolutePosition, childrenOf, DEFAULT_SHAPES, elementById, newElement } from './document';
import { generatePlaces } from './generator';

/**
 * The page-level edits that need more than one element: creating a group
 * with its places, dropping a place or an annotation at a point, and
 * regenerating a group's children. Pure functions over the document; the
 * store applies what they return.
 */
export type GroupSpec = {
    label: string;
    layout: Layout;
    labelSchema: LabelSchema;
    resourceTypeId: string;
};

const GROUP_GAP_MM = 1000;

/**
 * A new group goes right of everything that exists (LanCore lesson: a
 * group created under existing content looks like nothing happened).
 */
export function buildGroup(
    document: PlanDocument,
    spec: GroupSpec,
    newId: () => string,
): { elements: DraftElement[]; bbox: Bbox } {
    const existing = documentBbox(document);
    const origin: Point = existing ? { x: existing.x + existing.w + GROUP_GAP_MM, y: existing.y } : { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const group = newElement('group', newId(), {
        label: spec.label,
        x: origin.x,
        y: origin.y,
        layout: { ...spec.layout },
        labelSchema: { ...spec.labelSchema },
    });

    const places = generatePlaces({
        parentId: group.id,
        groupLabel: spec.label,
        layout: spec.layout,
        labelSchema: spec.labelSchema,
        resourceTypeId: spec.resourceTypeId,
        shape: DEFAULT_SHAPES.place,
        existing: [],
        newId,
    });

    const width = places.reduce((max, place) => Math.max(max, place.x + (place.shape.w ?? 0)), 0);
    const height = places.reduce((max, place) => Math.max(max, place.y + (place.shape.h ?? 0)), 0);

    return {
        elements: [group, ...places],
        bbox: { x: origin.x, y: origin.y, w: Math.max(width, 800), h: Math.max(height, 800) },
    };
}

/** Coordinates are relative to the parent (design §5). */
function relativeTo(document: PlanDocument, parentId: string | null, point: Point): Point {
    if (parentId === null) {
        return point;
    }

    const parent = absolutePosition(document, parentId);

    return { x: point.x - parent.x, y: point.y - parent.y };
}

export function placeAt(
    document: PlanDocument,
    point: Point,
    parentId: string | null,
    resourceTypeId: string,
    newId: () => string,
): DraftElement {
    const position = relativeTo(document, parentId, point);

    return newElement('place', newId(), {
        parentId,
        resourceTypeId,
        detached: parentId !== null,
        x: position.x,
        y: position.y,
    });
}

export function annotationAt(
    document: PlanDocument,
    point: Point,
    parentId: string | null,
    newId: () => string,
): DraftElement {
    const position = relativeTo(document, parentId, point);

    return newElement('annotation', newId(), { parentId, x: position.x, y: position.y });
}

/**
 * The group's children after regeneration, or null when the group has no
 * layout to regenerate from. The caller replaces the old children.
 */
export function regeneratedChildren(
    document: PlanDocument,
    groupId: string,
    newId: () => string,
): DraftElement[] | null {
    const group = elementById(document, groupId);

    if (!group || group.kind !== 'group' || !group.layout) {
        return null;
    }

    const children = childrenOf(document, groupId);
    const firstPlace = children.find((child) => child.kind === 'place' && child.resourceTypeId !== null);

    return generatePlaces({
        parentId: groupId,
        groupLabel: group.label ?? '',
        layout: group.layout,
        labelSchema: group.labelSchema ?? { row: '{row}', place: '{row}-{n:02}' },
        resourceTypeId: firstPlace?.resourceTypeId ?? '',
        shape: firstPlace?.shape ?? DEFAULT_SHAPES.place,
        existing: children,
        newId,
    });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write `usePlanSave.ts`**

```ts
import { useHttp } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { update as updatePlan, validate as validatePlan } from '@/routes/admin/plans';
import type { PlanDocument } from './document';
import type { PlanStore } from './usePlanStore';

/**
 * Save and dry run through Inertia v3 `useHttp` (design §8.3). The three
 * server answers map onto three callbacks: 200 → `onSuccess`, a 422 →
 * `onError` with the body's `errors` (the controller mirrors the conflict
 * list there because that is all `useHttp` hands over for a 422), 409 and
 * anything else → `onHttpException`, whose `data` is still the raw body.
 *
 * `markSaved` receives the document that was sent, so an edit made while
 * the request was in flight keeps the pill on "Unsaved changes".
 */
type SaveResult = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanSaveResultData;
type Validation = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanValidationData;
type Conflict = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanConflictData;
type Resolution = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanConflictResolutionData;
type Warning = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanWarningData;

type Payload = { expectedVersion: number; document: PlanDocument; resolutions: Resolution[] };

export type SaveStatus = 'clean' | 'unsaved' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error';

const SAVED_PILL_MS = 2000;

function currentVersionOf(data: string | Record<string, unknown>): number | null {
    try {
        const parsed = typeof data === 'string' ? (JSON.parse(data) as Record<string, unknown>) : data;

        return typeof parsed.currentVersion === 'number' ? parsed.currentVersion : null;
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

export function usePlanSave(planId: string, initialVersion: number, store: PlanStore) {
    const version = ref(initialVersion);
    const phase = ref<'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'>('idle');
    const message = ref<string | null>(null);
    const warnings = ref<Warning[]>([]);
    const checkConflicts = ref<Conflict[]>([]);
    const saveConflicts = ref<Conflict[]>([]);
    const serverErrors = ref<Record<string, string | string[]>>({});
    let savedTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const payload = (): Payload => ({ expectedVersion: version.value, document: store.document.value, resolutions: [] });
    const saveHttp = useHttp<Payload, SaveResult>(payload()).withAllErrors();
    const checkHttp = useHttp<Payload, Validation>(payload()).withAllErrors();

    const busy = computed(() => saveHttp.processing || checkHttp.processing);

    const status = computed<SaveStatus>(() => {
        if (phase.value === 'saving') {
            return 'saving';
        }

        if (phase.value === 'error') {
            return 'error';
        }

        if (store.isDirty.value) {
            return 'unsaved';
        }

        return phase.value === 'saved' ? 'saved' : 'clean';
    });

    function fail(text: string): void {
        phase.value = 'error';
        message.value = text;
    }

    function staleMessage(data: string | Record<string, unknown>): string {
        const current = currentVersionOf(data);

        return current === null
            ? 'Someone else saved this plan meanwhile. Reload the page and redo your changes.'
            : `Someone else saved version ${current} of this plan meanwhile. Reload the page and redo your changes.`;
    }

    function exceptionMessage(status: number, data: string | Record<string, unknown>): string {
        return status === 409 ? staleMessage(data) : `The server answered HTTP ${status}.`;
    }

    async function save(resolutions: Resolution[] = []): Promise<void> {
        if (saveHttp.processing) {
            return;
        }

        const sent = store.document.value;
        saveHttp.expectedVersion = version.value;
        saveHttp.document = sent;
        saveHttp.resolutions = resolutions;
        phase.value = 'saving';
        message.value = null;
        serverErrors.value = {};

        await saveHttp
            .put(updatePlan(planId).url, {
                onSuccess: (result) => {
                    version.value = result.version;
                    warnings.value = result.warnings;
                    saveConflicts.value = [];
                    checkConflicts.value = [];
                    store.markSaved(sent);
                    phase.value = 'saved';

                    if (savedTimer) {
                        clearTimeout(savedTimer);
                    }

                    savedTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (phase.value === 'saved') {
                            phase.value = 'idle';
                        }
                    }, SAVED_PILL_MS);
                },
                onError: (errors) => {
                    const list = (errors as Record<string, unknown>).conflicts;

                    if (Array.isArray(list)) {
                        saveConflicts.value = list as Conflict[];
                        phase.value = 'idle';

                        return;
                    }

                    serverErrors.value = errors as Record<string, string | string[]>;
                    fail('The server refused the document — see the checks below.');
                },
                onHttpException: (response) => {
                    fail(exceptionMessage(response.status, response.data));
                },
                onNetworkError: () => {
                    fail('The save did not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.');
                },
            })
            .catch(() => undefined);
    }

    async function validate(): Promise<void> {
        checkHttp.expectedVersion = version.value;
        checkHttp.document = store.document.value;
        checkHttp.resolutions = [];
        serverErrors.value = {};

        await checkHttp
            .post(validatePlan(planId).url, {
                onSuccess: (result) => {
                    checkConflicts.value = result.conflicts;
                    warnings.value = result.warnings;

                    if (phase.value === 'error') {
                        phase.value = 'idle';
                        message.value = null;
                    }
                },
                onError: (errors) => {
                    serverErrors.value = errors as Record<string, string | string[]>;
                },
                onHttpException: (response) => {
                    fail(exceptionMessage(response.status, response.data));
                },
                onNetworkError: () => {
                    fail('The check did not reach the server.');
                },
            })
            .catch(() => undefined);
    }

    function dismissConflicts(): void {
        saveConflicts.value = [];
    }

    return { version, status, message, busy, warnings, checkConflicts, saveConflicts, serverErrors, save, validate, dismissConflicts };
}
```

```vue
import type { InvariantIssue } from './invariants';

/**
 * One list for everything that stands between the document and a save:
 * client invariants (live), the server's validation errors from the last
 * attempt, the dry run's conflicts and the non-blocking warnings.
 */
type Conflict = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanConflictData;
type Warning = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanWarningData;

const props = defineProps<{
    issues: InvariantIssue[];
    conflicts: Conflict[];
    warnings: Warning[];
    serverErrors: Record<string, string | string[]>;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [elementId: string] }>();

const serverMessages = computed(() =>
    Object.entries(props.serverErrors)
        .filter(([key]) => key !== 'conflicts')
        .map(([key, value]) => ({ key, text: Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(' ') : value })),
);

const reasons: Record<Conflict['reason'], string> = {
    deleted: 'would be deleted',
    category_changed: 'would change category',
    blocked: 'would be blocked',
};

const empty = computed(

        props.conflicts.length === 0 &&
        props.warnings.length === 0 &&
        serverMessages.value.length === 0,
);
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';

/**
 * The save came back 422 with occupied places the document would delete,
 * recategorise or block (design §6.3). The only resolution in v1 is
 * `release`: the booking is released with reason `plan_conflict` and the
 * registrant's claim goes back to "please choose a seat". Resending
 * carries the same `expectedVersion` — a version that moved meanwhile
 * still answers 409.
 */
type Conflict = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanConflictData;
type Resolution = Konventix.Resources.Data.PlanConflictResolutionData;

const props = defineProps<{ open: boolean; conflicts: Conflict[]; processing: boolean }>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:open': [open: boolean]; resolve: [resolutions: Resolution[]] }>();

const reasons: Record<Conflict['reason'], string> = {
    deleted: 'deleted',
    category_changed: 'moved to another category',
    blocked: 'blocked',
};

const bookingCount = computed(() => props.conflicts.reduce((sum, conflict) => sum + conflict.bookings.length, 0));

function releaseAll(): void {
    emit('resolve', props.conflicts.map((conflict): Resolution => ({ placeId: conflict.placeId, resolution: 'release' })));
}
</script>

<template>
    <Dialog :open="open" @update:open="(value) => emit('update:open', value)">
        <DialogContent class="max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Occupied places affected</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                    {{ conflicts.length }} {{ conflicts.length === 1 ? 'place' : 'places' }} with
                    {{ bookingCount }} active {{ bookingCount === 1 ? 'booking' : 'bookings' }} would change. Releasing
                    sends the registrants back to choosing a seat; no mail is sent.
                </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>

            <ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
                <li v-for="conflict in conflicts" :key="conflict.placeId" class="rounded-md border border-border p-2">
                    <div class="font-medium text-text">
                        {{ conflict.ref ?? conflict.label ?? conflict.placeId }}
                        <span class="font-normal text-text-muted">— {{ reasons[conflict.reason] }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <ul class="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                        <li v-for="booking in conflict.bookings" :key="booking.bookingId">
                            {{ booking.holderType === 'operator' ? 'Organisation reservation' : 'Registration' }}
                            <span v-if="booking.registrationId" class="font-mono">{{ booking.registrationId }}</span>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>

            <DialogFooter>
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" :disabled="processing" @click="emit('update:open', false)">Keep the plan as saved</Button>
                <Button type="button" variant="destructive" :disabled="processing" @click="releaseAll">
                    Release {{ bookingCount }} {{ bookingCount === 1 ? 'booking' : 'bookings' }} and save
                </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, watch } from 'vue';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import type { GroupSpec } from './planEditing';

/**
 * "Add group": a linear row or a grid of places with a label schema
 * (design §5). The page places the result right of the plan, selects it
 * and switches to the select tool.
 */
const props = defineProps<{
    open: boolean;
    categories: Konventix.Resources.Data.CategoryData[];
    suggestedLabel: string;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:open': [open: boolean]; create: [spec: GroupSpec] }>();

const form = reactive({
    label: props.suggestedLabel,
    type: 'linear' as Konventix.Resources.Enums.LayoutKind,
    count: 16,
    rows: 2,
    cols: 8,
    spacing: 800,
    rowSpacing: 1000,
    startIndex: 1,
    rowSchema: '{row}',
    placeSchema: '{row}-{n:02}',
    resourceTypeId: props.categories[0]?.id ?? '',
});

watch(
    () => props.open,
    (open) => {
        if (open) {
            form.label = props.suggestedLabel;
            form.resourceTypeId = form.resourceTypeId || (props.categories[0]?.id ?? '');
        }
    },
);

function submit(): void {
    if (form.label.trim() === '' || form.resourceTypeId === '') {
        return;
    }

    emit('create', {
        label: form.label.trim(),
        layout: {
            type: form.type,
            count: form.type === 'linear' ? Math.max(0, Math.round(form.count)) : null,
            rows: form.type === 'grid' ? Math.max(0, Math.round(form.rows)) : null,
            cols: form.type === 'grid' ? Math.max(0, Math.round(form.cols)) : null,
            spacing: Math.max(1, Math.round(form.spacing)),
            rowSpacing: form.type === 'grid' ? Math.max(1, Math.round(form.rowSpacing)) : null,
            startIndex: Math.max(0, Math.round(form.startIndex)),
        },
        labelSchema: { row: form.rowSchema, place: form.placeSchema },
        resourceTypeId: form.resourceTypeId,
    });
    emit('update:open', false);
}
</script>

<template>
    <Dialog :open="open" @update:open="(value) => emit('update:open', value)">
        <DialogContent class="max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Add a group</DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>A row or a grid of places; the labels come from the schema. Everything is in millimetres.</DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>

            <form class="flex flex-col gap-4" @submit.prevent="submit">
                <p v-if="categories.length === 0" class="rounded-md border border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 p-3 text-sm text-text">
                    This event has no categories yet. Create one under Categories first — every place needs one.
                </p>

                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-label">Group label</Label>
                        <Input id="group-label" v-model="form.label" required />
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-category">Category</Label>
                        <select id="group-category" v-model="form.resourceTypeId" required class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-text">
                            <option v-for="category in categories" :key="category.id" :value="category.id">{{ category.name }}</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="grid gap-1">
                    <Label for="group-type">Layout</Label>
                    <select id="group-type" v-model="form.type" class="h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-sm text-text">
                        <option value="linear">Linear row</option>
                        <option value="grid">Grid</option>
                    </select>
                </div>

                <div v-if="form.type === 'linear'" class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-count">Places</Label>
                        <Input id="group-count" v-model.number="form.count" type="number" min="1" max="500" />
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-spacing">Spacing</Label>
                        <Input id="group-spacing" v-model.number="form.spacing" type="number" min="1" />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div v-else class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-rows">Rows</Label>
                        <Input id="group-rows" v-model.number="form.rows" type="number" min="1" max="100" />
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-cols">Columns</Label>
                        <Input id="group-cols" v-model.number="form.cols" type="number" min="1" max="100" />
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid gap-1">
                        <Label for="group-spacing-grid">Column spacing</Label>
                        <Input id="group-spacing-grid" v-model.number="form.spacing" type="number" min="1" />

                    <div class="grid gap-1">
```
